armA.definition: Complete lack of inhibition or restraint.
armA.arabic: الانطلاق بحرية تامة من غير أي قيود أو كسوف.. زي لما ترقص بجنون.
examples: (Noun usage rare at A1)
(Noun usage rare at A2)
He drove with reckless abandon.
She danced with total abandon.
They spent money with wild abandon.
He threw himself into the project with characteristic abandon.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band' 'فرقة موسيقية'.. لما تسمع الـ 'Band' بترقص بـ 'Abandon' 'انطلاق وحرية'.

armB.definition: Complete lack of inhibition or restraint.
armB.arabic: الانطلاق بحرية تامة من غير أي قيود أو كسوف.. زي لما ترقص بجنون.
examples: He drove with reckless abandon.
She danced with total abandon.
They spent money with wild abandon.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band' 'فرقة موسيقية'.. لما تسمع الـ 'Band' بترقص بـ 'Abandon' 'انطلاق وحرية'.

armA.definition: To use something to bad effect or for a bad purpose; to treat with cruelty.
armA.arabic: إنك تستخدم حاجة غلط، أو تعامل حد معاملة وحشة وعنيفة.
examples: Do not abuse animals.
He abused his position to get money.
People often abuse alcohol when they are stressed.
The prisoners were abused by the guards.
Don't abuse the hospitality of your hosts.
The politician was accused of abusing the system for personal gain.
armA.mnemonic: الفعل من 'Use' يستخدم.. 'Abuse' يسيء الاستخدام.

armB.definition: To use something to bad effect or for a bad purpose; to treat with cruelty.
armB.arabic: إنك تستخدم حاجة غلط، أو تعامل حد معاملة وحشة وعنيفة.
examples: Do not abuse animals.
People often abuse alcohol when they are stressed.
Don't abuse the hospitality of your hosts.
armB.mnemonic: الفعل من 'Use' يستخدم.. 'Abuse' يسيء الاستخدام.

armA.definition: In a way that is suitable or appropriate for the situation.
armA.arabic: يعني تتصرف بناءً على الموقف، أو تعمل اللي يناسب الظروف اللي إنت فيها.
examples: Act well.
Check the rules and act accordingly.
She was an expert, and they paid her accordingly.
The cost of materials rose, and we adjusted our prices accordingly.
Please inform us of your decision so we can proceed accordingly.
The circumstances have changed; accordingly, we must revise our strategy.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Accord' يعني اتفاق.. 'Accordingly' يعني طبقاً للاتفاق ده أو بناءً عليه.

armB.definition: In a way that is suitable or appropriate for the situation, or as a result of something mentioned.
armB.arabic: يعني التصرف بما يناسب الموقف أو الظروف، أو بمعنى «بناءً على ذلك / نتيجةً لذلك».
examples: Check the rules and act accordingly.
The cost of materials rose, and we adjusted our prices accordingly.
The circumstances have changed; accordingly, we must revise our strategy.
armB.translations: وفقاً لذلك بناءً عليه تبعاً لذلك
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Accord' يعني اتفاق.. 'Accordingly' يعني طبقاً للاتفاق ده أو بناءً عليه.

armA.definition: Correct in all details; exact and free from error.
armA.arabic: دقيق ومظبوط جدًا، مفيهوش أي غلطة.
examples: The clock is accurate.
Is this information accurate?
Please give an accurate description.
The figures are not completely accurate.
Accurate forecasting is essential for business.
Historians strive for an accurate account of events.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'A cure' 'علاج'.. الدكتور الشاطر لازم تشخيصه يكون 'Accurate' عشان يديك الـ 'Cure' الصح.

armB.definition: Correct in all details; exact and free from error.
armB.arabic: دقيق ومظبوط جدًا، مفيهوش أي غلطة.
examples: The figures are not completely accurate.
Please give an accurate description.
Is this information accurate?
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'A cure' 'علاج'.. الدكتور الشاطر لازم تشخيصه يكون 'Accurate' عشان يديك الـ 'Cure' الصح.

armA.definition: A person who campaigns to bring about political or social change.
armA.arabic: شخص ناشط بيتحرك وبيطالب بحقوق أو تغيير في المجتمع، مش بيسكت على الغلط.
examples: He is a well-known human rights activist.
As an environmental activist, she spoke out against the construction of the new chemical plant.
The local community rallied behind the activist during the public hearing.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Active' 'نشيط'.. هو شخص 'Active' في السياسة والمجتمع.

armB.definition: A person who campaigns to bring about political or social change.
armB.arabic: شخص ناشط بيتحرك وبيطالب بحقوق أو تغيير في المجتمع، مش بيسكت على الغلط.
examples: He is an activist.
She met a peace activist.
Activists marched in the street.
He is a well-known human rights activist.
Environmental activists protested against the new factory.
The government cracked down on political activists.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Active' 'نشيط'.. هو شخص 'Active' في السياسة والمجتمع.

armA.definition: Also; as an extra factor or circumstance.
armA.arabic: بالإضافة لكدة.. بتستخدمها عشان تزود معلومة على الكلام اللي قولته
examples: Additionally, it is cheap.
We need food. Additionally, we need water.
The room is large. Additionally, it has a nice view.
Additionally, the company will provide health insurance.
Members receive a discount; additionally, they get free shipping.
The drug is effective; additionally, it has few side effects.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Addition' 'إضافة'.. يعني بتضيف حاجة تانية للكلام

armB.definition: Also; as an extra factor or circumstance.
armB.arabic: بالإضافة لكدة.. بتستخدمها عشان تزود معلومة على الكلام اللي قولته
examples: Additionally, the company will provide health insurance.
Members receive a discount; additionally, they get free shipping.
The drug is effective; additionally, it has few side effects.
armB.translations: بالإضافة إلى ذلك علاوة على ذلك
armB.mnemonic: من 'Addition' 'إضافة'.. يعني بتضيف حاجة تانية للكلام

armA.definition: To manage and organize the affairs of a company, or to give a medical treatment to a patient.
armA.arabic: يدير أو يعطي. ممكن تيجي بمعنى يدير شغل أو منظمة، وممكن تيجي بمعنى يعطي دواء لمريض.
examples: She helps to administer the school's daily operations.
The nurse was trained to administer first aid in emergencies.
The court has the authority to administer justice in this region.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Admin'.. الـ 'Admin' هو اللي بيعمل 'Administer' 'بيدير' الجروب أو الشغل.

armB.definition: To manage and organize the affairs of a company or to give a treatment to a patient.
armB.arabic: يدير أو يعطي. ممكن تيجي بمعنى يدير شغل أو منظمة، وممكن تيجي بمعنى يعطي دواء لمريض.
examples: He administers the group.
The doctor administers the medicine.
She helps to administer the school's daily operations.
The fund is administered by a professional bank.
The nurse was trained to administer first aid in emergencies.
The court has the authority to administer justice in this region.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Admin'.. الـ 'Admin' هو اللي بيعمل 'Administer' 'بيدير' الجروب أو الشغل.

armA.definition: Far on in progress or development; modern and complex.
armA.arabic: متقدم أو متطور جدًا، سواء في المستوى أو التكنولوجيا.
examples: This is an advanced class.
We use advanced technology.
His English is at an advanced level.
The cancer was in an advanced stage.
She has advanced views on education.
The civilization was highly advanced for its time.
armA.mnemonic: جاي من 'Advance' 'يتقدم'.. 'Advanced' يعني وصل لمرحلة متقدمة.

armB.definition: Far on in progress or development; modern and complex.
armB.arabic: متقدم أو متطور جدًا، سواء في المستوى أو التكنولوجيا.
examples: This is an advanced class.
We use advanced technology.
His English is at an advanced level.
armB.mnemonic: جاي من 'Advance' 'يتقدم'.. 'Advanced' يعني وصل لمرحلة متقدمة.

armA.definition: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings and engines that carries passengers or goods through the air.
armA.arabic: وسيلة المواصلات اللي بتطير في الجو وبتنقل الناس لبلاد بعيدة.
examples: We traveled by aeroplane.
The aeroplane took off on time.
The invention of the aeroplane changed the world.
armA.mnemonic: مقطع 'Aero' يعني 'جو' و 'Plane' طيارة.. الـ 'Aeroplane' هي الطيارة اللي بتطير في الجو.

armB.definition: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings and a weight greater than that of the air it displaces.
armB.arabic: وسيلة المواصلات اللي بتطير في الجو وبتنقل الناس لبلاد بعيدة.
examples: The aeroplane is big.
We traveled by aeroplane.
The aeroplane took off on time.
He built a model aeroplane.
The invention of the aeroplane changed the world.
Aeroplane dynamics are complex to master.
armB.mnemonic: مقطع 'Aero' يعني 'جو' و 'Plane' طيارة.. الـ 'Aeroplane' هي الطيارة اللي بتطير في الجو.

armA.definition: The number of years that a person has lived.
armA.arabic: عدد السنين اللي الشخص عاشها من يوم ما اتولد.
examples: What is your age?
She is the same age as me.
He left home at the age of eighteen.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Age' شبه كلمة 'Edge' 'حافة'.. كل ما الـ 'Age' بيزيد، بنقرب من الـ 'Edge' 'نهاية الطريق'.

armB.definition: The number of years that a person has lived.
armB.arabic: عدد السنين اللي الشخص عاشها من يوم ما اتولد.
examples: What is your age?
She is the same age as me.
Retirement age is usually sixty-five.
He left home at the age of eighteen.
We live in a digital age.
Her face showed the signs of advancing age.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Age' شبه كلمة 'Edge' 'حافة'.. كل ما الـ 'Age' بيزيد، بنقرب من الـ 'Edge' 'نهاية الطريق'.

armA.definition: Engaging in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid rather than a professional basis.
armA.arabic: صفة تُطلق على من يمارس نشاطاً أو رياضة كهواية دون تقاضي أجر، أو على عمل يفتقر إلى الاحترافية.
examples: He is an amateur photographer.
The competition is open to amateur cooks.
The play was performed by an amateur dramatic society.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Pro'.. الـ 'Amateur' هو الهاوي اللي لسه بيتعلم ومش بياخد فلوس.

armB.definition: Engaging in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid rather than a professional basis.
armB.arabic: شخص بيعمل حاجة هواية ومش واخدها شغلانة، أو شغله مش احترافي.
examples: It was an amateur game.
He is an amateur photographer.
The competition is open to amateur cooks.
The play was performed by an amateur dramatic society.
His attempt to fix the sink was very amateur.
Despite being an amateur, his knowledge of astronomy rivaled that of professionals.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Pro'.. الـ 'Amateur' هو الهاوي اللي لسه بيتعلم ومش بياخد فلوس.

armA.definition: Causing laughter and providing entertainment.
armA.arabic: مُسلي أو دمه خفيف.. حاجة بتضحكك أو بتبسطك
examples: The cat is amusing.
It is an amusing book.
He told us an amusing story about his trip.
I didn't find his jokes very amusing.
She has an amusing way of describing people.
The play provides an amusing commentary on modern politics.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Amusement Park' 'مدينة الملاهي'.. المكان اللي كله حاجات 'Amusing' ومسلية

armB.definition: Causing laughter and providing entertainment.
armB.arabic: مُسلي أو دمه خفيف.. حاجة بتضحكك أو بتبسطك
examples: He told us an amusing story about his trip.
I didn't find his jokes very amusing.
She has an amusing way of describing people.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Amusement Park' 'مدينة الملاهي'.. المكان اللي كله حاجات 'Amusing' ومسلية

armA.definition: Belonging to the very distant past.
armA.arabic: حاجة قديمة جداً من زمن فات وانتهى، زي الآثار والحضارات القديمة.
examples: This is an ancient building.
They visited ancient ruins.
Ancient Egypt is famous for pyramids.
It is an ancient custom in this village.
He studies ancient Greek philosophy.
The ancient mariner told his tale.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Ant' 'نملة'.. النمل موجود من عصور 'Ancient' جداً.

armB.definition: Belonging to the very distant past.
armB.arabic: حاجة قديمة جداً من زمن فات وانتهى، زي الآثار والحضارات القديمة.
examples: This is an ancient building.
They visited ancient ruins.
It is an ancient custom in this village.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Ant' 'نملة'.. النمل موجود من عصور 'Ancient' جداً.

armA.definition: Any person at all; used in questions and negative sentences.
armA.arabic: أي شخص مهما كان، بتستخدم عادة في الأسئلة والنفي زي 'محدش جه' أو 'هل فيه حد هنا؟'.
examples: Can anyone help me?
I don't know anyone here.
If anyone calls, take a message.
Has anyone seen my keys?
It was a feat that anyone would be proud of.
He is more qualified than anyone to lead the team.
armA.mnemonic: 'Any' 'أي' + 'One' 'واحد'.. يعني أي واحد.

armB.definition: Any person at all; used in questions and negative sentences.
armB.arabic: أي شخص مهما كان، بتستخدم عادة في الأسئلة والنفي زي 'محدش جه' أو 'هل فيه حد هنا؟'.
examples: Can anyone help me?
I don't know anyone here.
Has anyone seen my keys?
armB.mnemonic: 'Any' 'أي' + 'One' 'واحد'.. يعني أي واحد.

armA.definition: Decided on beforehand (such as a time or place); equipped or furnished; or chosen for a position.
armA.arabic: تأتي بمعنى مُحَدَّد مسبقًا (مثل: appointed time)، أو مُجَهَّز ومفروش (مثل: well-appointed room)، أو مُعَيَّن في وظيفة أو منصب.
examples: He arrived at the appointed time.
She is the newly appointed manager.
We stayed in a luxuriously appointed suite at the hotel.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Appointment' يعني موعد.. لما حاجة تكون 'Appointed' يعني تم تحديدها أو تعيينها.

armB.definition: Decided on beforehand; or equipped/furnished (of a room).
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما شخص تم تعيينه في وظيفة، يا إما مكان مجهز ومفروش بشكل معين 'زي غرفة فندق'.
examples: He arrived at the appointed time.
She is the newly appointed manager.
Guests must meet in the lobby at the appointed hour.
The committee members were appointed by the president.
We stayed in a luxuriously appointed suite at the hotel.
The strictly appointed hierarchy of the organization stifled creativity.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Appointment' يعني موعد.. لما حاجة تكون 'Appointed' يعني تم تحديدها أو تعيينها.

armA.definition: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place.
armA.arabic: ميعاد محدد أو اتفاق إنك تقابل حد في وقت ومكان معينين، زي ميعاد الدكتور أو الشغل.
examples: I made an appointment to see the doctor.
She called the clinic to cancel her appointment.
Do you have an appointment with the manager today?
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Point' 'نقطة'.. الـ 'Appointment' هو تحديد 'Point' معينة في الزمن عشان تتقابلوا فيها.

armB.definition: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place.
armB.arabic: ميعاد محدد أو اتفاق إنك تقابل حد في وقت ومكان معينين، زي ميعاد الدكتور أو الشغل.
examples: I have an appointment.
She has a dentist appointment.
I made an appointment to see the doctor.
His appointment as chairman was unexpected.
The appointment of the new judges caused controversy.
He keeps his appointments with punctuality and precision.
armB.mnemonic: فيها 'Point' 'نقطة'.. الـ 'Appointment' هو تحديد 'Point' معينة في الزمن عشان تتقابلوا فيها.

armA.definition: Close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.
armA.arabic: يعني مش الرقم بالظبط، بس قريب منه جدًا، زي لما تقول 'حوالي' كذا أو تقديري.
examples: Can you give me the approximate cost?
The approximate distance is five miles.
These figures are only approximate and may change.
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Proxy' يعني وكيل.. والبديل بيكون 'Approximate' للأصل بس مش هو بالضبط.

armB.definition: Close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.
armB.arabic: يعني مش الرقم بالظبط، بس قريب منه جدًا، زي لما تقول 'حوالي' كذا.
examples: The time is approximate.
Can you give me the approximate cost?
The approximate distance is five miles.
These figures are only approximate and may change.
The colors in the photo only approximate the real painting.
His political views approximate those of the social democrats.
armB.mnemonic: فيها 'Proxy' يعني وكيل.. والبديل بيكون 'Approximate' للأصل بس مش هو بالضبط.

armA.definition: A chief bishop responsible for an archdiocese.
armA.arabic: رتبة دينية كبيرة في المسيحية، بيكون رئيس الأساقفة.
examples: The archbishop prayed.
We saw the archbishop at the church.
The Archbishop of Canterbury is a famous figure.
He was appointed as the new archbishop.
The archbishop delivered a sermon on peace.
Ecclesiastical laws are interpreted by the archbishop.
armA.mnemonic: 'Arch' يعني رئيسي 'زي Arch-enemy' + 'Bishop' أسقف.. يبقى 'رئيس الأساقفة'.

armB.definition: A chief bishop responsible for an archdiocese.
armB.arabic: رتبة دينية كبيرة في المسيحية، بيكون رئيس الأساقفة.
examples: He was appointed as the new archbishop after years of service to the church.
The archbishop delivered a sermon on peace to the gathered congregation.
Local church leaders met with the archbishop to discuss community issues.
armB.mnemonic: 'Arch' يعني رئيسي 'زي Arch-enemy' + 'Bishop' أسقف.. يبقى 'رئيس الأساقفة'.

armA.definition: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
armA.arabic: شخص فصيح، بيعرف يعبر عن أفكاره بوضوح ولباقة.
examples: She is very articulate for her age.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
The lawyer presented a highly articulate defense of his client.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Article' 'مقال'.. الشخص الـ 'Articulate' بيتكلم بوضوح وترتيب كأنه بيقرا 'Article' مكتوب ببراعة.

armB.definition: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
armB.arabic: شخص فصيح، بيعرف يعبر عن أفكاره بوضوح ولباقة.
examples: He speaks clearly.
She is very articulate for her age.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
He is an intelligent and articulate speaker.
She was unusually articulate about her feelings.
The lawyer presented a highly articulate defense of his client.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Article' 'مقال'.. الشخص الـ 'Articulate' بيتكلم بوضوح وترتيب كأنه بيقرا 'Article' مكتوب ببراعة.

armA.definition: Used to ask people to listen to important information or an order.
armA.arabic: كلمة بتتقال بصوت عالي عشان الناس تسكت وتركز، زي 'انتباه!'.
examples: Attention please!
Attention! The store is closing in five minutes.
Ladies and gentlemen, may I have your attention?
Attention all passengers, the train is delayed.
Attention to detail is critical in this job.
Attention! Company, halt!
armA.mnemonic: زي لما الضابط يقول للعساكر 'Attention' 'انتباه' عشان يوقفوا ثابت.

armB.definition: Used to ask people to listen to important information or an order.
armB.arabic: كلمة بتتقال بصوت عالي عشان الناس تسكت وتركز، زي 'انتباه!'.
examples: Attention please! The museum is closing in ten minutes.
Attention! The store is closing in five minutes.
Attention all passengers, the train is delayed.
armB.mnemonic: زي لما الضابط يقول للعساكر 'Attention' 'انتباه' عشان يوقفوا ثابت.

armA.definition: The quality of being pleasing, appealing, or beautiful.
armA.arabic: الجاذبية والجمال.. إن الحاجة تكون حلوة وتشد الناس ليها.
examples: Her attractiveness is clear.
The garden adds to the house's attractiveness.
The low price increased the attractiveness of the deal.
Physical attractiveness is not everything.
The attractiveness of the investment lies in its low risk.
Studies show a bias toward physical attractiveness in hiring.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Attract' 'يجذب'.. قدرة الشخص أو الشيء إنه يشدك ليه.

armB.definition: The quality of being pleasing, appealing, or beautiful.
armB.arabic: الجاذبية والجمال.. إن الحاجة تكون حلوة وتشد الناس ليها.
examples: The low price increased the attractiveness of the deal.
The attractiveness of the investment lies in its low risk.
Studies show a bias toward physical attractiveness in hiring.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Attract' 'يجذب'.. قدرة الشخص أو الشيء إنه يشدك ليه.

armA.definition: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.
armA.arabic: أخت الأب 'عمة' أو أخت الأم 'خالة'، أو مرات عمك أو خالك.
examples: My aunt lives in London.
I visited my aunt yesterday.
My aunt and uncle are coming for dinner.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Aunt' قريبة من 'أنتِ'.. هي زي أمك الثانية وبنقولها يا 'طنط'.

armB.definition: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.
armB.arabic: أخت الأب 'عمة' أو أخت الأم 'خالة'، أو مرات عمك أو خالك.
examples: My aunt lives in London.
I visited my aunt yesterday.
My aunt and uncle are coming for dinner.
She is a favorite aunt to her nieces.
He inherited the estate from a wealthy maiden aunt.
She played the role of the agony aunt for the community.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Aunt' قريبة من 'أنتِ'.. هي زي أمك الثانية وبنقولها يا 'طنط'.

armA.definition: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.
armA.arabic: إنك تكون عارف وفاهم إيه اللي بيحصل حواليك، أو عندك علم بموضوع معين.
examples: The campaign aims to raise awareness of pollution.
There is a growing awareness of environmental issues.
He has no awareness of the danger.
armA.mnemonic: لما تكون 'Aware' يعني صاحي وواخد بالك.. فالـ 'Awareness' هي الوعي والانتباه.

armB.definition: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.
armB.arabic: إنك تكون عارف وفاهم إيه اللي بيحصل حواليك، أو عندك علم بموضوع معين.
examples: He has no awareness of the danger.
We need more awareness about health.
The campaign aims to raise awareness of pollution.
There is a growing awareness of environmental issues.
Her acute awareness of social dynamics helped her succeed.
The meditation retreat focused on cultivating pure awareness.
armB.mnemonic: لما تكون 'Aware' يعني صاحي وواخد بالك.. فالـ 'Awareness' هي الوعي والانتباه.

armA.definition: Of the lowest pitch or range in music.
armA.arabic: صفة للصوت العميق والواطي جداً 'الجهير' في الموسيقى.
examples: He plays the bass guitar.
I like the bass sound.
The bass notes are very low.
She sings in the bass clef.
The song features a heavy bass line.
The woofer is designed to reproduce bass frequencies.
armA.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Base' 'قاعدة'.. لأن صوت الـ 'Bass' هو الأساس والقاعدة بتاعة الموسيقى.

armB.definition: Of the lowest pitch or range in music.
armB.arabic: صفة للصوت العميق والواطي جداً 'الجهير' في الموسيقى.
examples: The song features a heavy bass line.
The bass notes are very low.
The woofer is designed to reproduce bass frequencies.
armB.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Base' 'قاعدة'.. لأن صوت الـ 'Bass' هو الأساس والقاعدة بتاعة الموسيقى.

armA.definition: To begin to be something; to turn into something.
armA.arabic: يعني تتحول لحاجة تانية أو تبدأ تكون في حالة جديدة.
examples: He wants to become a doctor.
It has become very cold.
They became good friends.
The situation has become complicated.
It does not become you to speak like that.
He became increasingly disillusioned with politics.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Become' فيها 'Be' 'يكون' و 'Come' 'ييجي'.. يعني لما الحالة 'Come' وتخليك 'Be' حاجة تانية، يبقى إنت 'Become' 'أصبحت'.

armB.definition: To begin to be something; to turn into something.
armB.arabic: يعني تتحول لحاجة تانية أو تبدأ تكون في حالة جديدة.
examples: He wants to become a doctor.
People often become nervous before an exam.
Leaves become yellow in autumn.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Become' فيها 'Be' 'يكون' و 'Come' 'ييجي'.. يعني لما الحالة 'Come' وتخليك 'Be' حاجة تانية، يبقى إنت 'Become' 'أصبحت'.

armA.definition: Existence, or a living creature (especially a person).
armA.arabic: كلمة ليها معنيين: يا إما الكائن نفسه زي 'Human being'، يا إما الوجود نفسه والكيان الداخلي للشخص.
examples: A human being needs water to survive.
The organization came into being last year.
She felt it with every fiber of her being.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من الفعل 'Be' 'يكون'.. الـ 'Being' هو الكينونة أو الكائن نفسه اللي 'موجود'.

armB.definition: Existence, or a living creature (especially a person).
armB.arabic: كلمة ليها معنيين: يا إما الكائن نفسه زي 'Human being'، يا إما الوجود نفسه والكيان الداخلي للشخص.
examples: A human being needs water to survive.
We are all human beings.
Strange beings from another planet landed here.
The organization came into being last year.
She felt it with every fiber of her being.
Philosophers have debated the nature of being for centuries.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من الفعل 'Be' 'يكون'.. الـ 'Being' هو الكينونة أو الكائن نفسه اللي 'موجود'.

armA.definition: To think that something is true, correct, or real.
armA.arabic: إنك تكون متأكد إن حاجة حقيقية أو تصدق كلام حد من غير دليل ملموس.
examples: I believe you.
She believes in ghosts.
I believe that he is a good man.
Experts believe the economy will improve soon.
It is widely believed that the painting is a fake.
I couldn't believe my ears when I heard the news.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Be' و 'Live'.. عشان تصدق مبدأ لازم تعيشه 'Live' ويكون 'Be' حقيقي في حياتك.

armB.definition: To think that something is true, correct, or real.
armB.arabic: أن تصدّق شخصًا أو تعتقد أن شيئًا ما حقيقي أو صحيح.
examples: I believe you.
I believe that he is a good man.
Experts believe the economy will improve soon.
armB.mnemonic: تذكّر الكلمة من طريقة كتابتها: في وسط be-LIE-ve توجد كلمة lie (كذبة)؛ فالتصديق (believe) هو ألا تنخدع بالكذبة (lie).

armA.definition: In addition; furthermore; used to introduce an additional point or reason.
armA.arabic: بمعنى بالإضافة لكدة أو غير كدة، وتُستخدم لإضافة معلومة جديدة أو سبب آخر.
examples: I don't want to go to the party; besides, I am too tired.
The coat is far too expensive, and besides, it is not my style.
We cannot afford a vacation this year, and besides, there is too much work to do.
armA.translations: بالإضافة إلى ذلك علاوة على ذلك فضلاً عن ذلك
armA.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'Beside' 'بجانب' وحطينا لها 's' الجمع.. يعني بتحط حاجات كتير 'بجانب' بعضها.. يبقى بالإضافة لذلك.

armB.definition: In addition to; also; apart from.
armB.arabic: بمعنى بالإضافة لكدة، أو غير كدة. بنستخدمها لما نزود معلومة أو سبب تاني.
examples: Who is here besides you?
I don't want to go; besides, I am tired.
Besides milk, we need to buy bread.
It's too late to go out now. Besides, it's starting to rain.
He has many other interests besides his work.
Besides being a talented musician, she is also a published author.
armB.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'Beside' 'بجانب' وحطينا لها 's' الجمع.. يعني بتحط حاجات كتير 'بجانب' بعضها.. يبقى بالإضافة لذلك.

armA.definition: The cardinal number one thousand million (1,000,000,000).
armA.arabic: رقم المليار (ألف مليون).
examples: China has over one billion people.
Three billion years ago, life began.
The cost is estimated at several billion euros.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bill' يعني فاتورة.. تخيل فاتورة بـ 'Billion' دولار

armB.definition: The cardinal number one thousand million.
armB.arabic: رقم المليار.
examples: China has over one billion people.
That company is worth two billion.
Three billion years ago, life began.
They sold five billion units.
The cost is estimated at several billion euros.
We are looking at a timescale of a billion years.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bill' يعني فاتورة.. تخيل فاتورة بـ 'Billion' دولار

armA.definition: Very strange and unusual, often in a surprising way.
armA.arabic: حاجة غريبة جداً وغير مألوفة، بتخليك تستغرب لما تشوفها لأنها مش طبيعية.
examples: He wore a bizarre costume to the party.
The movie had a bizarre ending.
His behavior became increasingly bizarre and unpredictable.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bizarre' بتفكرنا بـ 'Bazaar' 'سوق'.. والسوق بيبقى فيه حاجات 'غريبة' وعجيبة.

armB.definition: Very strange and unusual, often in a surprising way.
armB.arabic: حاجة غريبة جداً وغير مألوفة، بتخليك تستغرب لما تشوفها لأنها مش طبيعية.
examples: That is a bizarre hat.
He wore a bizarre costume to the party.
It was a bizarre situation.
The movie had a bizarre ending.
She witnessed a bizarre sequence of events.
His behavior became increasingly bizarre and unpredictable.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bizarre' بتفكرنا بـ 'Bazaar' 'سوق'.. والسوق بيبقى فيه حاجات 'غريبة' وعجيبة.

armA.definition: Cold and miserable; without hope or encouragement (for situations or weather).
armA.arabic: وصف للمكان البارد الكئيب اللي مفيهوش حياة، أو للمستقبل اللي مفيهوش أمل.
examples: The winter weather was cold and bleak.
The company faces a bleak future if sales don't improve.
The report paints a bleak picture of the economy.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Block'.. لما الدنيا تكون مسدودة 'Block' قدامك، المستقبل بيبقى 'Bleak' وكئيب.

armB.definition: Cold and miserable; without hope or encouragement (for situations or weather).
armB.arabic: وصف للمكان البارد الكئيب اللي مفيهوش حياة، أو للمستقبل اللي مفيهوش أمل.
examples: The winter weather was cold and bleak.
The room looked bleak with no furniture.
It was a bleak day with heavy rain.
The company faces a bleak future if sales don't improve.
The report paints a bleak picture of the economy.
In the bleak midwinter, the wind moaned through the trees.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Block'.. لما الدنيا تكون مسدودة 'Block' قدامك، المستقبل بيبقى 'Bleak' وكئيب.

armA.definition: A hard hit with a hand or weapon, or an unexpected event that causes shock and misfortune.
armA.arabic: خبطة قوية بالإيد أو بأداة، وممكن تيجي بمعنى مصيبة أو صدمة مفاجئة.
examples: It was a heavy blow to his head.
Losing his job was a severe blow.
The news dealt a crushing blow to their hopes.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر لما 'Blue' 'أزرق'.. لما تاخد 'Blow' قوية جسمك بيزرق.

armB.definition: A hard hit with a hand or a weapon.
armB.arabic: خبطة قوية بالإيد أو بأداة، وممكن تيجي بمعنى مصيبة أو صدمة مفاجئة.
examples: He gave the door a blow.
It was a heavy blow to his head.
Losing his job was a severe blow.
They exchanged blows in the street.
The news dealt a crushing blow to their hopes.
She softened the blow by telling him gently.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر لما 'Blue' 'أزرق'.. لما تاخد 'Blow' قوية جسمك بيزرق.

armA.definition: A line separating two countries or areas.
armA.arabic: الخط الفاصل بين بلدين أو منطقتين، أو الحافة اللي بتبقى حوالين شيء معين.
examples: We live near the border.
They crossed the border by car.
You need a passport to cross the border.
The border between the two countries is closed.
There is tension along the northern border.
The refugee crisis at the border has escalated significantly.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Board' 'لوحة'.. زمان كانوا بيحطوا ألواح خشب عشان يعلموا الـ 'Border'.

armB.definition: A line separating two countries or areas.
armB.arabic: الخط الفاصل بين بلدين أو منطقتين، أو الحافة الخارجية لشيء معين.
examples: We live near the border.
You need a passport to cross the border.
The border between the two countries is closed.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة board (لوح خشب)؛ تخيل لوح خشب موضوع كحاجز فاصل على الـ border (الحدود).

armA.definition: In the lowest position; lowest.
armA.arabic: صفة للحاجة اللي تحت خالص، في أقل مستوى.
examples: Look at the bottom shelf.
Write your name on the bottom line.
The bottom drawer is stuck.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bottom' شبه 'بطن'.. والبطن تحت الصدر، يعني في الجزء الأسفل.

armB.definition: In the lowest position; lowest.
armB.arabic: صفة للحاجة اللي تحت خالص، في أقل مستوى.
examples: Look at the bottom shelf.
Write your name on the bottom line.
The bottom drawer is stuck.
He paid the bottom price for the car.
The bottom rung of the ladder was broken.
They reached the bottom depths of the ocean.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bottom' شبه 'بطن'.. والبطن تحت الصدر، يعني في الجزء الأسفل.

armA.definition: A specific type of animal or plant within a species, or a particular kind of person or thing.
armA.arabic: سُلالة معينة من الحيوانات تميزها صفات مشتركة، أو نوع وطراز خاص من الأشخاص.
examples: What breed is your dog?
Farmers choose the best breed for milk production.
He represents a dying breed of old-school journalists.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Brother'.. الـ 'Breed' هم الأخوة من نفس الفصيلة والنوع.

armB.definition: A specific type of animal or plant within a species.
armB.arabic: نوع معين أو فصيلة من الحيوانات، زي أنواع الكلاب أو القطط المختلفة.
examples: What breed is your dog?
This is a rare breed of cat.
Farmers choose the best breed for milk production.
German Shepherds are a popular breed for police work.
He represents a dying breed of old-school journalists.
The sheer diversity within the canine breed is genetically fascinating.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Brother'.. الـ 'Breed' هم الأخوة من نفس الفصيلة والنوع.

armA.definition: A round open container with a handle, used for carrying liquids.
armA.arabic: الجردل اللي بنملاه مية ونشيله من الإيد بتاعته.
examples: Fill the bucket with water.
We need a bucket and sponge to wash the car.
He carried a heavy bucket of sand.
The rain came down in buckets.
They are just a drop in the bucket compared to what we need.
The data is sorted into different storage buckets.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bucket' شبه 'Pocket'.. بس الـ 'Bucket' بنشيل فيه ميه مش فلوس.

armB.definition: A round open container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.
armB.arabic: الجردل اللي بنملاه مية ونشيله من الإيد بتاعته (الدلو).
examples: Fill the bucket with water.
We need a bucket and sponge to wash the car.
He carried a heavy bucket of sand.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bucket' شبه 'Pocket'.. بس الـ 'Bucket' بنشيل فيه ميه مش فلوس.

armA.definition: An estimate of income and expenditure for a set period of time.
armA.arabic: الميزانية، يعني الخطة اللي بتحطها لفلوسك، هتقبض كام وهتصرف كام في وقت معين.
examples: We need to stick to our monthly budget.
The government announced the new annual budget.
The project was completed within budget.
armA.mnemonic: زمان كانوا بيحطوا الفلوس في 'Bag' شنطة.. كلمة 'Budget' جاية من أصل الكلمة دي.

armB.definition: An estimate of income and expenditure for a set period of time.
armB.arabic: الميزانية، يعني الخطة اللي بتحطها لفلوسك، هتقبض كام وهتصرف كام في وقت معين.
examples: I have a small budget.
The holiday was over budget.
We need to stick to our monthly budget.
The government announced the new annual budget.
They are operating on a shoestring budget.
Budget constraints forced them to cancel the project.
armB.mnemonic: زمان كانوا بيحطوا الفلوس في 'Bag' شنطة.. كلمة 'Budget' جاية من أصل الكلمة دي.

armA.definition: Except; apart from.
armA.arabic: بتيجي بمعنى 'إلا' أو 'باستثناء'. زي لما تقول 'كلهم مشيوا ما عدا هو'.
examples: Everyone but Tom was there.
I have nothing left but hope.
There is no one here but me.

armB.definition: Except; apart from.
armB.arabic: بتيجي بمعنى 'إلا' أو 'باستثناء'. زي لما تقول 'كلهم مشيوا ما عدا هو'.
examples: Everyone but Tom was there.
I have nothing left but hope.
There is no one here but me.
The last but one.
Anything but that.
They had no alternative but to surrender.

armA.definition: A soft yellow fat obtained from milk, used in cooking and on bread.
armA.arabic: الزبدة الصفرا اللي بنعملها من اللبن وبنحطها على العيش أو نطبخ بيها.
examples: I like bread and butter.
She put some butter on the toast.
Fry the onions in a little butter.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Butter' شبه 'Better'.. عشان الأكل بيبقى طعمه 'Better' لما نحط عليه 'Butter'.

armB.definition: A soft yellow fat obtained from milk, used in cooking and on bread.
armB.arabic: الزبدة الصفرا اللي بنعملها من اللبن وبنحطها على العيش أو نطبخ بيها.
examples: I like bread and butter.
She put some butter on the toast.
You need butter to bake a cake.
Fry the onions in a little butter.
The recipe calls for clarified butter.
He really knows which side his bread is buttered on.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Butter' شبه 'Better'.. عشان الأكل بيبقى طعمه 'Better' لما نحط عليه 'Butter'.

armA.definition: To contact someone by phone or shout to them.
armA.arabic: يتصل بحد في التليفون أو ينادي عليه بصوت عالي. وممكن تيجي بمعنى يسمي.
examples: Please call me tomorrow.
I will call a taxi for you.
They call him 'Big Joe'.

armB.definition: To contact someone by phone or shout to them.
armB.arabic: يتصل بحد في التليفون أو ينادي عليه بصوت عالي. وممكن تيجي بمعنى يسمي.
examples: Please call me tomorrow.
They call him 'Big Joe'.
I will call a taxi for you.
The meeting was called to order.
I call into question his honesty.
The situation calls for immediate action.

armA.definition: To be able to or permitted to do something.
armA.arabic: فعل ناقص يُستخدم للتعبير عن القدرة والاستطاعة أو الإذن، بمعنى يقدر أو يستطيع.
examples: I can swim.
You can park here.
She can speak two languages.

armB.definition: To be able to or permitted to do something.
armB.arabic: بمعنى 'يقدر' أو 'يستطيع' يعمل حاجة.
examples: I can swim.
Can you help me?
You can park here.
Can it be true?
I can't help thinking about it.
One can hardly imagine the difficulty.

armA.definition: The negative form of can; to be unable to do something or not permitted to do something.
armA.arabic: صيغة النفي من الفعل (can)؛ تعني «لا يستطيع» أو «غير قادر على»، وتُكتب ككلمة واحدة وتُعد أكثر رسمية من (can't).
examples: I cannot swim.
She cannot come to the party.
We cannot afford a new car right now.
armA.translations: لا يستطيع لا يمكنه غير قادر على
armA.mnemonic: هي كلمتين لازقين في بعض: 'Can' و 'Not'.. يعني 'أقدر' + 'لأ'.

armB.definition: The negative form of can; to be unable to do something.
armB.arabic: يعني مش قادر أعمل الحاجة دي. هي هي Can't بس رسمية أكتر.
examples: I cannot swim.
She cannot come to the party.
We cannot afford a new car right now.
You cannot ignore the rules.
One cannot simply walk away from responsibility.
The complexity of the universe cannot be overstated.
armB.mnemonic: هي كلمتين لازقين في بعض: 'Can' و 'Not'.. يعني 'أقدر' + 'لأ'.

armA.definition: A small rectangular piece of stiff paper or plastic used for various purposes.
armA.arabic: قطعة ورق مقوى أو بلاستيك، زي كارت البنك، أو كروت اللعب، أو كارت المعايدة.
examples: Can I pay by credit card?
I sent a birthday card to my mom.
Pick a card from the deck.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Cart' 'عربية تسوق'.. عشان تشتري بالـ 'Cart' محتاج 'Card' تدفع بيه.

armB.definition: A small rectangular piece of stiff paper or plastic used for various purposes.
armB.arabic: قطعة ورق مقوى أو بلاستيك، زي كارت البنك، أو كروت اللعب، أو كارت المعايدة.
examples: I sent a birthday card to my mom.
Can I pay by credit card?
He showed his ID card to the guard.
Pick a card from the deck.
She played her cards right to get the promotion.
The organization holds all the cards in this negotiation.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Cart' 'عربية تسوق'.. عشان تشتري بالـ 'Cart' محتاج 'Card' تدفع بيه.

armA.definition: Goods carried on a ship, aircraft, or motor vehicle.
armA.arabic: البضاعة التقيلة اللي بتتنقل بالسفن أو الطيارات أو العربيات الكبيرة.
examples: They loaded the cargo onto the truck.
Customs officials inspected the cargo for illegal items.
The jettisoning of cargo was necessary to save the sinking vessel.
armA.mnemonic: 'Car' + 'Go'.. البضاعة اللي بنحطها في الـ 'Car' عشان الـ 'Go' 'السفر'.

armB.definition: Goods carried on a ship, aircraft, or motor vehicle.
armB.arabic: البضاعة التقيلة اللي بتتنقل بالسفن أو الطيارات أو العربيات الكبيرة.
examples: The ship has cargo.
They loaded the cargo onto the truck.
The plane is carrying a precious cargo.
The cargo ship arrived at the port late.
Customs officials inspected the cargo for illegal items.
The jettisoning of cargo was necessary to save the sinking vessel.
armB.mnemonic: 'Car' + 'Go'.. البضاعة اللي بنحطها في الـ 'Car' عشان الـ 'Go' 'السفر'.

armA.definition: Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
armA.arabic: حذر جداً وبياخد باله عشان مايغلطش أو يتأذي.
examples: He is a cautious driver.
They adopted a cautious approach to the problem.
Investors remain cautious despite the market rally.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Caution' (تحذير).. خليك 'Cautious' عشان متقعش.

armB.definition: Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
armB.arabic: حذر جداً وبياخد باله عشان مايغلطش أو يتأذي.
examples: Be cautious.
He is a cautious driver.
She was cautious about spending money.
The doctor gave a cautious prognosis.
They adopted a cautious approach to the problem.
Investors remain cautious despite the market rally.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Caution' 'تحذير'.. خليك 'Cautious' عشان متقعش.

armA.definition: A television station, or a path through which water or information flows.
armA.arabic: محطة تلفزيون، أو مسار بتمشي فيه الماية، أو حتى طريقة لتوصيل المعلومات.
examples: What is your favorite TV channel?
We need an open channel of communication.
The water flows through a narrow channel.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Channel' في التلفزيون.. هي مَسار بتوصلك منه المَعلومة.

armB.definition: A television station, or a path through which water or information flows.
armB.arabic: محطة تلفزيون، أو مسار بتمشي فيه الماية، أو حتى طريقة لتوصيل المعلومات.
examples: What is your favorite TV channel?
Change the channel, please.
We need an open channel of communication.
The water flows through a narrow channel.
They directed the funds through official government channels.
The English Channel has historically served as a formidable defensive barrier.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Channel' في التلفزيون.. هي مَسار بتوصلك منه المَعلومة.

armA.definition: To talk in a friendly and informal way.
armA.arabic: يدردش أو يتكلم مع شخص بشكل ودي وغير رسمي.
examples: I chat with my friends every day.
She likes to chat on the phone.
We can chat about the project tomorrow.
armA.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'شات'.. بتعمل شات مع صاحبك.

armB.definition: To talk in a friendly and informal way.
armB.arabic: يدردش أو يتكلم مع حد بشكل ودي وبسيط.
examples: I chat with my friends.
She likes to chat on the phone.
We chatted for hours about nothing.
He was chatting up a girl at the bar.
They chatted amiably despite their differences.
We chatted away the afternoon in the garden.
armB.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'شات'.. بتعمل شات مع صاحبك.

armA.definition: To shout for joy or in praise of someone; to comfort or encourage.
armA.arabic: إنك تهتف وتشجع حد بصوت عالي، أو تحاول تبسط حد وتفرحه.
examples: We cheer for our team.
Cheer up! It's not that bad.
The crowd cheered loudly when he scored.
I tried to cheer him up with a joke.
They cheered the soldiers as they marched by.
The unexpected victory cheered the nation immensely.
armA.mnemonic: لما الـ 'Cheerleaders' بيشجعوا الفريق، بيعملوا 'Cheer'.

armB.definition: To shout for joy or in praise of someone; to comfort or encourage.
armB.arabic: إنك تهتف وتشجع حد بصوت عالي، أو تحاول تبسط حد وتفرحه.
examples: We cheer for our team whenever they play at home.
I tried to cheer him up with a joke, but he was still upset.
The crowd began to cheer as the players walked onto the pitch.
armB.mnemonic: لما الـ 'Cheerleaders' بيشجعوا الفريق، بيعملوا 'Cheer'.

armA.definition: A professional cook who leads a kitchen.
armA.arabic: الطباخ المحترف اللي بيكون مسؤول عن المطبخ في المطاعم الكبيرة.
examples: The chef cooks good food.
He wants to be a chef in a hotel.
The head chef manages the kitchen staff.
She trained as a pastry chef in Paris.
The chef's signature dish is exquisite.
He is a celebrated chef known for his molecular gastronomy.
armA.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'Chief' يعني رئيس، بس شيلنا الـ i وبقت 'Chef' رئيس المطبخ

armB.definition: A professional cook who leads a kitchen.
armB.arabic: الطباخ المحترف اللي بيكون مسؤول عن المطبخ في المطاعم الكبيرة.
examples: He wants to be a chef in a hotel.
The head chef manages the kitchen staff.
She trained as a pastry chef in Paris.
armB.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'Chief' يعني رئيس، بس شيلنا الـ i وبقت 'Chef' رئيس المطبخ

armA.definition: The protruding part of the face below the mouth.
armA.arabic: منطقة الدقن اللي في وشك تحت بوقك.
examples: He has a small chin.
She rested her chin on her hand.
He rubbed the stubble on his chin.
Keep your chin up, things will get better.
The boxer took a heavy blow to the chin.
He has a prominent, cleft chin.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Chin' قريبة من 'Cheek'.. الاتنين في الوش.

armB.definition: The protruding part of the face below the mouth.
armB.arabic: منطقة الدقن اللي في وشك تحت بوقك.
examples: She rested her chin on her hand.
He rubbed the stubble on his chin.
The boxer took a heavy blow to the chin.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Chin' قريبة من 'Cheek'.. الاتنين في الوش.

armA.definition: To cut something into pieces with a sharp tool like a knife or axe.
armA.arabic: يقطع أو يفرم. تقطع حاجة حتت صغيرة بالسكينة أو الفاس.
examples: Please chop the onions.
He chopped wood for the fire.
Chop the carrots into small cubes.
They chopped down the old tree in the garden.
The budget was chopped by fifty percent.
The helicopter blades chopped through the heavy air.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل الشيف بيعمل 'Chop chop' بسرعة وهو بيقطع الخضار

armB.definition: To cut something into pieces with a sharp tool like a knife or axe.
armB.arabic: يقطع أو يفرم. تقطع حاجة حتت صغيرة بالسكينة أو الفاس.
examples: Please chop the onions before you start cooking.
Use a sharp axe to chop wood for the fireplace.
They decided to chop down the dying tree behind the house.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل الشيف بيعمل 'Chop chop' بسرعة وهو بيقطع الخضار

armA.definition: The position or status of being a citizen of a particular country.
armA.arabic: الجنسية أو المواطنة.. إنك تكون مواطن قانوني في بلد وليك حقوق وعليك واجبات.
examples: He wants US citizenship.
She applied for citizenship last year.
Dual citizenship allows you to hold two passports.
Schools should teach good citizenship to children.
The refugees were finally granted full citizenship.
Global citizenship implies a responsibility beyond one's own borders.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Citizen' 'مواطن' + 'Ship'.. كأن المواطنين كلهم راكبين 'Ship' 'سفينة' واحدة هي الوطن.

armB.definition: The position or status of being a citizen of a particular country.
armB.arabic: الجنسية أو المواطنة؛ وهي الوضع القانوني للفرد كمواطن في دولة معينة وما يترتب عليه من حقوق وواجبات.
examples: She applied for citizenship last year.
Dual citizenship allows you to hold two passports.
The refugees were finally granted full citizenship.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Citizen' 'مواطن' + 'Ship'.. كأن المواطنين كلهم راكبين 'Ship' 'سفينة' واحدة هي الوطن.

armA.definition: A person who is not in the armed services or the police force.
armA.arabic: الشخص المدني اللي مش عسكري ولا ظابط شرطة.
examples: He is not a soldier, he is a civilian.
As a civilian, she had never received any military training.
Under international law, an unarmed civilian must not be targeted during wartime.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الصفة.. 'Civil' مدني، فالـ 'Civilian' هو المواطن المدني.

armB.definition: A person who is not in the armed services or the police force.
armB.arabic: الشخص المدني اللي مش عسكري ولا ظابط شرطة.
examples: He is not a soldier, he is a civilian.
Civilians were asked to leave the area.
The bomb injured three civilians.
Police officers must protect civilians.
The target was wrongly identified as a military base, but it was full of civilians.
Under the Geneva Convention, the rights of civilians in war zones are paramount.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الصفة.. 'Civil' مدني، فالـ 'Civilian' هو المواطن المدني.

armA.definition: The appearance that something has as a result of reflecting light, such as red, blue, or green.
armA.arabic: اللون، زي الأحمر والأزرق، اللي بنشوفه بعيننا لما الضوء ينعكس على الأشياء.
examples: What is your favourite colour?
The sky is a beautiful blue colour.
The leaves change colour in autumn.

armB.definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects light.
armB.arabic: اللون، زي الأحمر والأزرق، اللي بنشوفه بعيننا لما الضوء ينعكس على الأشياء.
examples: What is your favorite colour?
The sky is a beautiful blue colour.
She added some colour to the drawing.
The leaves change colour in autumn.
The festival was a riot of colour and sound.
His writing lacks colour and imagination.

armA.definition: To join two or more things together.
armA.arabic: إنك تخلط أو تدمج حاجتين أو أكثر مع بعض عشان يبقوا حاجة واحدة.
examples: We can combine our money to buy a better gift.
Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water.
They decided to combine forces to finish the project.
armA.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Combine' بتخلي الحاجات 'Combo' واحد.

armB.definition: To join two or more things together.
armB.arabic: إنك تخلط أو تدمج حاجتين أو أكتر مع بعض عشان يبقوا حاجة واحدة.
examples: Combine milk and eggs.
We can combine our money.
The hotel combines luxury with comfort.
Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water.
They decided to combine forces to defeat the enemy.
His style combines elements of jazz and classical music.
armB.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Combine' بتخلي الحاجات 'Combo' واحد.

armA.definition: To focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity.
armA.arabic: يركز انتباهه كله في حاجة واحدة.
examples: I cannot concentrate.
Please concentrate on your work.
The noise makes it hard to concentrate.
We need to concentrate our efforts on sales.
Power is concentrated in the hands of a few.
He concentrated his mind on the problem at hand.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Centre' 'مركز'.. يعني تخلي تفكيرك كله في 'المركز' ونقطة واحدة.

armB.definition: To focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity.
armB.arabic: يركز انتباهه كله في حاجة واحدة.
examples: I cannot concentrate.
Please concentrate on your work.
The noise makes it hard to concentrate.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Centre' 'مركز'.. يعني تخلي تفكيرك كله في 'المركز' ونقطة واحدة.

armA.definition: Belonging or relating to a national legislative body, especially that of the US.
armA.arabic: خاص أو متعلق بالكونجرس (الهيئة التشريعية الأمريكية) أو بنشاطاته وأعضائه.
examples: She works as an aide in a congressional office.
The congressional committee investigated allegations of corruption.
The new healthcare plan will require congressional approval to pass.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة Congress (الكونجرس)، وإضافة اللاحقة -ional تحولها لصفة معناها: متعلق بالكونجرس.

armB.definition: Belonging or relating to a national legislative body, especially that of the US.
armB.arabic: أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالكونجرس 'البرلمان الأمريكي' أو الهيئات التشريعية.
examples: The congressional vote is today.
She works in a congressional office.
There was a congressional debate on TV.
The congressional committee investigated the issue.
Congressional approval is required for the new budget.
He has extensive experience in congressional lobbying and legislative affairs.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Congress' 'الكونجرس'.. يبقى 'Congressional' يعني حاجة تبع الكونجرس.

armA.definition: To join two or more things together; to link people or things.
armA.arabic: إنك توصل حاجتين ببعض أو تربط بينهم.. زي لما توصل الموبايل بالشاحن أو تربط فكرتين ببعض
examples: I connect my phone to the wifi.
Please connect the printer to the computer.
This train connects London and Paris.
The police tried to connect the two crimes.
It is difficult to connect abstract theories with real life.
The protagonist struggles to connect emotionally with his past.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Connect' قريبة من 'Contact'.. يعني اتصال أو تواصل

armB.definition: To join two or more things together; to link people or things.
armB.arabic: إنك توصل حاجتين ببعض أو تربط بينهم.. زي لما توصل الموبايل بالشاحن أو تربط فكرتين ببعض
examples: Please connect the printer to the computer.
I connect my phone to the wifi.
The police tried to connect the two crimes.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Connect' قريبة من 'Contact'.. يعني اتصال أو تواصل

armA.definition: A voting member of a community; a component part of something.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: الناخب اللي بيصوت في الدايرة الانتخابية، أو عنصر أساسي مكون لشيء.
examples: Parts of a whole. (Simplified)
Voters choose leaders. (Simplified)
Sugar is a constituent of candy.
The MP listened to his constituents.
Oxygen is a constituent of air.
The constituent assembly drafted the new laws.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Constitution' 'دستور'.. الـ 'Constituent' هو اللي بيصوت للدستور أو بيمثله.

armB.definition: A voting member of a community, or a component part of something.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: الناخب اللي بيصوت في الدايرة الانتخابية، أو عنصر أساسي مكون لشيء.
examples: Oxygen is a major constituent of air.
As a constituent, she wrote to her representative about the proposed law.
The chemist tested each constituent of the mixture to determine its purity.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Constitution' 'دستور'.. الـ 'Constituent' هو اللي بيصوت للدستور أو بيمثله.

armA.definition: To have or hold something within.
armA.arabic: يحتوي على، يعني حاجة تكون جوا حاجة تانية، زي الصندوق لما يكون جواه أغراض.
examples: This box contains toys.
Does this food contain nuts?
The letter contained good news.
They tried to contain the spread of the virus.
The document contains sensitive information regarding national security.
She could barely contain her anger when she heard the insult.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Container' 'الحاوية' وظيفتها إنها 'Contain' البضائع جواها.

armB.definition: To have or hold something within.
armB.arabic: يحتوي على، يعني حاجة تكون جوا حاجة تانية، زي الصندوق لما يكون جواه أغراض.
examples: Does this food contain nuts?
These boxes contain old photographs.
They tried to contain the spread of the virus.
armB.translations: يحتوي على يتضمن يشمل يُكبح / يُحجم
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Container' 'الحاوية' وظيفتها إنها 'Contain' البضائع جواها.

armA.definition: Most important or central to something.
armA.arabic: حاجة أساسية أو جوهرية.. مش فرعية.. زي المواد الأساسية في الدراسة
examples: English is a core subject.
We have a core team of five people.
Customer service is a core part of our business.
The company is focusing on its core activities.
Respect is a core value in this community.
The core curriculum omits several key historical events.
armA.mnemonic: زي الاسم بالظبط.. 'Core' يعني الأساس.. فـ 'Core values' يعني القيم الأساسية

armB.definition: Most important or central to something.
armB.arabic: حاجة أساسية أو جوهرية.. مش فرعية.. زي المواد الأساسية في الدراسة
examples: Customer service is a core part of our business.
The company is focusing on its core activities.
Respect is a core value in this community.
armB.mnemonic: تخيّل قلب التفاحة (apple core) الموجود في المنتصف تماماً؛ كصفة، أي شيء core بيكون في قلب وجوهر الموضوع يعني أساسي وجوهري.

armA.definition: Relating to a large company or group.
armA.arabic: أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالشركات الكبيرة والمؤسسات الضخمة.
examples: He works in a corporate office.
They have a new corporate logo.
We attended a corporate event last night.
She wants to climb the corporate ladder.
The company needs to improve its corporate governance.
Corporate social responsibility is vital for modern brands.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Corp'.. أي حاجة 'Corporate' يعني خاصة بالشركات الكبيرة والبيزنس.

armB.definition: Relating to a large company or group.
armB.arabic: أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالشركات الكبيرة والمؤسسات الضخمة.
examples: He works in a corporate office.
We attended a corporate event last night.
She wants to climb the corporate ladder.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Corp'.. أي حاجة 'Corporate' يعني خاصة بالشركات الكبيرة والبيزنس.

armA.definition: In a way that is true or accurate.
armA.arabic: إنك تعمل الحاجة صح من غير غلطات.
examples: Spell your name correctly.
He answered correctly.
If I remember correctly, he was there.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Correct' 'صح'.. يعني عملتها بشكل 'Correct'.

armB.definition: In a way that is true or accurate.
armB.arabic: إنك تعمل الحاجة صح من غير غلطات.
examples: Spell your name correctly.
He answered correctly.
If I remember correctly, he was there.
The machine was not operating correctly.
She correctly predicted the outcome of the election.
The data must be interpreted correctly to be useful.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Correct' 'صح'.. يعني عملتها بشكل 'Correct'.

armA.definition: To have a mutual relationship or connection, or to show that such a connection exists between two or more things.
armA.arabic: يربط بين حاجتين ويشوف العلاقة بينهم، أو إن الحاجتين يكونوا مرتبطين ببعض.
examples: The figures do not correlate with our results.
Researchers tried to correlate the data with the observed trends.
It is difficult to correlate these two disparate sets of statistics.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Co' 'مع' + 'Relate' 'يربط'.. يعني يربط الأشياء مع بعض.

armB.definition: To have a mutual relationship or connection.
armB.arabic: يربط بين حاجتين ويشوف العلاقة بينهم، أو إن الحاجتين يكونوا مرتبطين ببعض.
examples: Smoke correlates with fire.
Hard work correlates with success.
The figures do not correlate with our results.
Researchers tried to correlate the data with the observed trends.
Obesity correlates strongly with heart disease.
It is difficult to correlate these two disparate sets of statistics.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Co' 'مع' + 'Relate' 'يربط'.. يعني يربط الأشياء مع بعض.

armA.definition: A long passage in a building with doors leading into rooms on either side.
armA.arabic: ممر طويل جوا مبنى، بيبقى فيه أبواب بتوصل للأوض على الجنبين، زي اللي في المدارس أو المستشفيات.
examples: The bathroom is down the corridor.
Students waited in the corridor for the class to start.
Her office is at the end of the long corridor.
The hotel corridor was lined with beautiful paintings.
They established a humanitarian corridor to aid the civilians.
The bureaucratic corridor of power can be difficult to navigate.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Corridor' شبه 'Car' 'عربية' و 'Door' 'باب'.. تخيل إنك ماشي بـ 'Car' جوه 'Corridor' طويل مليان 'Doors'.

armB.definition: A long passage in a building with doors leading into rooms on either side.
armB.arabic: ممر طويل داخل مبنى، توجد به أبواب تؤدي إلى غرف على الجانبين، مثل ممرات المدارس أو المستشفيات أو الفنادق.
examples: Her office is at the end of the long corridor.
The hotel corridor was lined with beautiful paintings.
Students waited in the corridor for the class to start.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Corridor' تشبه 'Car' و 'Door'؛ تخيل أنك تقود 'Car' صغيرة داخل 'Corridor' طويل مليء بـ 'Doors' على الجانبين.

armA.definition: The quality of being trusted and believed in.
armA.arabic: المصداقية.. يعني الناس تصدقك وتثق في كلامك.
examples: The scandal damaged the company's credibility.
She built her credibility through years of hard work.
The report lacks scientific credibility.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Credit'.. لما يكون عندك 'Credit' عند الناس يعني بيثقوا فيك وعندك 'Credibility'.

armB.definition: The quality of being trusted and believed in.
armB.arabic: المصداقية.. يعني الناس تصدقك وتثق في كلامك.
examples: He has no credibility.
Lying hurts your credibility.
The scandal damaged the company's credibility.
She built her credibility through years of hard work.
The report lacks scientific credibility.
The witness's credibility was undermined by the cross-examination.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Credit'.. لما يكون عندك 'Credit' عند الناس يعني بيثقوا فيك وعندك 'Credibility'.

armA.definition: Having curves or coils; not straight (usually hair).
armA.arabic: صفة للشعر اللي مش ناعم ومفرود، بيبقى ملفوف على بعضه.
examples: She has curly hair.
My dog has a curly tail.
I wish my hair was curly instead of straight.
The plant has unusual curly leaves.
He has a mop of thick, curly hair.
The antique table featured curly maple wood.
armA.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Curve' منحنى.. الشعر الـ 'Curly' مليان منحنيات ولفات

armB.definition: Having curves or coils; not straight (usually hair).
armB.arabic: صفة للشعر اللي مش ناعم ومفرود، بيبقى ملفوف على بعضه.
examples: She has curly hair.
My dog has a curly tail.
I wish my hair was curly instead of straight.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Curve' منحنى.. الشعر الـ 'Curly' مليان منحنيات ولفات

armA.definition: A soft bag of cloth filled with soft material, used for sitting on or leaning against.
armA.arabic: المخدة الصغيرة اللي بنحطها على الكنبة عشان نسند عليها ضهرنا أو نقعد عليها.
examples: I sit on a cushion.
The sofa has red cushions.
She put a cushion behind her back.
Airbags act as a cushion during a car crash.
Savings can provide a financial cushion against unemployment.
The soft moss acted as a cushion for his fall.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'كوشة' اللي العرسان بيقعدوا فيها على 'Cushion' مريح.

armB.definition: A soft bag of cloth filled with soft material, used for sitting on or leaning against.
armB.arabic: المخدة الصغيرة اللي بنحطها على الكنبة عشان نسند عليها ضهرنا أو نقعد عليها.
examples: She put a cushion behind her back.
The wooden chair is hard, so I need a soft cushion.
Savings can provide a financial cushion against unemployment.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'كوشة' اللي العرسان بيقعدوا فيها على 'Cushion' مريح.

armA.definition: To condemn to eternal punishment; to criticize strongly; to express anger.
armA.arabic: كلمة بتتقال للتعبير عن الغضب الشديد، أو إنك تلعن حاجة وتتمنى لها الشر والخسارة.
examples: Damn! I forgot my keys.
Don't damn him for one mistake.
The critics damned the movie with faint praise.
He was damned by the evidence found in his car.
The policy was damned as a complete failure by the opposition.
Faust was damned to hell for making a pact with the devil.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Dam' 'سد'.. لما الـ 'Dam' اتكسر وغرق الدنيا، الناس قالوا 'Damn!'.

armB.definition: To severely criticize or condemn someone or something; or, in a religious sense, to condemn someone to eternal punishment.
armB.arabic: أن يلعن أو يحكم على شخص بالهلاك الأبدي، أو ينتقد شخصاً أو عملاً بشدة ويدينه.
examples: Don't damn him for one honest mistake.
Critics tend to damn any film that challenges conventional storytelling.
Strict doctrines warn that sin will damn the soul to eternal punishment.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Dam' 'سد'.. لما الـ 'Dam' اتكسر وغرق الدنيا، الناس قالوا 'Damn!'.

armA.definition: A specific day of the month or year; a social meeting; a sweet brown fruit.
armA.arabic: ليها كذا معنى: تاريخ اليوم، أو خروجة وموعد مع حد، وكمان بتيجي بمعنى 'تمر'.
examples: What is the date today?
I have a date with my friend tonight.
Please write your date of birth on the form.
We ate dried dates for dessert.
To date, this is his best work.
The radiocarbon date suggests the artifact is ancient.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Day' يوم.. الـ 'Date' هو تحديد الـ 'Day' ده بالظبط.

armB.definition: A specific day of the month or year; a planned social or romantic meeting; or a sweet, dark brown fruit.
armB.arabic: تأتي بمعنى تاريخ اليوم أو تاريخ محدد في التقويم، وتأتي أيضاً بمعنى موعد أو لقاء بين شخصين، وكذلك تعني ثمرة التمر.
examples: What is the date today?
I have a date with my friend tonight.
Please write your date of birth on the form.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Day' تعني يوم.. والـ 'Date' هو تحديد هذا الـ 'Day' بالتاريخ واليوم بدقة.

armA.definition: An agreement entered into by two or more parties for their mutual benefit.
armA.arabic: اتفاق أو صفقة بين طرفين، زي لما تتفق مع حد على بيع وشراء.
examples: It is a good deal.
We made a deal with the supplier.
I have a great deal of work to do today.
The government signed a trade deal with China.
He got a raw deal from the insurance company.
The peace deal was brokered under difficult circumstances.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Deal' يعني اتفاق.. لما تخلص كلام مع حد تقول 'It's a Deal' يعني اتفقنا خلاص.

armB.definition: An agreement entered into by two or more parties for their mutual benefit.
armB.arabic: اتفاق أو صفقة بين طرفين، زي لما تتفق مع حد على بيع وشراء.
examples: We made a deal with the supplier.
The government signed a trade deal with China.
It is a good deal.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Deal' يعني اتفاق.. لما تخلص كلام مع حد تقول 'It's a Deal' يعني اتفقنا خلاص.

armA.definition: To take action to solve a problem (deal with) or to distribute cards in a game.
armA.arabic: إنك تتعامل مع مشكلة أو شخص، أو توزع الكوتشينة في اللعب.
examples: I deal the cards now.
I have to deal with this problem immediately.
The book deals with the history of Egypt.
We only deal with reputable companies.
She is used to dealing with difficult customers.
The sanctions were designed to deal a blow to the regime.
armA.mnemonic: لما تقول 'Deal with it' يعني 'اتعامل' مع الموضوع وحله.

armB.definition: To take action to solve a problem (deal with) or to distribute cards in a game.
armB.arabic: إنك تتعامل مع مشكلة أو شخص، أو توزع الكوتشينة في اللعب.
examples: I have to deal with this problem immediately.
We only deal with reputable companies.
Whose turn is it to deal the cards?
armB.mnemonic: لما تقول 'Deal with it' يعني 'اتعامل' مع الموضوع وحله.

armA.definition: Something, typically money, that is owed or due.
armA.arabic: الديون، الفلوس اللي عليك ولازم ترجعها لحد تاني.
examples: He has no debt.
I paid my debt.
She is in debt to the bank.
The company is trying to reduce its debt.
National debt has reached an all-time high.
He acknowledged his debt of gratitude to his mentor.
armA.mnemonic: حرف الـ 'b' ساكت مبيتنطقش، زي ما أنت ساكت لما حد يطلب منك سداد الـ 'Debt' 'الدين'.

armB.definition: Something, typically money, that is owed or due.
armB.arabic: الديون، الفلوس اللي عليك ولازم ترجعها لحد تاني.
examples: The company is trying to reduce its debt.
She is in debt to the bank.
National debt has reached an all-time high.
armB.mnemonic: حرف الـ 'b' ساكت مبيتنطقش، زي ما أنت ساكت لما حد يطلب منك سداد الـ 'Debt' 'الدين'.

armA.definition: To openly resist or refuse to obey.
armA.arabic: إنك تتحدى حد أو ترفض تطيع الأوامر علناً. أو إن حاجة تكون صعبة جداً وتتحدى الوصف.
examples: I will defy him.
Do not defy the rules.
She decided to defy her parents' wishes.
The beauty of the scene defies description.
His actions defy all logic and reason.
A few brave souls dared to defy the tyrant's orders.
armA.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Defy' للقانون، إنت بتقول 'De-fine' 'بتحدد' قانونك الخاص وبترفض تمشي وراهم.

armB.definition: To openly resist or refuse to obey.
armB.arabic: إنك تتحدى حد أو ترفض تطيع الأوامر علناً. أو إن حاجة تكون صعبة جداً وتتحدى الوصف.
examples: She decided to defy her parents' wishes.
His actions defy all logic and reason.
A few brave souls dared to defy the tyrant's orders.
armB.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Defy' للقانون، إنت بتقول 'De-fine' 'بتحدد' قانونك الخاص وبترفض تمشي وراهم.

armA.definition: Relying on someone or something else for support, survival, or success.
armA.arabic: معتمد على شخص أو شيء آخر للدعم أو البقاء، وغير مستقل بذاته.
examples: Babies are dependent on their mothers.
He is dependent on his parents for money.
The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Depend' (يعتمد).. والـ 'Dependent' هو الشخص أو الشيء اللي بيعمل 'Depend' على غيره.

armB.definition: Relying on someone or something else for support or survival.
armB.arabic: معتمد على حد أو حاجة تانية، مش مستقل بنفسه.
examples: Babies are dependent on their mothers.
He is dependent on his parents for money.
Your grade is dependent on your final exam.
The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.
Drug dependent patients need special care.
The variables are mutually dependent in this equation.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Depend' 'يعتمد'.. الـ 'Dependent' هو الشخص اللي بيعمل 'Depend' على غيره.

armA.definition: A person or company that creates new products, software, or buildings.
armA.arabic: الشخص أو الشركة اللي بتطور حاجة، سواء مبرمج كمبيوتر أو مقاول بيبني عمارات.
examples: He is a game developer.
The developer built new houses.
Software developers are in high demand.
The property developer bought the land.
As a web developer, you need to know JavaScript.
The developer faced opposition from local residents regarding the new mall.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Develop' يطور.. الـ 'Developer' هو المُطوِّر اللي بيبني أو بيبرمج.

armB.definition: A person or company that creates new products, software, or buildings.
armB.arabic: الشخص أو الشركة التي تقوم بتطوير منتجات أو برمجيات، أو مقاول/مستثمر يقوم بإنشاء مبانٍ وعقارات.
examples: As a web developer, you need to know JavaScript.
He works as a game developer for a major gaming studio.
The property developer bought the land to build new apartments.
armB.mnemonic: من الفعل 'develop' (يطوّر).. بإضافة '-er' تصبح 'developer' أي الشخص أو الكيان المُطوِّر، سواء في البرمجة أو البناء العقاري.

armA.definition: The supreme spirit of evil; Satan.
armA.arabic: الشيطان أو روح الشر، وممكن تتقال على شخص شرير أو ماكر.
examples: The devil is bad.
He acted like a devil.
Speak of the devil, here he comes!
She's a little devil when she wants to be.
He is between the devil and the deep blue sea.
The details are where the devil resides.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Devil' هو أصل الـ 'Evil' 'الشر'.. الكلمتين فيهم نفس الحروف تقريباً.

armB.definition: The supreme spirit of evil; Satan.
armB.arabic: الشيطان أو روح الشر، وممكن تتقال على شخص شرير أو ماكر.
examples: Speak of the devil, here he comes!
She is a little devil when she wants to be.
He is between the devil and the deep blue sea.
armB.mnemonic: لاحظ أن كلمة devil تبدأ بحرف d وتتبعها كلمة evil (شر)؛ تذكر أن الـ devil دائماً مرتبط بالـ evil.

armA.definition: Something that interrupts someone or makes them feel worried; a noisy commotion.
armA.arabic: أي حاجة بتعمل دوشة أو قلق وبتقطع الهدوء، زي صوت عالي أو مشكلة حصلت.
examples: Sorry for the disturbance.
The loud music caused a disturbance at night.
He was arrested for causing a public disturbance.
armA.mnemonic: 'Disturb' يزعج.. الـ 'Disturbance' هو الدوشة والإزعاج اللي بيحصل.

armB.definition: Something that interrupts someone or makes them feel worried; a noisy commotion.
armB.arabic: أي حاجة بتعمل دوشة أو قلق وبتقطع الهدوء، زي صوت عالي أو مشكلة حصلت.
examples: Sorry for the disturbance.
The loud music caused a disturbance at night.
We reported a disturbance in the street to the police.
He was arrested for causing a public disturbance.
Atmospheric disturbances can affect radio signals.
The patient showed signs of severe emotional disturbance.
armB.mnemonic: 'Disturb' يزعج.. الـ 'Disturbance' هو الدوشة والإزعاج اللي بيحصل.

armA.definition: To separate and go in different directions.
armA.arabic: لما طريق واحد يتقسم لطريقين وكل واحد يروح في ناحية، أو الآراء تختلف وتبعد عن بعض.
examples: The roads diverge here.
Our paths diverge at the park.
Their opinions began to diverge on the issue.
The two species diverged millions of years ago.
Global economic trends are starting to diverge significantly.
The novel diverges from the standard narrative structure.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Converge'. الطرق بتعمل 'Diverge' زي حرف V بتوسع وتبعد.

armB.definition: To separate and go in different directions.
armB.arabic: لما طريق واحد يتقسم لطريقين وكل واحد يروح في ناحية، أو الآراء تختلف وتبعد عن بعض.
examples: The roads diverge here.
Their opinions began to diverge on the issue.
Global economic trends are starting to diverge significantly.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Converge'. الطرق بتعمل 'Diverge' زي حرف V بتوسع وتبعد.

armA.definition: A person with a medical degree whose job is to treat sick people.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيعالج الناس العيانة.
examples: I need to see a doctor.
The doctor gave me some medicine.
You should go to the doctor for a check-up.
She is studying to become a doctor.
He is a doctor of physics, not medicine.
The doctor's prognosis was grim but accurate.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Doctor' هي نفسها 'دكتور' بالعربي.

armB.definition: A person with a medical degree whose job is to treat sick people.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيعالج الناس العيانة.
examples: I need to see a doctor.
The doctor gave me some medicine.
She is studying to become a doctor.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Doctor' هي نفسها 'دكتور' بالعربي.

armA.definition: A highly intelligent sea animal that looks like a large fish with a beak-like snout.
armA.arabic: حيوان بحري ذكي جداً وصديق للإنسان، بيحب يلعب ونشوفه في العروض.
examples: The dolphin swims fast.
I saw a dolphin in the sea.
A friendly dolphin leaped high out of the water.
armA.mnemonic: نفس النطق بالعربي 'دُلفين'.. ممكن تربطها بـ 'Doll' 'لعبة' لأنه بيحب يلعب.

armB.definition: A highly intelligent sea animal that looks like a large fish with a beak-like snout.
armB.arabic: حيوان بحري ذكي جداً وصديق للإنسان، بيحب يلعب ونشوفه في العروض.
examples: The dolphin swims fast.
I saw a dolphin in the sea.
Dolphins are known for their intelligence.
We went on a boat trip to watch the dolphins.
The dolphin's sonar capabilities are fascinating to scientists.
Conservationists are worried about the declining dolphin population.
armB.mnemonic: نفس النطق بالعربي 'دُلفين'.. ممكن تربطها بـ 'Doll' 'لعبة' لأنه بيحب يلعب.

armA.definition: Relating to the running of a home, family, or one's own country.
armA.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالبيت والعيلة، أو حاجة محلية جوه البلد مش أجنبية.
examples: The government focuses on domestic issues.
Cats are domestic animals.
I don't like domestic work like cleaning.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Dome' يعني قبة.. الـ 'Domestic' هو اللي بيحصل تحت قبة البيت أو قبة البلد

armB.definition: Relating to the running of a home, family, or one's own country.
armB.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالبيت والعيلة، أو حاجة محلية جوه البلد مش أجنبية.
examples: Cats are domestic animals.
I don't like domestic work like cleaning.
The government focuses on domestic issues.
Domestic flights are cheaper than international ones.
The country is facing severe domestic unrest.
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a key economic indicator.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Dome' يعني قبة.. الـ 'Domestic' هو اللي بيحصل تحت قبة البيت أو قبة البلد

armA.definition: The opening where a door is, or the passage into a room.
armA.arabic: الفتحة التي يوجد بها الباب، أو المدخل الذي تعبر منه لدخول الغرفة.
examples: He stood in the doorway.
Please don't block the doorway with your bags.
She paused in the doorway to look back at the room.
armA.mnemonic: هي طريق 'Way' الباب 'Door'.. يعني الفتحة أو الـ 'Doorway' اللي بتدخل منها.

armB.definition: The opening where a door is, or the passage into a room.
armB.arabic: الفتحة اللي فيها الباب، أو المدخل اللي بتعدي منه عشان تدخل الأوضة.
examples: He stood in the doorway.
The cat sat in the doorway watching us.
Please don't block the doorway with your bags.
She paused in the doorway to look back at the room.
The beggar sought shelter in the doorway of the shop.
The magnificent arched doorway hinted at the grandeur inside.
armB.mnemonic: هي طريق 'Way' الباب 'Door'.. يعني الفتحة أو الـ 'Doorway' اللي بتدخل منها.

armA.definition: A thing or person that is the same as another; twice the quantity.
armA.arabic: حاجة أو شخص شبه التاني بالظبط، أو كمية مضاعفة.
examples: Give me a double.
He is the double of his father.
Make that a double, please.
She acted as a double for the actress.
His body double did the dangerous stunts.
To pay double is unfair.

armB.definition: Twice the amount, number, or quantity.
armB.arabic: ضعف الكمية أو المقدار (مرتان بقدر الشيء).
examples: We expected twenty guests, but double arrived.
She earns double what I make for the same work.
Why pay double when you can get it at a discount?

armA.definition: To or in the main business or commercial area of a town or city.
armA.arabic: في أو إلى وسط البلد (المنطقة التجارية أو المركزية للمدينة).
examples: Let's go downtown.
He works downtown but lives in the suburbs.
We drove downtown to see the parade.
armA.translations: في وسط البلد إلى وسط البلد
armA.mnemonic: لما تقول 'I am going downtown' كأنك بتقول أنا نازل 'Down' لقلب الـ 'Town'.

armB.definition: To or in the main business or commercial area of a town or city.
armB.arabic: ناحية وسط البلد، لما تكون رايح للمنطقة التجارية.
examples: Let's go downtown.
She lives downtown.
We drove downtown to see the parade.
He works downtown but lives in the suburbs.
They ventured downtown to explore the nightlife.
The protest marched downtown, gathering momentum along the way.
armB.mnemonic: لما تقول 'I am going downtown' كأنك بتقول أنا نازل 'Down' لقلب الـ 'Town'.

armA.definition: To prepare a preliminary version of a text or plan; or to recruit someone for military service.
armA.arabic: يكتب مسودة أو يجهز خطة مبدئية، أو يجند شخصاً للخدمة العسكرية.
examples: I will draft a response to their email this afternoon.
They plan to draft a new contract before the end of the week.
The government decided not to draft college students into the army.
armA.mnemonic: فكر في مجلد الـ Drafts (المسودات) في بريدك الإلكتروني؛ لما تعمل draft لرسالة، يعني بتكتب مسودتها المبدئية قبل الإرسال النهائي.

armB.definition: To prepare a preliminary version of a text; or to recruit someone for military service.
armB.arabic: يكتب مسودة أو يجهز خطة مبدئية، أو يجند حد في الجيش.
examples: Draft a letter.
We drafted a plan for the party.
She was drafted into the team.
Lawyers drafted the new contract.
He was drafted into the army at age 18.
The committee drafted a resolution to address the crisis.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم.. بيعمل 'Draft' يعني بيجهز ويخطط.

armA.definition: To make something free from water or liquid.
armA.arabic: إنك تنشف حاجة وتشيل منها المية.
examples: Dry your hands on the towel.
The sun will dry the clothes.
I need to dry my hair.
The wood needs time to dry out.
The tears dried on her cheeks.
The soil has dried up completely due to the drought.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الاسم، 'Dry' يعني ينشف.

armB.definition: To make something free from water or liquid.
armB.arabic: إنك تنشف حاجة وتشيل منها المية.
examples: Dry your hands on the towel.
The sun will dry the clothes.
I need to dry my hair.
armB.mnemonic: تذكّر كلمة مجفف الشعر (Hair dryer)؛ الكلمة الأساسية منها هي الفعل 'dry' ومعناها يجفف أو ينشف.

armA.definition: Temporarily unable or unwilling to speak, typically from shock or surprise; informally, foolish or stupid.
armA.arabic: تُستخدم في الكلام العادي بمعنى 'غبي'، لكن معناها الأصلي والتعبيري الأدبي هو 'أخرس' أو عاجز عن النطق من شدة الدهشة أو الصدمة.
examples: That was a dumb mistake.
He went dumb with fear.
They stared in dumb amazement at the sight.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Dam' 'سد'.. السد بيسكت المية، والـ 'Dumb' ساكت مبيتكلمش 'أو غبي'.

armB.definition: Temporarily unable or unwilling to speak; informal meaning is stupid.
armB.arabic: بتتقال بمعنى 'غبي' في الكلام العادي، بس معناها الأصلي 'أخرس' أو مش قادر يتكلم من الصدمة.
examples: That was a dumb mistake.
Don't be dumb.
He went dumb with fear.
Playing dumb won't help you now.
They stared in dumb amazement at the sight.
The sheer magnitude of the disaster left us struck dumb.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Dam' 'سد'.. السد بيسكت المية، والـ 'Dumb' ساكت مبيتكلمش 'أو غبي'.

armA.definition: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; long-lasting.
armA.arabic: حاجة قوية وبتستحمل وتعيش وقت طويل من غير ما تبوظ.
examples: This toy is very durable.
We need durable shoes for hiking.
Plastic is a durable material.
The company produces durable goods like fridges.
They are looking for a durable peace agreement.
The machine is made of highly durable titanium alloy.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Duration' 'مدة'.. الـ 'Durable' هو اللي مدته طويلة وبيعيش.

armB.definition: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; long-lasting.
armB.arabic: حاجة قوية وبتستحمل وتعيش وقت طويل من غير ما تبوظ.
examples: We need durable shoes for hiking.
Plastic is a durable material.
The negotiators hope to achieve a durable peace in the region.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Duration' 'مدة'.. الـ 'Durable' هو اللي مدته طويلة وبيعيش.

armA.definition: Fine powder made of dirt or waste that covers surfaces.
armA.arabic: التراب الناعم أو الغبار اللي بيتجمع على الأسطح لما ما تتنضفش فترة.
examples: There is dust on the table.
Please clean the dust.
The car left a cloud of dust behind it.
She wiped the dust off the old book.
The project was left to gather dust on the shelf.
We are but dust and shadows in the grand scheme of time.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Dust' هو التراب.. افتكر كلمة 'Duster' اللي هي فوطة التراب.

armB.definition: Fine powder made of dirt or waste that covers surfaces.
armB.arabic: التراب الناعم أو الغبار اللي بيتجمع على الأسطح لما ما تتنضفش فترة.
examples: There is dust on the table.
She wiped the dust off the old book.
The car left a cloud of dust behind it.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Dust' هو التراب.. افتكر كلمة 'Duster' اللي هي فوطة التراب.

armA.definition: A person who determines the final content of a text or publication.
armA.arabic: الشخص المسؤول عن مراجعة وتعديل المقالات أو الكتب قبل نشرها.
examples: The editor liked my story.
She works as a fashion editor.
The chief editor has the final say.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Edit' يعني يعدل.. فالـ 'Editor' هو المعدل أو المحرر.

armB.definition: A person who determines the final content of a text or publication.
armB.arabic: الشخص المسؤول عن مراجعة وتعديل المقالات أو الكتب قبل نشرها.
examples: He is an editor.
The editor liked my story.
She works as a fashion editor.
The letter to the editor was published.
The chief editor has the final say.
Use a text editor to modify the code.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Edit' يعني يعدل.. فالـ 'Editor' هو المعدل أو المحرر.

armA.definition: To give intellectual, moral, and social instruction to someone.
armA.arabic: تعلم حد وتديله معلومات وثقافة، مش بس دراسة في المدرسة، تربية كمان.
examples: Schools educate children.
He wants to educate himself about art.
Parents must educate their kids on safety.
The program aims to educate the public about health risks.
It is difficult to educate people who do not want to learn.
We must educate the next generation to be responsible citizens.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Cat'.. تخيل إنك بتحاول 'Educate' 'تعلّم' الـ 'Cat' بتاعتك تقرأ.

armB.definition: To give intellectual, moral, and social instruction to someone.
armB.arabic: تعلم حد وتديله معلومات وثقافة، مش بس دراسة في المدرسة، تربية كمان.
examples: The program aims to educate the public about health risks.
Parents must educate their kids on safety.
