He wants to educate himself about art.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Cat'.. تخيل إنك بتحاول 'Educate' 'تعلّم' الـ 'Cat' بتاعتك تقرأ.

armA.definition: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm.
armA.arabic: الكوع أو المِرفَق، وهو المفصل الذي يربط بين الساعد والجزء العلوي من الذراع.
examples: My elbow hurts.
She nudged him with her elbow.
He rested his elbow on the table.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Elbow' .. شكل الكوع عامل زي حرف 'L' .. 'L-bow'.

armB.definition: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm.
armB.arabic: الكوع، المفصل اللي بيربط بين دراعك من فوق ومن تحت.
examples: My elbow hurts.
He rested his elbows on the table.
She nudged him with her elbow.
The room was so crowded we were standing elbow to elbow.
He used some elbow grease to clean the floor.
She accidentally banged her funny bone, which is actually the nerve in the elbow.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Elbow' .. شكل الكوع عامل زي حرف 'L' .. 'L-bow'.

armA.definition: The branch of science dealing with electric circuits; or electronic devices.
armA.arabic: علم الإلكترونيات أو الأجهزة نفسها زي الكمبيوتر والموبايل.
examples: He studies electronics at college.
This shop sells electronics.
Modern electronics have revolutionized communication.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Electric' كهرباء.. الأجهزة اللي بتشتغل بكهرباء دقيقة.

armB.definition: The branch of science dealing with electric circuits; or electronic devices.
armB.arabic: علم الإلكترونيات أو الأجهزة نفسها زي الكمبيوتر والموبايل.
examples: I like electronics.
This shop sells electronics.
He studies electronics at college.
The electronics industry is growing fast.
Modern electronics have revolutionized communication.
Micro-electronics has enabled the miniaturization of devices.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Electric' كهرباء.. الأجهزة اللي بتشتغل بكهرباء دقيقة.

armA.definition: A feeling of shame, awkwardness, or self-consciousness, or a situation/person that causes it.
armA.arabic: شعور بالخجل أو الكسوف لما يحصل موقف محرج أو سخيف قدام الناس، أو الشيء/الشخص اللي بيسبب الحرج ده.
examples: His face was red with embarrassment.
To my embarrassment, I forgot his name.
The scandal caused significant embarrassment to the government.
armA.mnemonic: 'Embarrassment' فيها 'Bar'.. لو دخلت 'Bar' غلط ممكن تحس بـ 'Embarrassment'.

armB.definition: A feeling of shame, awkwardness, or self-consciousness.
armB.arabic: شعور بالخجل أو الكسوف لما يحصل موقف محرج أو سخيف قدام الناس.
examples: His face was red with embarrassment.
She felt embarrassment when she fell.
To my embarrassment, I forgot his name.
He is an embarrassment to his family.
The scandal caused significant embarrassment to the government.
She covered her face to hide the acute embarrassment she felt.
armB.mnemonic: 'Embarrassment' فيها 'Bar'.. لو دخلت 'Bar' غلط ممكن تحس بـ 'Embarrassment'.

armA.definition: An unborn offspring in the process of development; an early stage of something.
armA.arabic: الجنين في مراحله الأولى خالص قبل ما يتكون شكله الكامل، أو بداية أي فكرة.
examples: The doctor checked the health of the embryo.
Human embryo research is a controversial topic.
The project is still in embryo.

armB.definition: An unborn offspring in the process of development; an early stage of something.
armB.arabic: الجنين في مراحله الأولى خالص قبل ما يتكون شكله الكامل، أو بداية أي فكرة.
examples: The egg has an embryo.
We studied the chicken embryo.
The doctor checked the health of the embryo.
The project is still in embryo.
Human embryo research is a controversial topic.
The idea of democracy was present in embryo in ancient Greece.

armA.definition: A serious, unexpected, and dangerous situation requiring immediate action.
armA.arabic: حالة طارئة وخطيرة بتحصل فجأة ولازم نتصرف فيها بسرعة جداً، زي الحوادث أو الحريق.
examples: Call 911 in an emergency.
The pilot had to make an emergency landing.
The government declared a state of emergency.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من فعل 'Emerge' 'يظهر فجأة'.. الـ 'Emergency' هي المشكلة اللي بتظهر فجأة ومحتاجة حل.

armB.definition: A serious, unexpected, and dangerous situation requiring immediate action.
armB.arabic: حالة طارئة وخطيرة بتحصل فجأة ولازم نتصرف فيها بسرعة جداً، زي الحوادث أو الحريق.
examples: Call 911 in an emergency.
Use the emergency exit if there is a fire.
The pilot made an emergency landing.
She keeps a flashlight for emergencies.
The government declared a state of emergency.
The hospital has a contingency plan for handling civil emergencies.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من فعل 'Emerge' 'يظهر فجأة'.. الـ 'Emergency' هي المشكلة اللي بتظهر فجأة ومحتاجة حل.

armA.definition: The final part of something; the point where something stops.
armA.arabic: النهاية.. آخر حتة في الشيء أو آخر مشهد في الفيلم.
examples: It is the end of the day.
Go to the end of the street.
We stayed until the end of the movie.
There is no end in sight to this problem.
The means justify the end.
He met an untimely end.
armA.mnemonic: بنشوفها في آخر الفيلم دايماً 'The End' يعني 'النهاية'.

armB.definition: The final part of something; the point where something stops.
armB.arabic: النهاية.. آخر جزء في الشيء أو آخر وقت في حدث أو آخر مشهد في الفيلم.
examples: It is the end of the day.
Go to the end of the street.
We stayed until the end of the movie.
armB.mnemonic: بنشوفها في آخر الفيلم دايماً 'The End' يعني 'النهاية'.

armA.definition: To suffer something painful or difficult patiently; to remain in existence.
armA.arabic: يتحمل أو يطيق حاجة صعبة زي الألم أو المعاناة. وكمان بتيجي بمعنى يستمر ويبقى.
examples: I cannot endure this noise.
She had to endure a long flight.
They endured many hardships during the war.
His fame endured for centuries.
The company endured despite the economic crisis.
Humanity has the capacity to endure even the most catastrophic events.
armA.mnemonic: لازم تتحمل للآخر 'End' لحد ما نلاقي 'Cure' 'علاج'.. 'Endure'

armB.definition: To suffer something painful or difficult patiently; to remain in existence.
armB.arabic: يتحمل أو يطيق حاجة صعبة زي الألم أو المعاناة. وكمان بتيجي بمعنى يستمر ويبقى.
examples: She had to endure a long flight.
Humanity has the capacity to endure even the most catastrophic events.
His fame will endure for centuries.
armB.mnemonic: لازم تتحمل للآخر 'End' لحد ما نلاقي 'Cure' 'علاج'.. 'Endure'

armA.definition: The action of providing amusement or enjoyment, or performances and activities designed to entertain people.
armA.arabic: الترفيه أو التسلية، زي الأفلام والمزيكا والألعاب.
examples: The hotel provides evening entertainment.
We watched TV for entertainment.
The entertainment industry is huge.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر كلمة enter (يدخل): الترفيه حاجة بتدخل البهجة والسرور على قلبك.

armB.definition: The action of providing amusement or enjoyment.
armB.arabic: الترفيه أو التسلية، زي الأفلام والمزيكا والألعاب.
examples: Movies are good entertainment.
We watched TV for entertainment.
The hotel provides evening entertainment.
The entertainment industry is huge.
It was just harmless entertainment.
The city offers a wide range of cultural entertainment.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. الحاجة اللي 'بتدخل' السرور على قلبك.

armA.definition: Absolutely necessary; extremely important.
armA.arabic: حاجة مهمة جداً وماينفعش تكمل من غيرها، زي الماية للجسم.
examples: Water is essential for life.
It is essential to arrive on time.
Experience is essential for this job.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Essence' 'جوهر'.. الحاجة الـ 'Essential' هي الجوهر اللي ماينفعش نستغنى عنه.

armB.definition: Absolutely necessary; extremely important.
armB.arabic: حاجة مهمة جداً وماينفعش تكمل من غيرها، زي الماية للجسم.
examples: Water is essential for life.
It is essential to arrive on time.
Experience is essential for this job.
Vitamins are essential nutrients.
Trust is an essential element of any relationship.
The essential nature of the problem remains unsolved.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Essence' 'جوهر'.. الحاجة الـ 'Essential' هي الجوهر اللي ماينفعش نستغنى عنه.

armA.definition: A large area of land in the country owned by a person or family, or all the money and property that someone leaves when they die.
armA.arabic: ممتلكات كبيرة زي الأراضي والبيوت، أو كل الفلوس والأملاك اللي بيسيبها الشخص بعد وفاته.
examples: We visited a country estate.
The family estate was sold to pay debts.
His estate was divided among his children.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'State' 'دولة'.. الـ 'Estate' الكبيرة بتبقى زي دولة صغيرة لصحابها

armB.definition: A large area of land in the country that is owned by a family or an organization.
armB.arabic: ممتلكات كبيرة زي الأراضي والبيوت، أو كل الفلوس والأملاك اللي بيسيبها الشخص بعد وفاته.
examples: He lives on a big estate.
We visited a country estate.
She works in real estate.
The family estate was sold to pay debts.
His estate was divided among his children.
The landed estate system was central to the region's history.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'State' 'دولة'.. الـ 'Estate' الكبيرة بتبقى زي دولة صغيرة لصحابها

armA.definition: A thing that happens, especially one of importance.
armA.arabic: حدث أو مناسبة مهمة. زي حفلة، اجتماع، أو حتى ماتش كورة.
examples: It was a big event.
The party is a fun event.
The Olympics is a sporting event.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Event' قريبة من 'Invent'.. الـ 'Event' هو حاجة بتحصل وممكن نـ 'Invent' 'نبتكر' فيها.

armB.definition: A thing that happens, especially one of importance.
armB.arabic: حدث أو مناسبة مهمة. زي حفلة، اجتماع، أو حتى ماتش كورة.
examples: It was a big event.
The party is a fun event.
The Olympics is a sporting event.
In the event of fire, use the stairs.
The turn of events surprised everyone.
Historical events shaped the nation.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Event' قريبة من 'Invent'.. الـ 'Event' هو حاجة بتحصل وممكن نـ 'Invent' 'نبتكر' فيها.

armA.definition: Plain or obvious; clearly seen or understood.
armA.arabic: واضح جداً وظاهر للكل، ومش محتاج تفكير كتير عشان تفهمه.
examples: It became evident that he was lost.
Her talent was evident from a young age.
The success of the policy is evident in the statistics.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Evidence' 'دليل'.. لما الدليل يكون موجود، الحقيقة بتبقى 'Evident' 'واضحة'.

armB.definition: Plain or obvious; clearly seen or understood.
armB.arabic: واضح جداً وظاهر للكل، ومش محتاج تفكير كتير عشان تفهمه.
examples: It is evident to me.
His sadness was evident.
It became evident that he was lost.
Her talent was evident from a young age.
The success of the policy is evident in the statistics.
It is self-evident that all men are created equal.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Evidence' 'دليل'.. لما الدليل يكون موجود، الحقيقة بتبقى 'Evident' 'واضحة'.

armA.definition: Not approximated in any way; precise and accurate.
armA.arabic: يعني دقيق جداً أو مضبوط بالمللي. حاجة مفيهاش أي غلطة أو تقريب.
examples: What is the exact time?
We need the exact amount of money.
I can't remember his exact words.
armA.mnemonic: عشان تنجح في الـ 'Exam' 'الامتحان'، لازم إجابتك تكون 'Exact' 'دقيقة' وصح.

armB.definition: Not approximated in any way; precise and accurate.
armB.arabic: يعني دقيق جداً أو مضبوط بالمللي. حاجة مفيهاش أي غلطة أو تقريب.
examples: What is the exact time?
We need the exact amount of money.
I can't remember his exact words.
The exact cause of the fire is unknown.
She gave an exact description of the attacker.
Scientific experiments require exact measurements and conditions.
armB.mnemonic: عشان تنجح في الـ 'Exam' 'الامتحان'، لازم إجابتك تكون 'Exact' 'دقيقة' وصح.

armA.definition: A thing characteristic of its kind or illustrating a general rule.
armA.arabic: مثال.. نموذج بيوضحلك الفكرة عشان تفهمها أحسن.
examples: This is a good example.
Can you give me an example?
For example, you can eat fruit.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Exam' 'امتحان' جزء منها.. والامتحان عبارة عن 'Examples' 'أمثلة' بنحلها.

armB.definition: A thing characteristic of its kind or illustrating a general rule.
armB.arabic: مثال.. نموذج بيوضحلك الفكرة عشان تفهمها أحسن.
examples: This is a good example.
Can you give me an example?
For example, you can eat fruit.
She sets a good example for her sister.
This case is a classic example of the problem.
He was punished to make an example of him.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Exam' 'امتحان' جزء منها.. والامتحان عبارة عن 'Examples' 'أمثلة' بنحلها.

armA.definition: A person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.
armA.arabic: الاستثناء.. يعني حاجة مختلفة عن القاعدة العامة أو مش ماشية مع الباقي.
examples: There is an exception to every rule.
We are open every day, with the exception of Sunday.
I will make an exception for you this time.
armA.mnemonic: شبه علامة 'X'.. يعني حاجة بره القائمة.. 'X'-ception.

armB.definition: A person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.
armB.arabic: الاستثناء.. يعني حاجة مختلفة عن القاعدة العامة أو مش ماشية مع الباقي.
examples: Everyone went except him.
There is an exception to every rule.
We are open every day, with the exception of Sunday.
I will make an exception for you this time.
His performance was without exception the best.
The policy has been applied without exception.
armB.mnemonic: شبه علامة 'X'.. يعني حاجة بره القائمة.. 'X'-ception.

armA.definition: To cry out suddenly, especially in surprise, anger, or pain.
armA.arabic: إنك تقول حاجة بصوت عالي فجأة بسبب المفاجأة أو الغضب أو الفرحة.
examples: He exclaimed in pain.
"Look out!" she exclaimed.
The children exclaimed with delight when they saw the presents.
She exclaimed that she had never seen such a thing.
He exclaimed against the injustice of the verdict.
Critics exclaimed over the brilliance of the new play.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Exclaim' فيها 'Claim' 'يدّعي'.. لما حد يدّعي حاجة بصوت عالي ومفاجئ يبقى بيعمل 'Exclaim'.

armB.definition: To cry out suddenly, especially in surprise, anger, or pain.
armB.arabic: إنك تقول حاجة بصوت عالي فجأة بسبب المفاجأة أو الغضب أو الفرحة.
examples: I heard him exclaim in surprise when he saw the unexpected gift.
Why did she exclaim with delight upon hearing the good news?
You do not need to exclaim in anger over such a minor mistake.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Exclaim' فيها 'Claim' 'يدّعي'.. لما حد يدّعي حاجة بصوت عالي ومفاجئ يبقى بيعمل 'Exclaim'.

armA.definition: The state of being exposed to contact with something; publicity.
armA.arabic: التعرض لحاجة 'زي الشمس أو الخطر'، أو إن حاجة تنكشف وتتعرف للناس 'شهرة أو فضيحة'.
examples: Avoid too much sun exposure.
The camera needs a long exposure.
His exposure to the cold made him sick.
The band got a lot of exposure on TV.
The bank has limited its exposure to bad debt.
Prolonged exposure to radiation is lethal.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Expose' 'يكشف'.. الـ Exposure هو إنك تكون 'مكشوف' قدام حاجة.

armB.definition: The state of being exposed to contact with something; publicity.
armB.arabic: التعرض لحاجة 'زي الشمس أو الخطر'، أو إن حاجة تنكشف وتتعرف للناس 'شهرة أو فضيحة'.
examples: Avoid too much sun exposure.
His exposure to the cold made him sick.
The band got a lot of exposure on TV.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Expose' 'يكشف'.. الـ Exposure هو إنك تكون 'مكشوف' قدام حاجة.

armA.definition: A group of university departments; or an inherent mental or physical power.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: الكلية في الجامعة 'زي كلية الطب'، أو قدرة عقلية/بدنية عند الإنسان.
examples: He works at the faculty.
The Faculty of Arts is old.
She joined the law faculty.
The university has an excellent faculty of engineering.
He is losing his mental faculties due to age.
The faculty voted unanimously on the new curriculum.
armA.mnemonic: فاكرتني؟ 'Fact'.. الكلية 'Faculty' مكان بندرس فيه الـ 'Facts' الحقائق.

armB.definition: The teaching staff or an academic department of a university, or an inherent mental or physical power.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: الكلية أو هيئة التدريس في الجامعة، أو قدرة عقلية وبدنية عند الإنسان.
examples: She joined the law faculty.
The faculty voted unanimously on the new curriculum.
She showed a remarkable faculty for learning foreign languages.
armB.mnemonic: فاكرتني؟ 'Fact'.. الكلية 'Faculty' مكان بندرس فيه الـ 'Facts' الحقائق.

armA.definition: To be unsuccessful in achieving a goal, to not pass an exam, or to stop working properly.
armA.arabic: أن تفشل في تحقيق هدف، أو ترسب في امتحان، أو يتعطل جهاز عن العمل.
examples: I don't want to fail my test.
If you fail to plan, you plan to fail.
A car engine will fail without oil.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fail' تشبه نطق كلمة 'فيل' (Elephant).. لو حاولت تشيل 'فيل' لوحدك، بالتأكيد سوف 'fail' (تفشل).

armB.definition: To be unsuccessful in achieving a goal, or to stop working properly.
armB.arabic: إنك تفشل في تحقيق هدف، أو ترسب في امتحان، أو جهاز يعطل.
examples: I don't want to fail my test.
The engine failed to start.
He failed to mention the cost.
If you fail to plan, you plan to fail.
The crop failed due to the drought.
Words fail to express my gratitude.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fail' -> فيل 'Elephant'.. لو حاولت تشيل 'فيل' أكيد هتعمل 'Fail' 'تفشل'.

armA.definition: The money a passenger must pay for a journey on public transport.
armA.arabic: الفلوس اللي بتدفعها عشان تركب مواصلة زي التاكسي أو القطر أو الأتوبيس (الأجرة).
examples: How much is the bus fare?
I paid the taxi fare.
Children travel for half fare.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fare' قريبة من 'Fair' 'عادل'.. لازم تدفع 'Fare' 'أجرة' تكون 'Fair' عشان السواق ميزعلش.

armB.definition: The money a passenger must pay for a journey on public transport.
armB.arabic: الفلوس اللي بتدفعها عشان تركب مواصلة زي التاكسي أو القطر أو الأتوبيس.
examples: How much is the bus fare?
I paid the taxi fare.
Train fares have increased this year.
Children travel for half fare.
The airline introduced a new range of low-cost fares.
Fare evasion is a serious offense on the subway system.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fare' قريبة من 'Fair' 'عادل'.. لازم تدفع 'Fare' 'أجرة' تكون 'Fair' عشان السواق ميزعلش.

armA.definition: A natural oily or greasy substance in animal bodies or food.
armA.arabic: الدهون اللي موجودة في الأكل أو في جسم الإنسان والحيوان.
examples: This meat has a lot of fat.
Butter is mostly made of fat.
The chef trimmed the excess fat from the steak.
armA.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'Fat' الصفة، بس هنا معناها المادة نفسها 'الدهون' اللي بتخلي الواحد 'Fat'.

armB.definition: A natural oily or greasy substance in animal bodies or food.
armB.arabic: الدهون اللي موجودة في الأكل أو في جسم الإنسان والحيوان.
examples: This meat has a lot of fat.
Butter is mostly made of fat.
I am trying to burn excess body fat.
Vegetable fats are often healthier than animal fats.
The chef trimmed the excess fat from the steak.
Fat is essential for absorbing certain vitamins.
armB.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'Fat' الصفة، بس هنا معناها المادة نفسها 'الدهون' اللي بتخلي الواحد 'Fat'.

armA.definition: To include someone or something as an important part.
armA.arabic: إنك تبرز حاجة أو تخليها جزء أساسي ومهم في العرض.
examples: The conference will feature speakers from around the world.
Most modern smartphones feature advanced camera systems.
Does the new film feature any famous actors?
armA.mnemonic: لما الفيلم يـ 'Feature' ممثل، يعني بيخليه هو 'الميزة' الأساسية.

armB.definition: To include someone or something as an important part.
armB.arabic: إنك تبرز حاجة أو تخليها جزء أساسي ومهم في العرض.
examples: The show features a dog.
This week's magazine features a story on health.
The exhibition features paintings by Picasso.
The new album features several guest artists.
The conference will feature speakers from around the world.
The landscape is featured prominently in her novels.
armB.mnemonic: لما الفيلم يـ 'Feature' ممثل، يعني بيخليه هو 'الميزة' الأساسية.

armA.definition: To go for and then bring back someone or something.
armA.arabic: تروح تجيب حاجة وترجع بيها. مشهورة جداً في اللعب مع الكلاب 'Go fetch'.
examples: Fetch the ball.
Can you fetch me a glass of water?
I have to go and fetch the kids from school.
The painting is expected to fetch a high price at auction.
This argument is a bit far-fetched (difficult to believe).
She sent him to fetch the doctor immediately.
armA.mnemonic: ارمي الكورة للكلب وقوله 'Fetch'.. يعني 'هاتها'.

armB.definition: To go for and then bring back someone or something.
armB.arabic: تروح تجيب حاجة وترجع بيها. مشهورة جداً في اللعب مع الكلاب 'Go fetch'.
examples: Can you fetch me a glass of water?
I have to go and fetch the kids from school.
She sent him to fetch the doctor immediately.
armB.mnemonic: ارمي الكورة للكلب وقوله 'Fetch'.. يعني 'هاتها'.

armA.definition: To calculate an amount or to think about and understand something.
armA.arabic: تحسب حاجة أو تفكر في موضوع عشان تفهمه وتلاقي له حل.
examples: Can you figure the cost?
I cannot figure out this puzzle.
We need to figure out how to get there.
I figured that he would be late.
They figured him for a hero, but he was a spy.
The risks were not figured into the final calculation.
armA.mnemonic: لما تقول 'Figure it out' يعني بتحاول تـ 'Fix' 'تصلح' المشكلة وتفهمها.

armB.definition: To calculate an amount or to think about and understand something.
armB.arabic: تحسب حاجة أو تفكر في موضوع عشان تفهمه وتلاقي له حل.
examples: Can you figure the total cost of the project?
We need to figure out how to get there on time.
I figure that we can finish the work before sunset.
armB.mnemonic: لما تقول 'Figure it out' يعني بتحاول تـ 'Fix' 'تصلح' المشكلة وتفهمها.

armA.definition: One of the five digits on the hand.
armA.arabic: صباع الإيد.
examples: I have ten fingers.
She pointed a finger at the door.
He cut his finger while cooking.
Don't lift a finger to help.
They keep their fingers on the pulse of the market.
Accusations were flying and everyone was pointing the finger.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Finger'.. زي 'Chicken Fingers' أصابع الفراخ.

armB.definition: One of the five digits on the hand.
armB.arabic: صباع الإيد.
examples: She pointed a finger at the door.
He cut his finger while cooking.
She wore a gold ring on her finger.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Finger'.. زي 'Chicken Fingers' أصابع الفراخ.

armA.definition: Used to introduce the first point in a list or sequence.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها لما نبدأ نعدد حاجات أو نقط، معناها 'أولاً'.
examples: Firstly, wash your hands.
Firstly, we need to buy tickets.
Firstly, I want to thank everyone for coming.
There are two reasons: firstly, cost, and secondly, time.
Firstly, the proposal is too expensive to implement.
We must consider, firstly, the economic impact of the decision.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'First' يعني الأول.. فـ 'Firstly' يعني أولاً.

armB.definition: Used to introduce the first point in a list or sequence.
armB.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها لما نبدأ نعدد حاجات أو نقط، معناها 'أولاً'.
examples: Firstly, we need to buy tickets.
Firstly, I want to thank everyone for coming.
There are two reasons: firstly, cost, and secondly, time.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'First' يعني الأول.. فـ 'Firstly' يعني أولاً.

armA.definition: An animal that lives in water, has fins and scales, and breathes through gills.
armA.arabic: الكائن البحري اللي بيعيش في الماية وبناكله.
examples: I like to eat fish.
The fish swam in the bowl.
We saw many colorful fish in the reef.
There are plenty more fish in the sea.
He felt like a fish out of water.
The taxonomy of these tropical fish is complex.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة سهلة وكلنا عارفينها.. 'Fish' يعني سمكة.

armB.definition: An animal that lives in water, has fins and scales, and breathes through gills, or its flesh eaten as food.
armB.arabic: حيوان يعيش في الماء له زعانف وخياشيم (سمكة)، أو لحمه الذي يُؤكل كطعام (سمك).
examples: I like to eat fish for dinner.
He caught a large fish in the river.
The fish swam slowly around the tank.

armA.definition: A sudden bright light that shines for a short time.
armA.arabic: ضوء قوي وسريع بيظهر ويختفي فجأة، زي فلاش الكاميرا أو البرق.
examples: I saw a flash of light.
Use the flash on your camera.
There was a flash of lightning in the sky.
A news flash interrupted the program.
He felt a sudden flash of anger.
The idea came to him in a flash of inspiration.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Flash' الكاميرا.. ضوء سريع وقوي.

armB.definition: A sudden bright light that shines for a short time.
armB.arabic: ضوء قوي وسريع بيظهر ويختفي فجأة، زي فلاش الكاميرا أو البرق.
examples: There was a flash of lightning in the sky.
He felt a sudden flash of anger.
The idea came to him in a flash of inspiration.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Flash' الكاميرا.. ضوء سريع وقوي.

armA.definition: To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.
armA.arabic: يزدهر وينمو بقوة.. لما مشروع أو زرعة تكبر وتنجح.
examples: Flowers grow in the sun.
The plant grows well here.
Business is starting to flourish.
The arts flourished during that period.
Under her leadership, the company flourished.
Bacteria flourish in warm, damp environments.
armA.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Flower' 'الوردة' لما تفتح وتكبر.. المشروع بيـ 'Flourish'.

armB.definition: To grow or develop in a healthy, vigorous, or highly successful way.
armB.arabic: يزدهر وينمو بقوة ونجاح، سواء كان ذلك لنبات، أو نشاط تجاري، أو شخص، أو مجتمع.
examples: Bacteria flourish in warm, damp environments.
Few businesses can flourish without proper financial planning.
The arts continue to flourish in this historic city.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Flower' (الوردة) لما تفتح وتكبر.. المشروع أو الكائن الحي بيـ 'Flourish' (يزدهر).

armA.definition: Having an affection or liking for someone or something.
armA.arabic: لما تكون بتحب حد أو حاجة ومعتز بيها، أو عندك ذكريات حلوة معاها.
examples: I am fond of cats.
She is fond of her grandmother.
He has fond memories of his childhood.
We bade each other a fond farewell.
She is overly fond of giving advice.
He harbored a fond hope that they would meet again.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fond' قريبة من 'Found' 'وجد'.. لما تلاقي حد بتحبه بتقول I found someone I am fond of.

armB.definition: Having an affection or liking for someone or something.
armB.arabic: لما تكون بتحب حد أو حاجة ومعتز بيها، أو عندك ذكريات حلوة معاها.
examples: I am fond of cats.
He has fond memories of his childhood.
We bade each other a fond farewell.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fond' قريبة من 'Found' 'وجد'.. لما تلاقي حد بتحبه بتقول I found someone I am fond of.

armA.definition: The act of creating, preparing, or expressing something in a systematic way, or a mixture prepared according to a formula.
armA.arabic: صياغة فكرة أو التعبير عنها بدقة ونظام، أو تركيبة محددة لمستحضر دوائي أو كيميائي.
examples: The formulation of company policy requires careful thought.
His precise formulation of the argument impressed the judges.
Doctors are testing a new vaccine formulation.
armA.mnemonic: مشتقة من كلمة 'formula' (معادلة أو وصفة تركيب)؛ فكلمة 'formulation' تعني إما صياغة الفكرة أو تركيبة الدواء.

armB.definition: The act of creating or preparing something, or a mixture prepared according to a formula.
armB.arabic: صياغة فكرة أو تركيبة دواء أو منتج. الطريقة اللي بتركب بيها الحاجات مع بعض عشان تطلع نتيجة.
examples: This is a new soap formulation.
The formulation of the plan took two days.
Doctors are testing a new vaccine formulation.
The formulation of company policy requires careful thought.
His precise formulation of the argument impressed the judges.
Complex chemical formulations are protected by strict patents.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Formula' يعني معادلة.. الـ 'Formulation' هي 'التركيبة' اللي بتعملها عشان تطلع دواء أو خطة.

armA.definition: Coming after the third in a series.
armA.arabic: الرابع في الترتيب، اللي بيجي بعد التالت.
examples: It is his fourth birthday.
They live on the fourth floor.
This is the fourth time I've seen this movie.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Four' 'أربعة'.. يبقى 'Fourth' يعني الرابع

armB.definition: Coming after the third in a series.
armB.arabic: الرابع في الترتيب، اللي بيجي بعد التالت.
examples: It is his fourth birthday.
They live on the fourth floor.
This is the fourth time I've seen this movie.
The fourth of July is a holiday in the US.
The press is often called the fourth estate.
He broke the fourth wall in his performance.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Four' 'أربعة'.. يبقى 'Fourth' يعني الرابع

armA.definition: A bird, especially one kept on a farm for its meat or eggs, or a wild bird hunted for food or sport.
armA.arabic: الطيور التي تُربى في المزارع للاستفادة من لحمها وبيضها (الدواجن)، أو الطيور البرية التي تُصاد للأكل.
examples: Chickens are a type of fowl.
They sell fish, meat, and fowl at the market.
The hunter returned with a brace of wild fowl.
armA.mnemonic: نفس نطق كلمة 'Foul' 'فاول في الكورة' بس المعنى مختلف.. هنا معناها طيور.

armB.definition: Birds that are kept on a farm for their eggs or meat (like chickens).
armB.arabic: الطيور اللي بتتربى في المزارع للأكل زي الفراخ والبط 'الدواجن'.
examples: We keep fowl on the farm.
Chickens are a type of fowl.
They sell fish, meat, and fowl at the market.
The disease affected the local water fowl.
The hunter returned with a brace of wild fowl.
Guinea fowl are considered a delicacy in some cuisines.
armB.mnemonic: نفس نطق كلمة 'Foul' 'فاول في الكورة' بس المعنى مختلف.. هنا معناها طيور.

armA.definition: Located at or near the most forward part of something.
armA.arabic: حاجة موجودة قدام، زي الباب الأمامي أو الكرسي الأمامي.
examples: Open the front door.
I want the front seat.
The front page of the newspaper covers the story.
He sustained an injury to his front teeth.
The front runner in the election is popular.
They launched a full frontal attack.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Front' 'مقدمة'.. صفة بتوصف أي حاجة إنها 'أمامية'.

armB.definition: Located at or near the most forward part of something.
armB.arabic: حاجة موجودة قدام، زي الباب الأمامي أو الكرسي الأمامي.
examples: Open the front door.
I want the front seat.
The front page of the newspaper covers the story.
armB.mnemonic: اربط front بكلمة forward (للأمام)؛ الاثنان يبدآن بـ fr- ويدلان على كل ما هو أمامي.

armA.definition: A line or border separating two countries; the extreme limit of understanding or achievement.
armA.arabic: الحدود الفاصلة بين بلدين، أو آخر مكان وصله الناس قبل المجهول، سواء في الأرض أو العلم.
examples: They crossed the frontier.
Soldiers guard the frontier.
Space is the final frontier.
We lived near the frontier with Canada.
Researchers are pushing back the frontiers of science.
The novel explores the harsh life on the American frontier.
armA.mnemonic: 'Front' 'أمام'.. الـ 'Frontier' هو الخط اللي في الـ 'Front' بينك وبين العالم الجديد.

armB.definition: A line or border separating two countries, or the extreme limit of settled land or achievement.
armB.arabic: الحدود الفاصلة بين بلدين، أو أقصى حدود الاستيطان والمعرفة قبل المجهول.
examples: We lived near the frontier with Canada.
Space is often described as the final frontier.
The novel explores the harsh life on the American frontier.
armB.mnemonic: 'Front' 'أمام'.. الـ 'Frontier' هو الخط اللي في الـ 'Front' بينك وبين العالم الجديد.

armA.definition: To prevent someone from achieving something, causing them to feel annoyed.
armA.arabic: إنك تحسس حد بالعجز أو الضيق عشان مش عارف يحقق اللي هو عايزه، أو إنك تبوظ خطة حد.
examples: His constant interruptions were designed to frustrate the speaker.
Such unexpected delays will only frustrate the passengers waiting at the gate.
Bureaucratic regulations can frustrate attempts to reform the current system.
armA.mnemonic: لما تكون 'Frustrated' 'محبط'، بتبقى عايز تخرج الـ 'Rust' 'الصدأ' والضيق اللي جواك.

armB.definition: To prevent someone from achieving something, causing them to feel annoyed.
armB.arabic: إنك تحسس حد بالعجز أو الضيق عشان مش عارف يحقق اللي هو عايزه، أو إنك تبوظ خطة حد.
examples: Don't frustrate me.
The game frustrates him.
Bad weather frustrated our plans.
It frustrates me when the internet is slow.
His constant questions were designed to frustrate the speaker.
The complex legal system often frustrates attempts at reform.
armB.mnemonic: لما تكون 'Frustrated' 'محبط'، بتبقى عايز تخرج الـ 'Rust' 'الصدأ' والضيق اللي جواك.

armA.definition: Enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure.
armA.arabic: المرح والمتعة والشعور بالسعادة والانبساط.
examples: We had fun at the park.
Swimming is great fun.
It's no fun waiting for the bus in the rain.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fun' قريبة من كلمة 'فَن' بالعربي، والفنون دائماً مصدر للمتعة والـ Fun.

armB.definition: Enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure.
armB.arabic: المرح والمتعة، إنك تتبسط وتضحك.
examples: We had fun at the park.
Swimming is great fun.
It's no fun waiting for the bus in the rain.
She's full of fun and energy.
They poked fun at his strange hat.
The satire was all in good fun, meant to entertain rather than offend.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fun' قريبة من 'فَن'.. الفنون دايماً فيها 'Fun' ومتعة.

armA.definition: A break or space in an object or between two objects; a difference.
armA.arabic: الفجوة أو الفراغ اللي بين حاجتين، أو الفرق الكبير بين مستويين.
examples: There is a gap in the fence.
Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
There is a big age gap between them.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Gap' هي الفتحة أو الفراغ اللي بين حاجتين.. زي الـ 'Gap' بين الأسنان.

armB.definition: A break or space in an object or between two objects; a difference.
armB.arabic: الفجوة أو الفراغ اللي بين حاجتين، أو الفرق الكبير بين مستويين.
examples: There is a gap in the fence.
Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
There is a big age gap between them.
The gap between rich and poor is widening.
We need to bridge the gap between theory and practice.
The data has a significant gap that explains the error.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Gap' هي الفتحة أو الفراغ اللي بين حاجتين.. زي الـ 'Gap' بين الأسنان.

armA.definition: Refined petroleum used as fuel for internal combustion engines.
armA.arabic: الوقود السائل 'البنزين' اللي بنحطه في العربيات عشان الموتور يشتغل.
examples: The car needs gasoline.
Gasoline is expensive today.
He filled the tank with gasoline.
The engine runs on unleaded gasoline.
Gasoline prices fluctuate with the oil market.
The combustion of gasoline releases carbon dioxide.
armA.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'Gas'.. السائل اللي بيتحول لطاقة.

armB.definition: Refined petroleum used as fuel for internal combustion engines, especially in motor vehicles.
armB.arabic: الوقود السائل المستخرج من البترول (البنزين) والمستخدم لتشغيل محركات السيارات والمركبات.
examples: He stopped at the station to fill the tank with gasoline.
The car stopped because it ran out of gasoline.
The engine was designed to run on unleaded gasoline.
armB.mnemonic: In American English, 'gasoline' is often shortened to 'gas'—the fuel that keeps your car on the line and moving forward.

armA.definition: A sudden, short intake of breath, as in shock or surprise.
armA.arabic: الشهقة اللي بتطلع منك فجأة لما تتخض أو تتفاجأ بحاجة.
examples: She gave a loud gasp.
He let out a gasp of surprise.
There was a collective gasp from the audience.
She took a sharp gasp of air.
His last gasp was one of relief.
The dying industry is on its last gasp.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Gas' 'غاز'.. لما تشم ريحة غاز قوية بتعمل 'Gasp' وتكتم نفسك.

armB.definition: A sudden, short intake of breath, as in shock or surprise.
armB.arabic: الشهقة اللي بتطلع منك فجأة لما تتخض أو تتفاجأ بحاجة.
examples: He let out a gasp of surprise.
There was a collective gasp from the audience.
She took a sharp gasp of air.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر 'Gas' 'غاز'.. لما تشم ريحة غاز قوية بتعمل 'Gasp' وتكتم نفسك.

armA.definition: Made of gold, or having the yellow color of gold.
armA.arabic: حاجة مصنوعة من الذهب، أو لونها دهبي.
examples: She wears a gold watch.
The gold paint looks nice.
The team wore gold uniforms.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Gold' 'دهب'.. صفة لأي حاجة 'ذهبية'.

armB.definition: Made of gold, or having the yellow color of gold.
armB.arabic: حاجة مصنوعة من الذهب، أو لونها دهبي.
examples: She wears a gold watch.
The gold paint looks nice.
I have a gold credit card.
The team wore gold uniforms.
It was a gold standard for the industry.
The sunset turned the sky a deep gold.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Gold' 'دهب'.. صفة لأي حاجة 'ذهبية'.

armA.definition: That which is morally right; righteousness.
armA.arabic: الخير نفسه، عكس الشر. أو ممكن تيجي بمعنى الفايدة والمصلحة.
examples: Good always wins in stories.
Do good and good will come to you.
We must work for the common good.
There is a lot of good in him.
The debate between good and evil is eternal.
Utilitarianism focuses on the greatest good for the greatest number.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Good' قريبة من 'Gold' 'ذهب'.. الذهب معدن 'Good' وقيمته عالية.

armB.definition: That which is morally right, beneficial, or of value.
armB.arabic: الخير نفسه، عكس الشر. أو ممكن تيجي بمعنى الفايدة والمصلحة.
examples: There is a lot of good in him.
We must work together for the common good.
The story explores the battle between good and evil.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Good' قريبة من 'Gold' 'ذهب'.. الذهب معدن 'Good' وقيمته عالية.

armA.definition: A firm hold or grip; mental understanding of something.
armA.arabic: يا إما مسكة قوية بالإيد، يا إما استيعاب وفهم كامل لموضوع معين.
examples: He has a strong grasp.
The baby's grasp is tight.
Success is within our grasp.
She has a good grasp of French.
He failed to loosen his grasp on reality.
Her grasp of quantum physics implies years of study.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Grab' 'يمسك'.. الـ 'Grasp' هي المسكة القوية أو إنك تمسك الفكرة بعقلك وتفهمها.

armB.definition: A firm hold or grip; a comprehensive mental understanding of something.
armB.arabic: إما مسكة أو قبضة قوية باليد، وإما فهم واستيعاب كامل لموضوع معين.
examples: She has a good grasp of French grammar.
Victory is finally within our grasp after months of preparation.
He kept a firm grasp on the railing as the boat rocked.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر 'Grab' (يمسك).. الـ 'Grasp' هي المسكة القوية بإيدك، أو إنك تمسك الفكرة بعقلك وتفهمها كويس.

armA.definition: Feeling or showing thanks to someone; appreciative.
armA.arabic: يعني تكون ممتن وشاكر لحد عمل معاك واجب أو ساعدك.
examples: I am grateful for your help.
She gave him a grateful smile.
We are deeply grateful to all the staff.
He was grateful for the opportunity to travel.
I am eternally grateful for your timely intervention.
The refugees were grateful for the sanctuary provided by the church.
armA.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Great'.. لما حد يعمل معاك حاجة 'Great' عظيمة، لازم تكون 'Grateful' ليه.

armB.definition: Feeling or showing thanks to someone; appreciative.
armB.arabic: يعني تكون ممتن وشاكر لحد عمل معاك واجب أو ساعدك.
examples: I am grateful for your help.
She gave him a grateful smile.
We are deeply grateful to all the staff.
armB.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Great'.. لما حد يعمل معاك حاجة 'Great' عظيمة، لازم تكون 'Grateful' ليه.

armA.definition: To take and keep a firm hold of; grasp tightly.
armA.arabic: يمسك حاجة جامد، أو يسيطر على انتباه حد.
examples: Grip the handle tightly.
She gripped my hand in fear.
The tires gripped the wet road well.
Panic gripped the crowd when the fire started.
I was gripped by the exciting plot of the movie.
The nation was gripped by a sense of impending crisis.
armA.mnemonic: زي الاسم بالظبط، 'Grip' يعني يكلبش في الحاجة.

armB.definition: To take and keep a firm hold of; grasp tightly.
armB.arabic: يمسك حاجة جامد، أو يسيطر على انتباه حد.
examples: Make sure you grip the steering wheel firmly when driving on icy roads.
A sudden feeling of panic began to grip the passengers as the turbulence worsened.
The dramatic thriller will grip audiences from the opening scene to the final twist.
armB.translations: يُمْسِك بِقُوَّة يستحوذ على يسيطر على
armB.mnemonic: افتكر كلمة grab (يمسك)؛ كلمة grip قريبة منها جداً في الصوت والمعنى: يمسك بقوة أو يكلبش في حاجة.

armA.definition: The solid surface of the earth.
armA.arabic: السطح الصلب للأرض الذي نمشي أو نقف عليه.
examples: He sat on the ground.
The ground was wet after the rain.
He dropped his keys on the ground.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Ground' قريبة من 'Round'.. الأرض اللي بنمشي عليها جزء من كوكب 'Round' (مدوّر).

armB.definition: The solid surface of the earth.
armB.arabic: الأرض اللي بنمشي عليها. السطح الصلب للكوكب.
examples: He sat on the ground.
The ground was wet after the rain.
We need to cover a lot of ground today.
They found common ground in the negotiation.
The project got off the ground successfully.
His arguments were built on shaky ground.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Ground' قريبة من 'Round'.. الأرض اللي بنمشي عليها جزء من كوكب 'Round' 'مدور'.

armA.definition: A formal promise or assurance that certain conditions will be fulfilled.
armA.arabic: الضمان.. الوعد إن الحاجة دي كويسة ولو باظت تتصلح أو تتبدل
examples: The watch has a two-year guarantee.
We offer a money-back guarantee.
There is no guarantee that it will work.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Guard' 'حارس'.. الضمان 'Guarantee' بيحرس حقك وفلوسك

armB.definition: A formal promise or assurance that certain conditions will be fulfilled.
armB.arabic: الضمان.. الوعد إن الحاجة دي كويسة ولو باظت تتصلح أو تتبدل
examples: Is there a guarantee?
The watch has a two-year guarantee.
There is no guarantee that it will work.
We offer a money-back guarantee.
The constitution provides a guarantee of free speech.
His past success is no guarantee of future performance.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Guard' 'حارس'.. الضمان 'Guarantee' بيحرس حقك وفلوسك

armA.definition: Covered with a lot of hair.
armA.arabic: جسمه مليان شعر، أو وصف لحاجة فيها شعر كتير.
examples: The dog is very hairy.
He has a hairy chest.
Spiders have hairy legs.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Hair' 'شعر'.. واضحة جداً

armB.definition: Covered with a lot of hair.
armB.arabic: جسمه مليان شعر، أو وصف لحاجة فيها شعر كتير.
examples: The dog is very hairy.
He has a hairy chest.
Spiders have hairy legs.
It was a hairy drive down the mountain.
The caterpillar is small and hairy.
The pilot managed to land the plane after a hairy descent.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Hair' 'شعر'.. واضحة جداً

armA.definition: Of great weight; difficult to lift or move.
armA.arabic: حاجة وزنها تقيل وصعب تشيلها، أو حاجة كميتها كبيرة.
examples: This box is very heavy.
There was heavy rain yesterday.
Traffic is heavy this morning.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Heave' يعني يرفع بصعوبة.. الحاجة الـ 'Heavy' محتاجة 'Heave'.

armB.definition: Of great weight; difficult to lift or move.
armB.arabic: حاجة وزنها تقيل وصعب تشيلها، أو حاجة كميتها كبيرة.
examples: This box is very heavy.
There was heavy rain yesterday.
Traffic is heavy this morning.
He paid a heavy price for his mistake.
The air was heavy with the scent of flowers.
The novel is a bit heavy going for casual readers.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Heave' يعني يرفع بصعوبة.. الحاجة الـ 'Heavy' محتاجة 'Heave'.

armA.definition: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.
armA.arabic: عاجز ومش قادر يساعد نفسه، محتاج حد يقف جنبه.
examples: The baby is helpless.
I felt helpless without my phone.
She gave a helpless shrug.
The injured animal lay helpless on the road.
He was helpless against the overwhelming force of the storm.
The bureaucracy made us feel utterly helpless and frustrated.
armA.mnemonic: 'Help' 'مساعدة' + '-less' 'بدون'.. يعني بدون مساعدة، مش قادر يساعد نفسه.

armB.definition: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.
armB.arabic: عاجز ومش قادر يساعد نفسه أو يدافع عنها، ومحتاج حد يقف جنبه.
examples: The injured animal lay helpless on the road.
He was helpless against the overwhelming force of the storm.
The bureaucracy made us feel utterly helpless and frustrated.
armB.mnemonic: 'Help' 'مساعدة' + '-less' 'بدون'.. يعني بدون مساعدة، مش قادر يساعد نفسه.

armA.definition: In, at, or to this place or position.
armA.arabic: هنا، في المكان اللي إحنا فيه دلوقتي.
examples: Come here.
I live near here.
Here is the money I owe you.
armA.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Hear' يسمع.. أنا قادر أسمعك 'Here' في المكان ده.

armB.definition: In, at, or to this place or position.
armB.arabic: هنا، في المكان اللي إحنا فيه دلوقتي.
examples: Come here.
I live near here.
Here is the money I owe you.
Look here, we need to solve this problem.
Here lies the difficulty of the situation.
Herein lies the proof of his innocence.
armB.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Hear' يسمع.. أنا قادر أسمعك 'Here' في المكان ده.

armA.definition: A person admired for courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.
armA.arabic: البطل، شخص الناس بتحبه وبتحترمه عشان شجاعته أو أعماله العظيمة.
examples: He is my hero.
She became a national hero after winning the gold medal.
The firefighter was praised as a hero for saving the child.
armA.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Super-hero'.. البطل اللي عنده قدرات خارقة.

armB.definition: A person admired for courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.
armB.arabic: البطل، شخص الناس بتحبه وبتحترمه عشان شجاعته أو أعماله العظيمة.
examples: He is my hero.
The movie is about a superhero.
Firefighters are often seen as heroes.
She became a national hero after winning the gold medal.
The protagonist is an anti-hero in this novel.
His hero worship of the singer was obsessive.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Super-hero'.. البطل اللي عنده قدرات خارقة.

armA.definition: A system where members are ranked according to relative status or authority.
armA.arabic: التسلسل الهرمي، نظام بيرتب الناس أو الحاجات فوق بعض حسب الأهمية أو السلطة 'مدير، مشرف، موظف'.
examples: The social hierarchy was very strict.
Maslow's hierarchy of needs explains human motivation.
They challenged the established political hierarchy.
armA.mnemonic: أولها 'High' 'عالي'.. الـ 'Hierarchy' هو النظام اللي فيه ناس 'Higher' من ناس

armB.definition: A system where members are ranked according to relative status or authority.
armB.arabic: التسلسل الهرمي، نظام بيرتب الناس أو الحاجات فوق بعض حسب الأهمية أو السلطة 'مدير، مشرف، موظف'.
examples: The boss is top of the hierarchy.
Every army has a hierarchy.
He is low in the company hierarchy.
The social hierarchy was very strict.
Maslow's hierarchy of needs explains human motivation.
They challenged the established political hierarchy.
armB.mnemonic: أولها 'High' 'عالي'.. الـ 'Hierarchy' هو النظام اللي فيه ناس 'Higher' من ناس

armA.definition: To emphasize something or make people notice it.
armA.arabic: يبرز أهمية حاجة أو يعلم عليها بقلم فسفوري عشان تبان.
examples: Please highlight the correct answer.
She highlighted the important words in the text.
The teacher highlighted the mistakes in my essay.
The report highlights the need for better safety.
The speech highlighted the growing gap between rich and poor.
Recent events have highlighted the fragility of the peace process.
armA.mnemonic: بتخلي الحاجة 'High' في الأهمية لما تحط عليها 'Light'.

armB.definition: To emphasize something or make people notice it.
armB.arabic: يبرز أهمية حاجة أو يعلم عليها بقلم فسفوري عشان تبان.
examples: Please highlight the correct answer on your worksheet.
We want to highlight the main benefits of this new program.
The conference aims to highlight the challenges facing public education.
armB.translations: يسلط الضوء على يبرز يعلم بقلم تمييز
armB.mnemonic: بتخلي الحاجة 'High' في الأهمية لما تحط عليها 'Light'.

armA.definition: Having an empty space inside; not solid.
armA.arabic: مجوَّف.. يعني فاضي من جوا مش مصمت، زي الماسورة أو جذع شجرة فاضي
examples: The ball is hollow inside.
Owls often live in hollow trees.
It was a hollow victory because nobody celebrated.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hollow' أولها 'Hole'.. يعني جواها خرم أو فراغ كبير

armB.definition: Having an empty space inside; not solid.
armB.arabic: مجوَّف.. يعني فاضي من جوا مش مصمت، زي الماسورة أو جذع شجرة فاضي
examples: The ball is hollow inside.
Owls often live in hollow trees.
His voice sounded hollow in the empty room.
It was a hollow victory because nobody celebrated.
She felt a hollow emptiness in her chest after he left.
The politician's promises turned out to be hollow.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hollow' أولها 'Hole'.. يعني جواها خرم أو فراغ كبير

armA.definition: Unfriendly or aggressive behavior or opposition.
armA.arabic: العداء أو الخصومة، لما حد يكون بيعامل حد تاني بطريقة وحشة وعدوانية.
examples: She looked at him with hostility.
There is growing public hostility towards the new tax law.
The meeting was marred by open hostility between the two leaders.
armA.mnemonic: عكس كلمة 'Hospitality' 'كرم الضيافة'.. الـ 'Hostility' هي سوء المعاملة والعداء.

armB.definition: Unfriendly or aggressive behavior or opposition.
armB.arabic: العداء أو الخصومة، لما حد يكون بيعامل حد تاني بطريقة وحشة وعدوانية.
examples: There is hostility between them.
She looked at him with hostility.
The hostility of the crowd was frightening.
They ceased hostilities after the peace treaty.
There is growing public hostility towards the new tax law.
The meeting was marred by open hostility between the two leaders.
armB.mnemonic: عكس كلمة 'Hospitality' 'كرم الضيافة'.. الـ 'Hostility' هي سوء المعاملة والعداء.

armA.definition: To intentionally not listen or give attention to.
armA.arabic: يتجاهل أو يطنش، يعني يعمل نفسه مش شايف أو مش سامع.
examples: Don't ignore me.
He ignored the sign.
I tried to ignore the noise.
She ignored his advice completely.
We cannot afford to ignore these warnings.
It is perilous to ignore the lessons of history.
armA.mnemonic: 'Ignorant' يعني 'جاهل'.. لما تعمل 'Ignore' لحد كأنك 'تجهل' وجوده.

armB.definition: To intentionally not listen or give attention to.
armB.arabic: يتجاهل أو يطنش، يعني يعمل نفسه مش شايف أو مش سامع.
examples: Don't ignore me.
I tried to ignore the noise.
We cannot afford to ignore these warnings.
armB.mnemonic: 'Ignorant' يعني 'جاهل'.. لما تعمل 'Ignore' لحد كأنك 'تجهل' وجوده.

armA.definition: A picture illustrating a book or newspaper, or an example that clarifies something.
armA.arabic: صورة بتترسم عشان توضح فكرة في كتاب أو مجلة، أو مثال بيتشرح عشان يسهل الفهم.
examples: The illustration shows how the machine works.
Let me give you an illustration of what I mean.
The incident serves as a graphic illustration of the dangers involved.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Illustrate' يعني يوضح.. الـ 'Illustration' هي الصورة اللي بتوضح المعنى.

armB.definition: A picture illustrating a book or newspaper, or an example that clarifies something.
armB.arabic: صورة بتترسم عشان توضح فكرة في كتاب أو مجلة، أو مثال بيتشرح عشان يسهل الفهم.
examples: This book has a nice illustration.
The illustration shows how the machine works.
She is studying fashion illustration at college.
Let me give you an illustration of what I mean.
The incident serves as a graphic illustration of the dangers involved.
His argument was supported by the illustration of several historical precedents.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Illustrate' يعني يوضح.. الـ 'Illustration' هي الصورة اللي بتوضح المعنى.

armA.definition: Visually descriptive or figurative language, especially in a literary work.
armA.arabic: الصور البلاغية أو التشبيهات اللي الكاتب بيستخدمها عشان يخليك تتخيل المشهد كأنك شايفه بعينك.
examples: The poem's dark imagery reflects the author's sadness.
Her writing is full of colorful imagery.
Religious imagery is pervasive throughout Renaissance art.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Image' 'صورة'.. الـ 'Imagery' هو استخدام الكلام لرسم 'Images' في خيالك.

armB.definition: Visually descriptive or figurative language, especially in a literary work.
armB.arabic: الصور البلاغية أو التشبيهات اللي الكاتب بيستخدمها عشان يخليك تتخيل المشهد كأنك شايفه بعينك.
examples: The book has nice imagery.
The poet uses imagery of nature.
Her writing is full of colorful imagery.
The movie uses computer imagery to create monsters.
The poem's dark imagery reflects the author's sadness.
Religious imagery is pervasive throughout Renaissance art.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Image' 'صورة'.. الـ 'Imagery' هو استخدام الكلام لرسم 'Images' في خيالك.

armA.definition: To put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
armA.arabic: ينفذ خطة أو قرار ويطبقه على أرض الواقع.
examples: We need to implement the plan.
It will take time to implement these changes.
They failed to implement the recommendations of the committee.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Imply'.. بس هنا معناها تنفذ الخطة وتطبقها.

armB.definition: To put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
armB.arabic: ينفذ خطة أو قرار ويطبقه على أرض الواقع.
examples: They implement the rule.
We need to implement the plan.
The government implemented new tax laws.
It will take time to implement these changes.
They failed to implement the recommendations of the committee.
The treaty was never fully implemented due to political unrest.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Imply'.. بس هنا معناها تنفذ الخطة وتطبقها.

armA.definition: To bring goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.
armA.arabic: يستورد، يعني يشتري بضاعة من دولة تانية ويدخلها بلده.
examples: We import tea from China.
They import cars from Germany.
The country has to import most of its oil.
It is cheaper to import these parts than to make them.
The software allows you to import data from other files.
They were accused of illegally importing endangered species.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم: 'In' + 'Port'.. يدخل البضاعة الميناء.

armB.definition: To bring goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.
armB.arabic: يستورد: يشتري بضائع أو خدمات من دولة أخرى ويدخلها إلى بلده لبيعها أو استخدامها.
examples: They import cars from Germany.
The country has to import most of its oil.
It is cheaper to import these parts than to make them.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الكلمة: In + Port.. إدخال البضائع إلى الميناء (Port) داخل البلد (In).

armA.definition: Happening as a minor accompaniment to something else; not the main part.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتحصل بالصدفة أو كشيء جانبي مش أساسي مع حاجة تانية.
examples: Any resemblance to real persons is purely incidental.
The discovery was incidental to their main research.
Cognitive development is not merely incidental to physical growth.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Incident' 'حادثة/واقعة'.. الـ 'Incidental' هو الشيء العارِض اللي بيحصل على الهامش.

armB.definition: Happening as a minor accompaniment to something else; not the main part.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتحصل بالصدفة أو كشيء جانبي مش أساسي مع حاجة تانية.
examples: Small costs are incidental.
The problem was incidental to the main issue.
We have some incidental expenses on the trip.
Any resemblance to real persons is purely incidental.
The discovery was incidental to their main research.
Cognitive development is not merely incidental to physical growth.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Incident' 'حادثة/واقعة'.. الـ 'Incidental' هو الشيء العارِض اللي بيحصل على الهامش.

armA.definition: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
armA.arabic: أصلي أو بلدي. بتتقال على السكان الأصليين لبلد، أو النباتات والحيوانات اللي نشأت في مكان معين طبيعياً.
examples: The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
This plant is indigenous to Mexico.
The government protected the rights of indigenous tribes.
armA.mnemonic: أولها 'Indi'.. فكر في 'Indian' 'الهنود الحمر' هما الـ 'Indigenous' 'السكان الأصليين' لأمريكا.

armB.definition: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
armB.arabic: أصلي أو بلدي. بتتقال على السكان الأصليين لبلد، أو النباتات والحيوانات اللي نشأت في مكان معين طبيعياً.
examples: Indigenous people live here.
This plant is indigenous to Mexico.
We learned about the indigenous culture.
The government protected the rights of indigenous tribes.
The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
Globalization poses a threat to many indigenous languages and traditions.
armB.mnemonic: أولها 'Indi'.. فكر في 'Indian' 'الهنود الحمر' هما الـ 'Indigenous' 'السكان الأصليين' لأمريكا.

armA.definition: A person or animal that lives in or occupies a place.
armA.arabic: الشخص أو الحيوان اللي عايش ومستقر في مكان معين، زي سكان المدينة أو سكان الغابة.
examples: The oldest inhabitant of the town turned 100.
Every inhabitant of the village signed the petition.
As a lifelong inhabitant of the city, he knows all of its hidden streets.
armA.mnemonic: 'In' 'في' + 'Habit' 'عادة'.. الناس اللي من عادتهم يعيشوا 'في' المكان ده.

armB.definition: A person or animal that lives in or occupies a place.
armB.arabic: الشخص أو الحيوان اللي عايش ومستقر في مكان معين، زي سكان المدينة أو سكان الغابة.
examples: The inhabitants of the village are friendly.
How many inhabitants does the city have?
The island has no human inhabitants.
The oldest inhabitant of the town turned 100.
The inhabitants complained about the noise pollution.
Indigenous inhabitants often have rights to the land.
armB.mnemonic: 'In' 'في' + 'Habit' 'عادة'.. الناس اللي من عادتهم يعيشوا 'في' المكان ده.

armA.definition: The ability to assess and start things independently, or a new plan to achieve a goal.
armA.arabic: القدرة إنك تاخد خطوة وتبدأ حاجة من نفسك من غير ما حد يقولك، أو خطة جديدة لحل مشكلة.
examples: He has no initiative.
She took the initiative to clean the room.
We need a new initiative to help the poor.
You should use your own initiative at work.
The peace initiative was welcomed by both sides.
The company lost the initiative to its agile competitors.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'In it'.. عشان تنجح في أي مشروع لازم تكون 'In it' وتاخد الـ 'Initiative' بنفسك.

armB.definition: The ability to assess and start things independently, or a new plan to achieve a goal.
armB.arabic: القدرة إنك تاخد خطوة وتبدأ حاجة من نفسك من غير ما حد يقولك، أو خطة جديدة لحل مشكلة.
examples: She took the initiative to clean the room.
You should use your own initiative at work.
The peace initiative was welcomed by both sides.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'In it'.. عشان تنجح في أي مشروع لازم تكون 'In it' وتاخد الـ 'Initiative' بنفسك.

armA.definition: The action or process of innovating; a new method, idea, or product.
armA.arabic: الابتكار، إنك تعمل حاجة جديدة خالص أو تطور حاجة موجودة بطريقة ذكية.
examples: This phone is a great innovation.
We need innovation to grow.
Technological innovation is changing the world.
The company is known for its product innovation.
Innovation is the key to economic success.
Disruptive innovation can completely reshape an industry.
armA.mnemonic: 'In' 'في' + 'Nova' 'نوفا/جديد'.. إنك تجيب حاجة 'Nova' يعني بتعمل 'Innovation'.

armB.definition: The action or process of innovating; a new method, idea, or product.
armB.arabic: الابتكار، إنك تعمل حاجة جديدة خالص أو تطور حاجة موجودة بطريقة ذكية.
examples: Technological innovation is changing the way we live.
The company is known for its product innovation.
We need continuous innovation to stay competitive in the market.
armB.mnemonic: 'In' 'في' + 'Nova' 'نوفا/جديد'.. إنك تجيب حاجة 'Nova' يعني بتعمل 'Innovation'.

armA.definition: The action of inserting something.
armA.arabic: عملية إدخال أو إدراج حاجة جوه حاجة تانية، زي إضافة كلمة في نص أو وضع شريحة في جهاز.
examples: The insertion of the key opened the door.
Check the insertion of the battery.
The insertion of a new clause changed the contract.
Surgical insertion of the device took two hours.
The text required the insertion of several footnotes.
The strategic insertion of troops turned the tide of the battle.
armA.mnemonic: الفعل 'Insert' 'يدخل'.. الـ 'Insertion' هي عملية الإدخال نفسها.

armB.definition: The action of inserting something.
armB.arabic: عملية إدخال أو إدراج حاجة جوه حاجة تانية، زي إضافة كلمة في نص أو وضع شريحة في جهاز.
examples: The insertion of a new clause changed the contract.
Surgical insertion of the device took two hours.
The text required the insertion of several footnotes.
armB.mnemonic: الفعل 'Insert' يعني يدخل أو يدرج، واللاحقة '-ion' تحوله لاسم، فـ 'Insertion' هي عملية الإدخال أو الإدراج نفسها.

armA.definition: An example or single occurrence of something.
armA.arabic: مثال أو حالة معينة لحاجة حصلت.
examples: In this particular instance, we can make an exception.
This is a rare instance of success.
For instance, look at this picture.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Instance' قريبة من 'Instant'.. يعني لحظة أو حالة حصلت دلوقتي.

armB.definition: An example or single occurrence of something.
armB.arabic: مثال أو حالة معينة لحاجة حصلت.
examples: Show me an instance.
For instance, look at this picture.
This is a rare instance of success.
In this particular instance, we can make an exception.
There are many instances where this rule applies.
It was a glaring instance of political corruption.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Instance' قريبة من 'Instant'.. يعني لحظة أو حالة حصلت دلوقتي.

armA.definition: Happening immediately; prepared very quickly.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتحصل فوراً من غير تأخير، أو بتجهز بسرعة جداً.
examples: I like instant coffee.
She sent an instant message.
The book was an instant success.
He felt an instant attraction to her.
The medication provided instant relief from the pain.
Modern technology allows for instant global communication.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Instagram' مليان صور 'Instant' لحظية وفورية.

armB.definition: Happening immediately; prepared very quickly.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتحصل فوراً من غير تأخير، أو بتجهز بسرعة جداً.
examples: The book was an instant success.
The medication provided instant relief from the pain.
Modern technology allows for instant global communication.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Instagram' مليان صور 'Instant' لحظية وفورية.

armA.definition: Intention or purpose.
armA.arabic: النية أو القصد من فعل شيء معين.
examples: It was not my intent to hurt you.
The intent of the law is to protect citizens.
He was charged with possession with intent to supply.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intend' 'ينوي'.. الـ 'Intent' هي النية نفسها.

armB.definition: Intention or purpose.
armB.arabic: النية أو القصد من فعل شيء معين.
examples: It was not my intent to hurt you.
He explained his intent.
She acted with good intent.
The intent of the law is to protect citizens.
He was charged with possession with intent to supply.
The author's original intent has been lost in translation.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intend' 'ينوي'.. الـ 'Intent' هي النية نفسها.

armA.definition: To explain the meaning of something or translate speech orally.
armA.arabic: لما تترجم كلام حد فوري، أو تشرح وتفسر معنى حاجة غامضة للناس.
examples: Can you interpret this sign?
He interprets for the tourists.
How do you interpret this poem?
Data can be interpreted in many ways.
I interpreted his silence as agreement.
The law was interpreted strictly by the judge.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. المترجم بيدخل 'In' بين الطرفين عشان يعمل 'Interpret' 'يفسر' ويوصل المعنى.

armB.definition: To explain the meaning of something or translate speech orally.
armB.arabic: لما تترجم كلام حد فوري، أو تشرح وتفسر معنى حاجة غامضة للناس.
examples: Can you interpret this sign?
How do you interpret this poem?
She was hired to interpret for the international delegates.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. المترجم بيدخل 'In' بين الطرفين عشان يعمل 'Interpret' 'يفسر' ويوصل المعنى.

armA.definition: Not taking into account; regardless of.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها لما نقول إن في حاجة هتحصل مهما كانت الظروف أو العوامل التانية.
examples: Everyone can come, irrespective of age.
We play outside irrespective of the weather.
The rules apply to everyone, irrespective of their job.
The bonus is paid irrespective of the company's profits.
We must uphold human rights irrespective of political differences.
The law mandates equal treatment irrespective of race, creed, or color.
armA.mnemonic: 'Ir-' نفي + 'Respective' اعتبار.. يعني من غير أي اعتبار للظروف، 'بغض النظر'.

armB.definition: Not taking into account; regardless of.
armB.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها لما نقول إن في حاجة هتحصل مهما كانت الظروف أو العوامل التانية.
examples: Everyone can come, irrespective of age.
The rules apply to everyone, irrespective of their job.
The law mandates equal treatment irrespective of race, creed, or color.
armB.translations: بغض النظر عن بصرف النظر عن دون اعتبار لـ
armB.mnemonic: 'Ir-' نفي + 'Respective' اعتبار.. يعني من غير أي اعتبار للظروف، 'بغض النظر'.

armA.definition: An unhappy and angry feeling caused by wanting what someone else has, or fearing that someone you love will prefer another person.
armA.arabic: الغيرة، لما تحس بضيق عشان حد عنده حاجة مش عندك أو خايف حد ياخد مكانك.
examples: Feelings of jealousy can destroy a healthy relationship.
She tried to hide her jealousy when he talked to other girls.
His professional jealousy prevented him from praising his colleague.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Jealous'.. ممكن نقول 'Jealousy' زي 'Jail'.. الغيرة بتحطك في سجن أفكارك.

armB.definition: The state or feeling of being jealous.
armB.arabic: الغيرة، لما تحس بضيق عشان حد عنده حاجة مش عندك أو خايف حد ياخد مكانك.
examples: He felt jealousy.
Her jealousy caused problems.
Jealousy can destroy a relationship.
She tried to hide her jealousy when he talked to other girls.
His professional jealousy prevented him from praising his colleague.
Othello is a classic tragedy about the destructive power of jealousy.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Jealous'.. ممكن نقول 'Jealousy' زي 'Jail'.. الغيرة بتحطك في سجن أفكارك.

armA.definition: A member of the people and cultural community whose traditional religion is Judaism.
armA.arabic: شخص يتبع الديانة اليهودية أو ينتمي إلى الشعب اليهودي.
examples: As a practicing Jew, he observes the Sabbath from Friday evening to Saturday night.
She spoke about her experience growing up as a secular Jew in a diverse city.
Every Jew in the congregation participated in the annual holiday service.

armB.definition: A member of the people and cultural community whose traditional religion is Judaism.
armB.arabic: شخص بيتبع الديانة اليهودية أو بينتمي للشعب اليهودي.
examples: He is a Jew.
Jews celebrate Hanukkah.
She learned about the history of the Jews.
The museum honors Jews who fought in the war.
Orthodox Jews follow strict dietary laws.
The diaspora of the Jews is a major historical subject.

armA.definition: A person or thing that kills; informally, something very difficult or impressive.
armA.arabic: الشخص أو الشيء الذي يقتل، وفي التعبير العامي يُطلق على أمر صعب للغاية أو مجهد أو مذهل.
examples: The police are looking for the killer.
Heart disease is the silent killer in modern society.
That math exam was a real killer.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Kill' يقتل.. الـ 'Killer' هو القاتل.

armB.definition: A person or thing that kills; informally, something very difficult or impressive.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيقتل. وفي الكلام العامي ممكن تتقال على حاجة صعبة جداً 'زي امتحان قاتل' أو حاجة جامدة جداً.
examples: The killer was caught.
Smoking is a major killer.
The police are looking for the killer.
That math exam was a real killer.
Heart disease is the silent killer in modern society.
The comedian's opening joke was a killer; everyone laughed.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Kill' يقتل.. الـ 'Killer' هو القاتل.

armA.definition: To a great extent; mostly or mainly.
armA.arabic: بمعنى 'إلى حد كبير' أو 'في الغالب'.. لما تكون الحاجة دي هي السبب الرئيسي.
examples: The success was largely due to her effort.
The old system has been largely replaced.
His theories are largely based on speculation.
armA.translations: إلى حد كبير في الغالب بصورة عامة
armA.mnemonic: من كلمة 'Large' 'كبير'.. يعني الموضوع بيحصل بنسبة كبيرة 'Largely'

armB.definition: To a great extent; mostly or mainly.
armB.arabic: بمعنى 'إلى حد كبير' أو 'في الغالب'.. لما تكون الحاجة دي هي السبب الرئيسي.
examples: The room is largely empty.
It is largely a matter of time.
The success was largely due to her effort.
The old system has been largely replaced.
His theories are largely based on speculation.
The phenomenon remains largely unexplained by modern science.
armB.mnemonic: من كلمة 'Large' 'كبير'.. يعني الموضوع بيحصل بنسبة كبيرة 'Largely'

armA.definition: The act or sound of laughing.
armA.arabic: الضحكة نفسها. الصوت اللي بيطلع منك لما تكون مبسوط.
examples: She has a loud laugh.
We had a good laugh about it.
His laugh is contagious.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Laugh' أولها 'La'.. زي لما تضحك وتقول 'لا لا لا'.

armB.definition: The act or sound of laughing.
armB.arabic: الضحكة نفسها. الصوت اللي بيطلع منك لما تكون مبسوط.
examples: She has a loud laugh.
We had a good laugh about it.
His laugh is contagious.
It was just a laugh, nothing serious.
She let out a hollow laugh.
The play was a laugh a minute.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Laugh' أولها 'La'.. زي لما تضحك وتقول 'لا لا لا'.

armA.definition: Most important, successful, or advanced.
armA.arabic: صفة بتوصف الشيء أو الشخص اللي في المقدمة، يعني الأهم أو الأنجح في مجاله.
examples: She played the leading role in the play.
Heart disease is a leading cause of death.
They are the leading experts in this field.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lead' 'يقود'.. فالـ 'Leading' هو القائد أو المتصدر.

armB.definition: Most important, successful, or advanced.
armB.arabic: صفة بتوصف الشيء أو الشخص اللي في المقدمة، يعني الأهم أو الأنجح في مجاله.
examples: He is a leading player.
She played the leading role in the play.
Heart disease is a leading cause of death.
They are the leading experts in this field.
The leading edge of technology changes rapidly.
He asked a leading question to trap the witness.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lead' 'يقود'.. فالـ 'Leading' هو القائد أو المتصدر.

armA.definition: A printed sheet of paper containing information or advertising, usually distributed for free.
armA.arabic: ورقة مطبوعة صغيرة بتتوزع في الشارع أو بتيجي مع الدواء فيها معلومات أو إعلانات.
examples: Read the leaflet.
They handed out a leaflet.
The leaflet explains how to use the device.
Check the side effects in the patient information leaflet.
We designed a promotional leaflet for the campaign.
Dropping leaflets from the air was a common propaganda tactic.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Leaf' يعني ورقة شجر.. والـ 'Leaflet' ورقة صغيرة زي ورقة الشجر.

armB.definition: A printed sheet of paper containing information or advertising, usually distributed for free.
armB.arabic: ورقة مطبوعة صغيرة بتتوزع في الشارع أو بتيجي مع الدواء فيها معلومات أو إعلانات.
examples: The leaflet explains how to use the device.
Check the side effects in the patient information leaflet.
We designed a promotional leaflet for the campaign.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Leaf' يعني ورقة شجر.. والـ 'Leaflet' ورقة صغيرة زي ورقة الشجر.

armA.definition: To allow liquid or gas to escape; to disclose secret information.
armA.arabic: يسرب مية أو غاز.. أو يسرب أخبار ومعلومات مش المفروض حد يعرفها.
examples: The tap leaks.
The bottle is leaking water.
The roof leaks when it rains.
Someone leaked the news to the press.
The committee leaked the report to influence public opinion.
Chemicals leached from the soil and leaked into the groundwater.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الاسم.. 'Leak' يعني يسرب.

armB.definition: To allow liquid or gas to escape through a crack or hole, or to disclose secret information to the public.
armB.arabic: يُسرِّب سائلًا أو غازًا عبر فتحة، أو يُسرِّب ويُفشي معلومات سرية للعلن.
examples: Old water pipes often leak when temperatures drop below freezing.
An anonymous insider decided to leak the classified documents to the press.
If the fuel tank continues to leak, the car could catch fire.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر: الموظف قال للصحفي: هسرّب 'ليك' (leak) كل الأخبار السرية.

armA.definition: A big jump or a sudden large change/increase.
armA.arabic: قفزة كبيرة، سواء قفزة حقيقية برجلك أو قفزة وتطور كبير في مستوى حاجة.
examples: The cat made a big leap.
With one leap, he crossed the stream.
It was a leap year with 366 days.
The price of oil took a sudden leap.
Taking that job was a leap in the dark for him.
Technological progress often happens in giant leaps.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'Lip' شِفّة.. تخيل نملة بتعمل 'Leap' قفزة كبيرة من فوق الـ 'Lip'.

armB.definition: A forceful jump or bounce, or a sudden, dramatic increase or advancement.
armB.arabic: قفزة كبيرة، سواء كانت حركة بدنية بالارتقاء في الهواء أو طفرة وتغير مفاجئ وكبير في مستوى شيء ما.
examples: With one leap, he crossed the stream.
The price of oil took a sudden leap.
Taking that job was a leap in the dark for him.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة في النطق من كلمة 'Lip' (شِفّة).. تخيل نملة تقوم بعمل 'Leap' (قفزة كبيرة) من فوق الـ 'Lip'.

armA.definition: Sufficient to cause death; very harmful or destructive.
armA.arabic: قاتل أو مميت. حاجة خطيرة جداً لدرجة إنها ممكن تسبب الوفاة.
examples: The chemical is lethal in small doses.
The government approved the use of lethal force.
A lethal combination of drugs was found in his system.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Last' 'أخير'.. الجرعة الـ 'Lethal' هي الـ 'Last' 'آخر' حاجة هتاخدها في حياتك.

armB.definition: Sufficient to cause death; very harmful or destructive.
armB.arabic: قاتل أو مميت. حاجة خطيرة جداً لدرجة إنها ممكن تسبب الوفاة.
examples: The snake bite is lethal.
That poison is lethal to rats.
Driving fast can be lethal.
The chemical is lethal in small doses.
The government approved the use of lethal force.
A lethal combination of drugs was found in his system.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Last' 'أخير'.. الجرعة الـ 'Lethal' هي الـ 'Last' 'آخر' حاجة هتاخدها في حياتك.

armA.definition: To grant an official license to permit the use of something or allow an activity.
armA.arabic: إنك تدي إذن رسمي لحد عشان يعمل نشاط معين أو يستخدم حاجة ملكك.
examples: They license the car.
The shop is licensed to sell food.
The doctor is licensed to practice medicine.
The company licensed its technology to a foreign partner.
The new drug has not yet been licensed for human use.
The university licensed the patent to a pharmaceutical giant for development.
armA.mnemonic: الفعل من 'ليسانس'.. يعني يدي 'License' لحد.

armB.definition: To grant an official license to permit the use of something or allow an activity.
armB.arabic: أن تمنح إذناً رسمياً أو ترخيصاً لشخص أو جهة لممارسة نشاط معين أو استخدام ملكية ما قانونياً.
examples: The government plans to license several new private radio stations next year.
Many software companies prefer to license their technology rather than sell it outright.
The local council will not license the music venue if safety regulations are not met.
armB.mnemonic: الفعل من 'ليسانس'.. يعني يدي 'License' أو تصريح رسمي لحد.

armA.definition: The way in which a person or group lives.
armA.arabic: طريقة حياتك، بتاكل إيه، بتلبس إيه، بتقضي وقتك إزاي، وكل عاداتك اليومية.
examples: He has a busy lifestyle.
A healthy lifestyle is important.
They enjoy a luxurious lifestyle.
Modern lifestyle can be very stressful.
The magazine promotes an alternative lifestyle.
Sedentary lifestyles are contributing to the rise in chronic diseases.
armA.mnemonic: 'Life' 'حياة' + 'Style' 'أسلوب'.. يعني أسلوب الحياة.

armB.definition: The way in which a person or group lives.
armB.arabic: طريقة حياتك، بتاكل إيه، بتلبس إيه، بتقضي وقتك إزاي، وكل عاداتك اليومية.
examples: A healthy lifestyle is important.
He has a busy lifestyle.
They enjoy a luxurious lifestyle.
armB.mnemonic: 'Life' 'حياة' + 'Style' 'أسلوب'.. يعني أسلوب الحياة.

armA.definition: Gently, delicately, or with little force.
armA.arabic: بخفة وبساطة، من غير قوة أو عنف. ممكن تيجي بمعنى عدم الاهتمام كفاية 'استخفاف'.
examples: She knocked lightly on the door.
Season the food lightly with salt.
Don't take this warning lightly.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Light' 'خفيف'.. 'Lightly' يعني بتعمل الحاجة وإيدك خفيفة

armB.definition: Gently, delicately, or with little force.
armB.arabic: بخفة وبساطة، من غير قوة أو عنف. ممكن تيجي بمعنى عدم الاهتمام كفاية 'استخفاف'.
examples: It is raining lightly.
She knocked lightly on the door.
Season the food lightly with salt.
Don't take this warning lightly.
He was let off lightly by the judge.
She stepped lightly across the fragile ice.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Light' 'خفيف'.. 'Lightly' يعني بتعمل الحاجة وإيدك خفيفة

armA.definition: To find agreeable, enjoyable, or satisfactory.
armA.arabic: يحب حاجة أو تعجبه.
examples: I like pizza.
Do you like swimming?
I would like to order now.
armA.mnemonic: زي زرار الـ 'Like' في الفيسبوك.. بتدوس عليه لما حاجة تعجبك.

armB.definition: To find agreeable, enjoyable, or satisfactory.
armB.arabic: يحب حاجة أو تعجبه.
examples: I like pizza.
Do you like swimming?
I would like to order now.
She doesn't like being told what to do.
I like to think that I am a generous person.
How do you like them apples?
armB.mnemonic: زي زرار الـ 'Like' في الفيسبوك.. بتدوس عليه لما حاجة تعجبك.

armA.definition: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.
armA.arabic: حاجة مش مربوطة كويس أو واسعة زيادة عن اللزوم. زي لما تلبس قميص واسع 'فضفاض' أو مسمار بيتحرك من مكانه.
examples: My tooth is loose.
She wore a loose shirt.
The dog got loose and ran away.
There is a loose connection in the wiring.
It was just a loose translation of the poem.
He has a loose grasp of the complex theories involved.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر فعل 'Lose' 'يخسر'.. لو الزرار كان 'Loose' 'مفكوك'، غالباً هتعمله 'Lose' وتضيّعه.

armB.definition: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.
armB.arabic: حاجة مش مربوطة كويس أو واسعة زيادة عن اللزوم. زي لما تلبس قميص واسع 'فضفاض' أو مسمار بيتحرك من مكانه.
examples: There is a loose connection in the wiring.
She wore a loose shirt.
The dog got loose and ran away.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر فعل 'Lose' 'يخسر'.. لو الزرار كان 'Loose' 'مفكوك'، غالباً هتعمله 'Lose' وتضيّعه.

armA.definition: In a way that is not firm or tight; not exact.
armA.arabic: لما تعمل حاجة من غير دقة أوي، أو تربط حاجة بس مش جامد، يعني سايبة شوية.
examples: Hold it loosely.
The shirt fits loosely.
The movie is loosely based on a true story.
The organizations are loosely connected.
The term is used very loosely in this context.
He held the reins loosely, allowing the horse to choose its path.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Loose' 'واسع'.. لما تربط الحبل 'Loosely' بيبقى مهوي ومش ماسك جامد.

armB.definition: In a way that is not firm, tight, or strictly exact.
armB.arabic: لما تعمل حاجة من غير دقة أوي، أو تربط حاجة بس مش جامد، يعني سايبة شوية.
examples: The shirt fits loosely.
The movie is loosely based on a true story.
The organizations are loosely connected.
armB.translations: بشكل فضفاض بشكل غير محكم تقريبياً
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Loose' 'واسع'.. لما تربط الحبل 'Loosely' بيبقى مهوي ومش ماسك جامد.

armA.definition: Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance.
armA.arabic: وفي ومخلص، الشخص اللي مبيخونش وبيفضل ثابت على العهد.
examples: Dogs are loyal animals.
He is a loyal friend.
The shop has many loyal customers.
She remained loyal to her principles.
The army remained loyal to the government.
His loyal service to the crown was rewarded with a knighthood.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Loyal' قريبة من 'Law' 'قانون'.. المخلص هو اللي بيمشي على قانون الوفاء.

armB.definition: Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance.
armB.arabic: وفي ومخلص، الشخص اللي مبيخونش وبيفضل ثابت على العهد.
examples: He is a loyal friend who always supports those he cares about.
The shop has many loyal customers who return every week.
She remained loyal to her principles despite facing severe criticism.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Loyal' قريبة من 'Law' 'قانون'.. المخلص هو اللي بيمشي على قانون الوفاء.

armA.definition: The words of a song (usually plural: lyrics).
armA.arabic: كلمات الأغنية 'وغالباً بتيجي بصيغة الجمع Lyrics'.
examples: I know the lyric to this song.
He wrote a beautiful lyric.
Can you print the lyrics for me?
The lyrics of this song are very meaningful.
She analyzed the lyric structure of the ballad.
The juxtaposition of the upbeat melody with the melancholic lyric is striking.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Lyric' قريبة من 'Lyre' 'القيثارة'.. زمان كانوا بيغنوا الشعر على القيثارة.

armB.definition: The words of a song (usually plural: lyrics), or a short poem expressing personal feelings.
armB.arabic: كلمات الأغنية (وغالبًا ما تُستخدم بصيغة الجمع lyrics)، أو قصيدة غنائية قصيرة تعبّر عن مشاعر شخصية.
examples: I know the lyric to this song.
She quoted a memorable lyric from her favorite track.
He spent hours trying to write the perfect lyric for the chorus.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Lyric' قريبة من 'Lyre' 'القيثارة'.. زمان كانوا بيغنوا الشعر على القيثارة.

armA.definition: Impressive beauty, dignity, or power; also a title for a king or queen.
armA.arabic: العظمة والفخامة، وكمان لقب بنقوله للملوك 'جلالة الملك'.
examples: The Queen is Her Majesty.
We bowed to His Majesty.
The majesty of the castle amazed us.
You can feel the majesty of the mountains here.
The music captured the sheer majesty of the occasion.
The cathedral stands in all its Gothic majesty.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Magic' 'سحر' قريبة منها.. الـ 'Majesty' فيها سحر وعظمة وهيبة الملوك.

armB.definition: Impressive beauty, dignity, or power; also a title for a king or queen.
armB.arabic: العظمة والفخامة، وكمان لقب بنقوله للملوك 'جلالة الملك'.
examples: The cathedral stands in all its Gothic majesty.
The music captured the sheer majesty of the occasion.
You can feel the majesty of the mountains here.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Magic' 'سحر' قريبة منها.. الـ 'Majesty' فيها سحر وعظمة وهيبة الملوك.

armA.definition: Required by law or rules; compulsory.
