armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول إن حاجة بدأت من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمرة، أو عشان نقول السبب 'بمعنى عشان أو بما إن'.
examples: I have been here since Monday.
She hasn't eaten since breakfast.
Since you are here, please help me.
He has improved a lot since he joined the team.
It has long since been forgotten by the public.
Since the premise is flawed, the conclusion must be rejected.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Sense'.. لما يكون عندك 'Sense' بالوقت، هتعرف إن الموضوع بدأ 'Since' فترة.

armB.definition: From a past time until now, or used to show the reason for something.
armB.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول إن حاجة بدأت من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمرة، أو عشان نقول السبب 'بمعنى عشان أو بما إن'.
examples: He has improved a lot since he joined the team.
Since you are here, please help me.
We decided to stay home since it was raining.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Sense'.. لما يكون عندك 'Sense' بالوقت، هتعرف إن الموضوع بدأ 'Since' فترة.

armA.definition: In the period after a specified time in the past.
armA.arabic: من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمر حتى الآن (منذ).
examples: I have been here since Monday.
She has known him since childhood.
It has been raining since this morning.

armB.definition: In the period after a specified time in the past.
armB.arabic: من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمر لحد دلوقتي.
examples: I have been here since Monday.
She has known him since childhood.
It has been raining since this morning.
Since the war began, many have fled.
Since the dawn of time, humans have looked at the stars.
The regulations have changed since the last audit.

armA.definition: Referring to just one person or thing; exceptionally good or remarkable.
armA.arabic: المفرد 'عكس الجمع'، أو وصف لحاجة فريدة ومتميزة جداً.
examples: Cat is a singular noun.
Use the singular form here.
The word has a singular meaning.
He showed singular courage.
It was an event of singular importance.
Her voice had a singular quality that captivated everyone.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Single'.. في الجرامر يعني 'مفرد'، وفي الوصف يعني حاجة 'Unique' وملهاش زي.

armB.definition: Referring to just one person or thing; exceptionally good or remarkable.
armB.arabic: المفرد 'عكس الجمع'، أو وصف لحاجة فريدة ومتميزة جداً.
examples: Use the singular form here.
He showed singular courage.
Her voice had a singular quality that captivated everyone.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Single'.. في الجرامر يعني 'مفرد'، وفي الوصف يعني حاجة 'Unique' وملهاش زي.

armA.definition: A girl or woman who has the same parents as another person.
armA.arabic: البنت اللي ليها نفس الأب والأم معاك، فرد من العيلة أقرب ما يكون ليك.
examples: I have one sister.
My older sister lives in Paris.
She is like a sister to me.
armA.mnemonic: تشبه 'Sista' بالعامية.. هي أختك اللي من نفس الأب والأم.

armB.definition: A girl or woman who has the same parents as another person.
armB.arabic: البنت اللي ليها نفس الأب والأم معاك، فرد من العيلة أقرب ما يكون ليك.
examples: I have one sister.
My older sister lives in Paris.
She is like a sister to me.
The two cities are sister cities.
The nuns in the convent are called sisters.
We must fight for the rights of our sisters around the world.
armB.mnemonic: تشبه 'Sista' بالعامية.. هي أختك اللي من نفس الأب والأم.

armA.definition: The captain of a ship, boat, or sports team.
armA.arabic: القبطان اللي بيسوق السفينة، أو قائد الفريق الرياضي.
examples: The skipper steers the boat.
He is the skipper of our team.
The skipper told the crew to prepare for the storm.
You need a license to be a skipper of this vessel.
The experienced skipper navigated through the narrow channel.
As the team's skipper, he bore the responsibility for the defeat.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Skipper' هو اللي بيخلي السفينة تعمل 'Skip' للأمواج ويقودها بمهارة.

armB.definition: The captain of a ship, boat, or sports team.
armB.arabic: القبطان اللي بيسوق السفينة، أو قائد الفريق الرياضي.
examples: The experienced skipper navigated through the narrow channel.
The skipper told the crew to prepare for the storm.
As the team's skipper, he bore the responsibility for the defeat.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Skipper' هو اللي بيخلي السفينة تعمل 'Skip' للأمواج ويقودها بمهارة.

armA.definition: To cut with a violent sweeping movement or reduce greatly.
armA.arabic: يقطع حاجة بقوة وعنف، أو يقلل الأسعار بشكل كبير جداً.
examples: Do not slash the seat.
He slashed the tall grass.
The company decided to slash the prices.
Someone slashed his car tires last night.
The new policy aims to slash unemployment rates.
Critics slashed the author's new novel with harsh reviews.
armA.mnemonic: زي لما المحلات تعمل 'Sale'.. بتعمل 'Slash' للأسعار يعني بتقصها للنص.

armB.definition: To cut with a violent sweeping movement or reduce greatly.
armB.arabic: يقطع حاجة بقوة وعنف، أو يقلل الأسعار بشكل كبير جداً.
examples: Do not slash the seat.
The company decided to slash the prices.
The new policy aims to slash unemployment rates.
armB.mnemonic: زي لما المحلات تعمل 'Sale'.. بتعمل 'Slash' للأسعار يعني بتقصها للنص.

armA.definition: To form one's features into a pleased, kind, or amused expression.
armA.arabic: إنك تعمل حركة بشفايفك تبين إنك مبسوط أو بتضحك من غير صوت.
examples: I smile when I am happy.
Please smile for the camera.
She smiled at him across the room.
He smiled politely but didn't say anything.
Fate smiled on their venture.
She smiled a wry smile of resignation.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Smile' قريبة من 'Smell' 'يشم'.. لما بتشم وردة بتعمل 'Smile'.

armB.definition: To form one's features into a pleased, kind, or amused expression.
armB.arabic: إنك تعمل حركة بشفايفك تبين إنك مبسوط أو بتضحك من غير صوت.
examples: I smile when I am happy.
Please smile for the camera.
They always smile when they greet someone.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Smile' قريبة من 'Smell' 'يشم'.. لما بتشم وردة بتعمل 'Smile'.

armA.definition: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning.
armA.arabic: الصابون اللي بنغسل بيه إيدنا ووشنا.
examples: Buy a bar of soap.
This soap smells like lavender.
Use mild soap for sensitive skin.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة soap قريبة جداً في النطق والمعنى من الكلمة العربية 'صابون'.

armB.definition: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning.
armB.arabic: الصابون اللي بنغسل بيه إيدنا ووشنا.
examples: I wash with soap.
Buy a bar of soap.
This soap smells like lavender.
Use mild soap for sensitive skin.
The artisan made soap from organic goat milk.
The chemical reaction used to make soap is called saponification.
armB.mnemonic: هي أصل كلمة 'صابون'.. النطق قريب جداً.

armA.definition: Beautiful in a dramatic and eye-catching way.
armA.arabic: حاجة مبهرة جداً وشكلها يجنن، تخطف العين من جمالها.
examples: The mountain range offers spectacular scenery for hikers.
She looked spectacular in that dress.
The fireworks were spectacular.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Spectacles' 'نظارة'.. حاجة محتاجة تلبس 'Spectacles' عشان تشوف حلاوتها كويس.

armB.definition: Beautiful in a dramatic and eye-catching way.
armB.arabic: حاجة مبهرة جداً وشكلها يجنن، تخطف العين من جمالها.
examples: The view is spectacular.
We saw a spectacular show.
The fireworks were spectacular.
She looked spectacular in that dress.
The team suffered a spectacular failure.
The mountain range offers spectacular scenery for hikers.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Spectacles' 'نظارة'.. حاجة محتاجة تلبس 'Spectacles' عشان تشوف حلاوتها كويس.

armA.definition: A form of words used as a magical charm; OR a short period of time.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: تعويذة سحرية زي اللي في القصص، أو فترة زمنية قصيرة 'زي موجة حر'.
examples: The dry spell damaged the crops.
We had a spell of hot weather.
The wizard recited an ancient spell to unlock the door.
armA.mnemonic: الساحرة بتعمل 'Spell' 'تعويذة' عشان تسحرك.. وممكن تقول 'Cold spell' يعني موجة برد.

armB.definition: A form of words used as a magical charm; OR a short period of time.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: تعويذة سحرية زي اللي في القصص، أو فترة زمنية قصيرة 'زي موجة حر'.
examples: The witch cast a spell.
We had a spell of hot weather.
He rested for a short spell.
She fell under his spell.
The dry spell damaged the crops.
The wizard recited an ancient spell to unlock the door.
armB.mnemonic: الساحرة بتعمل 'Spell' 'تعويذة' عشان تسحرك.. وممكن تقول 'Cold spell' يعني موجة برد.

armA.definition: To write or name the letters that form a word in the correct sequence.
armA.arabic: يتهجى، يعني يقول حروف الكلمة بالترتيب الصح.
examples: Can you spell your name?
How do you spell 'cat'?
I can't spell very well.
Please spell out the details.
The new policy spells disaster for small businesses.
His silence spelled the end of their relationship.
armA.mnemonic: أكيد عارف الـ 'Spelling'.. الفعل 'Spell' يعني يتهجى الكلمة.

armB.definition: To have something bad as an inevitable result; to signify or portend something undesirable.
armB.arabic: ينذر بكذا أو يؤدي حتمًا إلى نتيجة سيئة أو كارثية (مثل: ينذر بكارثة أو يجلب المتاعب).
examples: Any delay in funding could spell disaster for the local hospital.
A sharp increase in taxes would spell trouble for struggling families.
The failure of these talks may spell the end of the peace process.
armB.translations: ينذر بـ يؤدي إلى (كارثة أو مشكلة)
armB.mnemonic: اربط المعنى هنا بالـ 'spell' بمعنى (تعويذة سحرية)؛ كأن الأمر يلقي تعويذة شؤم تجلب الكوار والمتاعب (spells disaster).

armA.definition: Magnificent; very impressive; excellent.
armA.arabic: رائع أو عظيم. كلمة بتوصف الجمال والفخامة.
examples: The house is splendid.
We had a splendid time.
What a splendid idea!
The view from the top was splendid.
He made a splendid effort to win.
The king wore splendid robes for the ceremony.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Splenda' السكر.. حاجة 'Splendid' يعني حلوة زي السكر.

armB.definition: Magnificent; very impressive; excellent.
armB.arabic: رائع أو عظيم. كلمة بتوصف الجمال والفخامة.
examples: What a splendid idea!
The view from the top was splendid.
We had a splendid time.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Splenda' السكر.. حاجة 'Splendid' يعني حلوة زي السكر.

armA.definition: A soft, porous material or an object made of it, used for washing, cleaning, or absorbing liquid.
armA.arabic: الإسفنجة التي تُستخدم في التنظيف أو الاستحمام لامتصاص الماء والسوائل.
examples: I use a sponge to wash the car.
The sponge is full of water.
She wiped the table with a damp sponge.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر شخصية 'سبونج بوب' (SpongeBob) الكرتونية، فهو في الأصل عبارة عن إسفنجة بحرية.

armB.definition: A soft, porous material used for washing or cleaning.
armB.arabic: الإسفنجة اللي بنستخدمها في التنظيف أو الاستحمام عشان بتمتص المية.
examples: I use a sponge to wash the car.
The sponge is full of water.
She wiped the table with a damp sponge.
Sponge cake is very soft and light.
Natural sponges are harvested from the sea.
He was accused of being a sponge, always living off his friends' money.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'SpongeBob'.. هو أصلاً سفنجة.

armA.definition: An act of pressing something firmly; a situation of financial restriction or difficulty.
armA.arabic: ضغطة قوية بالإيد، أو زنقة في الفلوس أو المكان.
examples: She gave his hand a gentle squeeze.
The company is feeling the squeeze from rising costs.
The credit squeeze has affected small businesses.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Squeeze' فيها صوت الكاف والزاي زي كأنك بتعصر حاجة 'سكوييز'.

armB.definition: An act of pressing something firmly; a situation of financial restriction.
armB.arabic: ضغطة قوية بالإيد، أو زنقة في الفلوس أو المكان.
examples: Give the lemon a squeeze.
She gave his hand a gentle squeeze.
It was a tight squeeze to get everyone in the car.
The company is feeling the squeeze from rising costs.
The credit squeeze has affected small businesses.
The government put a squeeze on public spending to curb inflation.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Squeeze' فيها صوت الكاف والزاي زي كأنك بتعصر حاجة 'سكوييز'.

armA.definition: To thrust a knife or other pointed weapon into someone or something.
armA.arabic: يضرب حد بسكينة أو آلة حادة.
examples: The suspect attempted to stab the officer with a broken bottle.
Don't stab the meat with your fork.
He would never stab his partner in the back for personal gain.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Stab' نطقها حاد وقوي زي 'الطعنة' بالظبط.

armB.definition: To thrust a knife or other pointed weapon into someone or something.
armB.arabic: يضرب حد بسكينة أو آلة حادة.
examples: Do not stab.
He was stabbed in the leg.
Don't stab the meat with your fork.
The killer stabbed his victim three times.
I felt like I had been stabbed in the back by my best friend.
The pain stabbed through his chest like a needle.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Stab' نطقها حاد وقوي زي 'الطعنة' بالظبط.

armA.definition: Something that you say or write formally to give information.
armA.arabic: كلام رسمي بتقوله أو بتكتبه عشان توضح معلومة أو تعلن عن حاجة.
examples: The police made a statement.
Is that a true statement?
The minister issued an official statement to the press.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'State' يعني يصرّح.. فالـ 'Statement' هو التصريح نفسه.

armB.definition: Something that you say or write formally to give information.
armB.arabic: كلام رسمي بتقوله أو بتكتبه عشان توضح معلومة أو تعلن عن حاجة.
examples: The police made a statement.
Is that a true statement?
I received my bank statement today.
The prime minister issued a statement regarding the crisis.
Her dress made a bold fashion statement.
The artist's work is a powerful political statement against war.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'State' يعني يصرّح.. فالـ 'Statement' هو التصريح نفسه.

armA.definition: To stop something unwanted from spreading or increasing; also to originate from.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما يوقف تدفق أو انتشار حاجة (زي الدم أو أزمة)، يا إما ينبع أو ييجي من (زي المشاكل اللي بتيجي من سبب معين).
examples: They tried to stem the bleeding.
The government took measures to stem the tide of illegal immigration.
Most of his health problems stem from smoking.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما الـ 'Stem' 'الساق' بيطلع من الأرض، المشاكل ممكن 'Stem from' 'تنبع من' أسباب معينة.

armB.definition: To stop something unwanted from spreading or increasing; also to originate from.
armB.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما يوقف تدفق حاجة 'زي الدم'، يا إما ينبع أو ييجي من 'زي المشكلة دي جاية من كذا'.
examples: Stop the water.
The problem comes from stress.
They tried to stem the bleeding.
Most of his health problems stem from smoking.
The government took measures to stem the tide of illegal immigration.
Her insecurity stems from a lack of affection in childhood.
armB.mnemonic: زي ما الـ 'Stem' 'الساق' بيطلع من الأرض، المشاكل ممكن 'Stem from' 'تنبع من' أسباب معينة.

armA.definition: A close-fitting covering for the foot and leg, usually for women.
armA.arabic: شراب طويل وحريمي، غالباً بيكون خفيف وشفاف، أو الشراب الكبير اللي بيتعلق في الكريسماس.
examples: She wears stockings.
I need a new pair of stockings.
He hung his Christmas stocking by the fire.
Nylon stockings became popular in the 1940s.
The bank robber wore a stocking over his face.
She adjusted the seam of her silk stocking.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Stock' يعني مخزون.. زمان كانوا بيحوشوا الفلوس في الـ 'Stocking'.

armB.definition: A close-fitting covering for the foot and leg, usually made of nylon or silk, or a large decorative sock hung at Christmas.
armB.arabic: شراب طويل وحريمي، غالباً بيكون خفيف وشفاف، أو الشراب الكبير اللي بيتعلق في الكريسماس.
examples: He hung his Christmas stocking by the fire.
The bank robber wore a stocking over his face.
She adjusted the seam of her silk stocking.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Stock' يعني مخزون.. زمان كانوا بيحوشوا الفلوس في الـ 'Stocking'.

armA.definition: A person whom one does not know.
armA.arabic: شخص غريب متعرفوش وأول مرة تشوفه.
examples: He is a stranger.
Don't talk to strangers.
I felt like a stranger in my own town.
She married a complete stranger.
He is no stranger to hard work.
The stranger's mysterious arrival caused a stir.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Strange' 'غريب'.. الشخص اللي تصرفاته أو شكله غريب عليك بيبقى 'Stranger'.

armB.definition: A person whom one does not know.
armB.arabic: شخص غريب لا تعرفه ولم يسبق لك لقاؤه.
examples: She married a complete stranger.
I felt like a stranger in my own town.
A polite stranger stopped to help me find the train station.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Strange' (غريب)؛ الشخص الذي يكون غير مألوف أو شكله وتصرفاته غريبة عليك يكون 'Stranger'.

armA.definition: A continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas; or a small river.
armA.arabic: تيار متدفق.. سواء مية زي النهر الصغير، أو هوا، أو حتى بيانات على النت
examples: There is a small stream near my house.
We crossed the stream on a bridge.
A stream of cold air came into the room.
The company has a steady stream of income.
He watched a live stream of the event.
She released a stream of consciousness in her writing.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Street' 'شارع'.. الـ 'Stream' هو شارع المية.. أو 'Live Stream' 'بث مباشر'

armB.definition: A continuous flow of liquid, air, or people; or a small, narrow river.
armB.arabic: تيار متدفق (سواء ماء، هواء، أو حركة مستمرة)، أو جدول ماء ونهر صغير.
examples: There is a small stream near my house.
A stream of cold air came into the room.
The company has a steady stream of income.
armB.translations: جدول ماء مجرى مائي تيار تدفق
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Street' (شارع).. الـ 'Stream' هو شارع المية الجاري.. أو تذكر 'Live Stream' (بث مباشر يتدفق باستمرار).

armA.definition: To learn about a subject, usually at school or university.
armA.arabic: تخصص وقت ومجهود عشان تتعلم حاجة أو تفهم موضوع، زي المذاكرة.
examples: I study English every day.
She is studying to be a doctor.
He studied the map carefully.
Scientists are studying the effects of the virus.
We need to study the proposal in detail.
He studied his opponent's face for any sign of weakness.

armB.definition: To learn about a subject, usually at school or university.
armB.arabic: تخصص وقت ومجهود عشان تتعلم حاجة أو تفهم موضوع، زي المذاكرة.
examples: I study English every day.
They study hard for the exam.
We study math and science at school.

armA.definition: A thing or person that is being discussed, described, or dealt with; a field of study.
armA.arabic: الموضوع اللي بنتكلم فيه، أو المادة الدراسية اللي بتدرسها في المدرسة زي التاريخ أو العلوم.
examples: Math is my favorite subject.
We changed the subject of the conversation.
History is an interesting subject to study.
The email had no subject line.
The subject of the painting is a young woman.
The ethics of AI is a complex subject involving philosophy and technology.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Subject' هو الموضوع أو المادة.. افتكر إنك بتفتح الـ 'Sub'-way عشان تختار الـ 'Subject' اللي هتاكله.

armB.definition: An area of knowledge studied in a school or college, or a person or thing being discussed or described.
armB.arabic: الموضوع الذي يتم التحدث عنه أو مناقشته، أو المادة الدراسية التي تدرسها في المدرسة أو الجامعة.
examples: Math is my favorite subject.
We changed the subject of the conversation.
History is an interesting subject to study.

armA.definition: A person who pays to receive a service or publication regularly.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي دافع اشتراك عشان توصله خدمة أو مجلة بانتظام، أو مشترك في قناة يوتيوب.
examples: As a loyal subscriber, she receives the print edition of the journal every month.
Each new subscriber is entitled to a complimentary trial period.
The platform notified every subscriber about the upcoming changes to the membership policy.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Sub' 'تحت' و 'Scribe' 'يكتب'.. يعني كتبت اسمك تحت العقد واشتركت.

armB.definition: A person who pays to receive a service or publication regularly.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي دافع اشتراك عشان توصله خدمة أو مجلة بانتظام، أو مشترك في قناة يوتيوب.
examples: I am a subscriber.
The magazine has many subscribers.
Subscribers get a discount on books.
The channel reached one million subscribers.
The service is only available to registered subscribers.
The decline in print subscribers forced the newspaper to go digital.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Sub' 'تحت' و 'Scribe' 'يكتب'.. يعني كتبت اسمك تحت العقد واشتركت.

armA.definition: Coming after something in time; following.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتحصل بعد حاجة تانية، يعني لاحقة أو تالية ليها.
examples: In subsequent years, he became famous.
The subsequent events were surprising.
Subsequent generations will pay the price.
The theory was developed subsequent to the discovery.
Any subsequent changes must be approved.
The mistake was corrected in a subsequent edition of the book.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Sequence' 'تسلسل'.. حاجة 'Subsequent' يعني جاية بعدها في التسلسل، يعني 'لاحقة'.

armB.definition: Coming after something in time; following.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتحصل بعد حاجة تانية، يعني لاحقة أو تالية ليها.
examples: In subsequent years, he became famous.
Any subsequent changes must be approved.
The mistake was corrected in a subsequent edition of the book.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Sequence' 'تسلسل'.. حاجة 'Subsequent' يعني جاية بعدها في التسلسل، يعني 'لاحقة'.

armA.definition: The light that comes from the sun.
armA.arabic: النور اللي بيجي من الشمس.
examples: Plants need sunlight to grow.
Bright sunlight filled the room.
Avoid direct sunlight on your skin at noon.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة مركبة من 'Sun' شمس و 'Light' ضوء.. يعني ضوء الشمس.

armB.definition: The light that comes from the sun.
armB.arabic: النور اللي بيجي من الشمس.
examples: The sunlight is warm.
Plants need sunlight to grow.
Bright sunlight filled the room.
Avoid direct sunlight on your skin at noon.
The painting captures the dappled sunlight on the leaves.
Prolonged exposure to intense sunlight can degrade certain materials.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة مركبة من 'Sun' شمس و 'Light' ضوء.. يعني ضوء الشمس.

armA.definition: A small bird with pointed wings OR an act of swallowing food/drink.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما عصفور السنونو الصغير، يا إما بلعة مية أو أكل.
examples: Look at that little swallow flying.
He took a swallow of water.
The swallows migrate south in winter.
She took a deep swallow of her coffee.
One swallow does not make a summer.
With a nervous swallow, he began his speech.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Swallow' قريبة من 'Swollen' 'متورم'.. لو زورك متورم مش هتعرف تعمل 'Swallow' 'تبلع'.

armB.definition: An act of swallowing food or liquid, a mouthful; or a small migratory bird with long pointed wings and a forked tail.
armB.arabic: اسم له معنيان شائعان: إما جُرْعة أو بَلْعة من شراب أو طعام، وإما طائر السُّنُونُو الصغير ذو الأجنحة الطويلة والذيل المتشعب.
examples: He took a swallow of water.
With a nervous swallow, he began his speech.
Look at that little swallow flying.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Swallow' قريبة من 'Swollen' 'متورم'.. لو زورك متورم مش هتعرف تعمل 'Swallow' 'تبلع'.

armA.definition: To excrete moisture through the pores of the skin, typically due to heat or exertion.
armA.arabic: إن جسمك يفرز ميه 'عرق' لما الجو يكون حر أو تعمل مجهود.
examples: I sweat when it is hot.
He began to sweat after running.
The athletes sweat a lot during training.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sweet' 'حلو'.. بس الـ 'Sweat' 'العرق' مش حلو خالص! فرق حرف واحد يقلب المعنى.

armB.definition: To excrete moisture through the pores of the skin, typically due to heat or exertion.
armB.arabic: إن جسمك يفرز ميه 'عرق' لما الجو يكون حر أو تعمل مجهود.
examples: I sweat when it is hot.
He began to sweat after running.
The athletes sweat a lot during training.
Don't sweat the small stuff; focus on the big picture.
The cheese began to sweat at room temperature.
She was sweating profusely as the fever broke.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sweet' 'حلو'.. بس الـ 'Sweat' 'العرق' مش حلو خالص! فرق حرف واحد يقلب المعنى.

armA.definition: To make a determined effort to deal with a problem or difficult task.
armA.arabic: يعني تبدأ تتعامل مع مشكلة صعبة أو موقف معقد وتحاول تحله، زي لما نقول نتصدى للمشكلة أو نعالج الموضوع بجدية.
examples: We need to tackle this problem soon.
The government is trying to tackle unemployment.
She decided to tackle the difficult project herself.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Take all'.. لما تعمل 'Tackle' لمشكلة، إنت بتـ 'Take all' المسؤولية وبتحلها.

armB.definition: To make a determined effort to deal with a problem or difficult task.
armB.arabic: يعني تبدأ تتعامل مع مشكلة صعبة أو موقف معقد وتحاول تحله. زي لما نقول 'هنعالج الموضوع ده' بجدية.
examples: I tackle the ball in the game.
We need to tackle this problem soon.
The government is trying to tackle unemployment.
She decided to tackle the difficult project herself.
They failed to tackle the underlying causes of the crisis.
The philosopher attempted to tackle the epistemological questions of his time.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Take all'.. لما تعمل 'Tackle' لمشكلة، إنت بتـ 'Take all' المسؤولية وبتحلها.

armA.definition: To hit lightly; or to make use of a resource.
armA.arabic: يخبط خبطة خفيفة، أو يستغل مصدر معين زي ما بتفتح الحنفية.
examples: Tap the screen to start.
He tapped on the door.
She tapped her fingers on the table impatiently.
We need to tap into new markets.
The company is trying to tap the student talent pool.
His phone was tapped by the police.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما بتعمل 'Tap' على شاشة الموبايل عشان تختار حاجة.

armB.definition: To hit lightly; or to make use of a resource.
armB.arabic: يخبط خبطة خفيفة، أو يستغل مصدر معين زي ما بتفتح الحنفية.
examples: Please tap the screen to start the video.
We need to tap into new markets to expand our business.
The company is trying to tap the student talent pool.
armB.mnemonic: زي ما بتعمل 'Tap' على شاشة الموبايل عشان تختار حاجة.

armA.definition: An optical instrument used to make distant objects appear nearer.
armA.arabic: جهاز بيقرب البعيد، بنستخدمه عشان نشوف النجوم والكواكب في السما.
examples: We looked at the stars through a telescope.
He has a small telescope in his room.
The invention of the telescope changed our view of the universe.
armA.mnemonic: 'Tele' يعني بعيد 'زي Telephone'، و 'Scope' يعني رؤية.. يبقى جهاز رؤية البعيد.

armB.definition: An optical instrument used to make distant objects appear nearer.
armB.arabic: جهاز بيقرب البعيد، بنستخدمه عشان نشوف النجوم والكواكب في السما.
examples: I see the moon with a telescope.
He has a small telescope in his room.
We looked at the stars through a telescope.
The Hubble Space Telescope takes amazing pictures.
The invention of the telescope changed our view of the universe.
Radio telescopes detect signals from deep space.
armB.mnemonic: 'Tele' يعني بعيد 'زي Telephone'، و 'Scope' يعني رؤية.. يبقى جهاز رؤية البعيد.

armA.definition: Stretched tight or rigid; unable to relax due to nervousness.
armA.arabic: لما تكون مشدود وقلقان وأعصابك تعبانة، أو وصف للعضلة لما تكون مشدودة.
examples: He looks tense.
My muscles are tense after the gym.
The atmosphere in the room was very tense.
She gets tense before exams.
There was a tense silence before the verdict was read.
Diplomatic relations between the two countries remain tense.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Ten' 'عشرة'.. كأنك شايل 'Ten' كيلو على كتافك فبقيت 'Tense'.

armB.definition: Stretched tight or rigid; unable to relax due to nervousness or anxiety.
armB.arabic: وصف للشخص لما يكون قلقان ومش قادر يسترخي، أو للجو/الموقف لما يكون مشحون ومتوتر، أو للعضلة لما تكون مشدودة.
examples: The atmosphere in the room was very tense.
She gets tense before exams.
My muscles are tense after the gym.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Ten' 'عشرة'.. كأنك شايل 'Ten' كيلو على كتافك فبقيت 'Tense'.

armA.definition: A level paved area or platform next to a building; a patio or balcony.
armA.arabic: شرفة واسعة أو مساحة مبلطة قدام البيت 'تراس'.
examples: We sat on the terrace.
The hotel has a nice terrace.
They ate lunch on the sunny terrace.
The garden is built on several terraces.
Rice is grown on terraces in the mountains.
The penthouse features a wrap-around terrace with city views.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الكلمة بنستخدمها 'تراس'.

armB.definition: A level paved area or platform next to a building; a patio or balcony.
armB.arabic: شرفة واسعة أو مساحة مبلطة قدام البيت 'تراس'.
examples: We sat on the terrace.
They ate lunch on the sunny terrace.
The penthouse features a wrap-around terrace with city views.
armB.mnemonic: نفس الكلمة بنستخدمها 'تراس'.

armA.definition: Extremely bad or causing great fear or distress.
armA.arabic: حاجة سيئة جداً أو مرعبة، زي حادثة فظيعة أو طعم أكل وحش.
examples: I have a terrible headache.
The weather is terrible today.
It was a terrible mistake to leave the door open.
The terrible news shocked the entire community.
The country suffered from a terrible economic depression.
The tyrant's terrible reign left an indelible scar on the nation's psyche.
armA.mnemonic: من نفس أصل 'Terror' رُعْب.. الحاجة الـ 'Terrible' مُرْعِبة وسَيِّئَة.

armB.definition: Extremely bad or causing great fear or distress.
armB.arabic: حاجة سيئة جداً أو مرعبة، زي حادثة فظيعة أو طعم أكل وحش.
examples: I have a terrible headache.
The weather is terrible today.
It was a terrible mistake to leave the door open.
armB.mnemonic: من نفس أصل 'Terror' رُعْب.. الحاجة الـ 'Terrible' مُرْعِبة وسَيِّئَة.

armA.definition: Used to introduce the second part of a comparison.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها للمقارنة بين حاجتين، بمعنى 'من' أو 'عن' لما نقول حاجة أكبر أو أصغر من حاجة.
examples: She is older than me.
I like tea more than coffee.
The results were much better than we expected.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Than' فيها حرف 'A' زي كلمة 'After'.. يعني اللي بيجي بعدها هو اللي بنقارن بيه.

armB.definition: Used to introduce the second part of a comparison.
armB.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها للمقارنة بين حاجتين، بمعنى 'من' أو 'عن' لما نقول حاجة أكبر أو أصغر من حاجة.
examples: She is older than me.
I like tea more than coffee.
It is better to give than to receive.
The results were much better than we expected.
He is more of a poet than a musician.
Scarcely had we arrived than the storm broke.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Than' فيها حرف 'A' زي كلمة 'After'.. يعني اللي بيجي بعدها هو اللي بنقارن بيه.

armA.definition: Immediately or shortly after that.
armA.arabic: فوراً بعد ذلك، أو بناءً على ذلك (كلمة رسمية وأدبية تعني عندئذٍ أو على إثر ذلك).
examples: The agreement was signed, and thereupon the work commenced.
The crowd cheered, and thereupon the speaker resumed his address.
The king died, and thereupon his son took the throne.
armA.translations: عندئذ بناء على ذلك على إثر ذلك
armA.mnemonic: 'There' 'هناك' + 'Upon' 'على'.. يعني بناءً على اللي حصل هناك/دلوقتي، حصل كذا.

armB.definition: Immediately or shortly after that.
armB.arabic: فوراً بعد ذلك، أو بناءً على ذلك. كلمة أدبية شوية.
examples: He left, and then I slept.
She smiled, and thereupon he relaxed.
The king died, and thereupon his son took the throne.
He produced the evidence; thereupon, the case was dismissed.
The agreement was signed, and thereupon the work commenced.
The crowd cheered, and thereupon the speaker resumed his address.
armB.mnemonic: 'There' 'هناك' + 'Upon' 'على'.. يعني بناءً على اللي حصل هناك/دلوقتي، حصل كذا.

armA.definition: The process of using one's mind to consider or reason about something.
armA.arabic: التفكير. عملية تشغيل الدماغ عشان تفهم أو تحل حاجة.
examples: I am thinking.
What is your thinking on this?
We need some fresh thinking.
Critical thinking is an important skill.
His thinking was influenced by Greek philosophy.
Paradigm shifts often require a fundamental change in thinking.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Think' 'يفكر'.. الـ 'Thinking' هو التفكير نفسه

armB.definition: The process of using one's mind to consider or reason about something.
armB.arabic: التفكير. عملية تشغيل الدماغ عشان تفهم أو تحل حاجة.
examples: What is your thinking on this?
We need some fresh thinking.
Critical thinking is an important skill.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Think' 'يفكر'.. الـ 'Thinking' هو التفكير نفسه

armA.definition: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand.
armA.arabic: أداة تحديد بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توضح إننا بنتكلم عن 'هذا' الشيء القريب.
examples: I like this car.
This week has been busy.
We need to solve this problem.

armB.definition: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand.
armB.arabic: أداة تحديد بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توضح إننا بنتكلم عن 'هذا' الشيء القريب.
examples: I like this car.
This week has been busy.
We need to solve this problem.
In this country, people drive on the left.
At this point in time, we cannot comment.
Under this particular interpretation, the law is invalid.

armA.definition: The floor of an entrance; or the level at which something starts to happen.
armA.arabic: العتبة بتاعة الباب، أو الحد الفاصل. يعني النقطة اللي لو عديتها بتدخل في مرحلة جديدة 'زي عتبة الألم'.
examples: He stood on the threshold.
She crossed the threshold into the house.
I have a low threshold for boredom.
If income rises above this threshold, you pay tax.
We are on the threshold of a new era in medicine.
The stimulus failed to reach the threshold required for neural activation.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hold' يعني يمسك.. الـ 'Threshold' هو 'العتبة' اللي بتمسك الباب، أو الحد اللي لو عديته الدنيا تتغير.

armB.definition: The floor of an entrance; or the level at which something starts to happen.
armB.arabic: العتبة بتاعة الباب، أو الحد الفاصل. يعني النقطة اللي لو عديتها بتدخل في مرحلة جديدة 'زي عتبة الألم'.
examples: She crossed the threshold into the house.
If income rises above this threshold, you pay tax.
We are on the threshold of a new era in medicine.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hold' يعني يمسك.. الـ 'Threshold' هو 'العتبة' اللي بتمسك الباب، أو الحد اللي لو عديته الدنيا تتغير.

armA.definition: From the beginning to the end; completely.
armA.arabic: يعني من الأول للآخر، أو بشكل كامل. زي لما تقرأ كتاب كله 'through' أو تتبل مية لحد جسمك.
examples: Please let me through.
I read the book straight through.
We were wet through after the rain.
He slept through the storm.
We need to think this matter through carefully.
The proposal was carried through despite strong opposition.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Through' بإنك بتعدي في الحاجة لحد ما تخلصها.. يعني بتعملها 'Through' للنهاية.

armB.definition: From one end or side to the other, or from the beginning to the end; completely.
armB.arabic: تُستخدم كظرف بمعنى المرور والعبور من جانب لآخر (زي: عدّيني / خليني أمُر)، أو الاستمرار من البداية حتى النهاية وبشكل كامل (زي قراءة شيء للنهاية أو التبلل بالكامل).
examples: Please let me through.
I read the book straight through.
We were wet through after the rain.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر 'Through' بإنك بتعدي في الحاجة لحد ما تخلصها.. يعني بتعملها 'Through' للنهاية.

armA.definition: A rubber covering placed around a wheel to protect it and grip the road.
armA.arabic: الإطار المطاط اللي بيتحط حولين عجل العربية عشان تمشي عليه.
examples: My car has a flat tire.
We need to change the tire.
The mechanic checked the tire pressure.
Winter tires are essential for driving in snow.
The friction of the tire on the road generates heat.
He scrutinized the tire tread for signs of uneven wear.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Tire' قريبة من 'Ta-yer'.. زي ما بنقول 'طَايِر' بالعربية، والعربية بتمشي على الـ 'Tire'.

armB.definition: A rubber covering placed around a wheel to protect it and grip the road.
armB.arabic: الإطار المطاطي الذي يوضع حول عجلة المركبة لحمايتها ومساعدتها على التماسك على الطريق.
examples: My car has a flat tire.
We need to change the tire.
The mechanic checked the tire pressure.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Tire' قريبة من 'Ta-yer'.. زي ما بنقول 'طَايِر' بالعربية، والعربية بتمشي على الـ 'Tire'.

armA.definition: To throw something lightly or casually.
armA.arabic: يرمي حاجة بخفة أو من غير اهتمام، زي لما ترمي المفاتيح على الترابيزة.
examples: Toss the ball to me.
Please toss the salad.
Don't just toss your clothes on the floor.
He tossed the keys to his brother.
She tossed and turned all night, unable to sleep.
They tossed around a few ideas for the new project.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'طز'.. لما تقول لحد 'طز' ممكن تعمل 'Toss' 'ترمي' حاجة بإيدك.

armB.definition: To throw something lightly or casually.
armB.arabic: يرمي حاجة بخفة أو من غير اهتمام، زي لما ترمي المفاتيح على الترابيزة.
examples: Don't just toss your clothes on the floor.
Let's toss a coin to decide who goes first.
Please toss the ball back to the children.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'طز'.. لما تقول لحد 'طز' ممكن تعمل 'Toss' 'ترمي' حاجة بإيدك.

armA.definition: A powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment.
armA.arabic: جرار زراعي قوي بيمشي في الأرض الطينة عشان يحرثها أو يشد حاجات تقيلة.
examples: The farmer drives a tractor.
A red tractor is in the field.
He used a tractor to pull the heavy trailer.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Traction' يعني جرّ.. الـ 'Tractor' هو اللي بيعمل الجرّ ده في المزرعة.

armB.definition: A powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment.
armB.arabic: جرار زراعي قوي بيمشي في الأرض الطينة عشان يحرثها أو يشد حاجات تقيلة.
examples: The farmer drives a tractor.
A red tractor is in the field.
He used a tractor to pull the heavy trailer.
Modern tractors are equipped with GPS technology.
The agricultural sector relies heavily on tractor maintenance.
The mechanization of farming began with the introduction of the steam tractor.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Traction' يعني جرّ.. الـ 'Tractor' هو اللي بيعمل الجرّ ده في المزرعة.

armA.definition: A person who trains people or animals.
armA.arabic: المدرب اللي بيعلمك مهارة جديدة أو بيساعدك تتمرن في الجيم، أو بيدرب حيوانات.
examples: He is my trainer.
I need a personal trainer.
The dog trainer is very good.
She works as a corporate trainer.
The horse trainer prepared for the race.
Experienced trainers know how to motivate athletes.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Train' يدرب.. الـ 'Trainer' هو المدرب اللي بيعلمك تعمل التمرين صح.

armB.definition: A person who trains people or animals.
armB.arabic: المدرب اللي بيعلمك مهارة جديدة أو بيساعدك تتمرن في الجيم، أو بيدرب حيوانات.
examples: I need a personal trainer to help me get in shape.
The dog trainer showed us how to manage our puppy.
She works as a corporate trainer for new employees.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Train' يدرب.. الـ 'Trainer' هو المدرب اللي بيعلمك تعمل التمرين صح.

armA.definition: To do or carry out business.
armA.arabic: يُجري معاملة تجارية أو يخلص شغل ومصالح.
examples: They agreed to transact business solely in Euros.
It is safer to transact online with a secure connection.
The dealer refused to transact with unregistered clients.
armA.mnemonic: أصل كلمة 'Transaction'.. لما تـ 'Transact' يعني بتعمل 'Action' 'فعل' تجاري.

armB.definition: To do or carry out business.
armB.arabic: يُجري معاملة تجارية أو يخلص شغل ومصالح.
examples: They buy and sell things.
We transact business every day.
It is safer to transact online with a secure connection.
Banks transact millions of dollars daily.
The dealer refused to transact with unregistered clients.
They agreed to transact business solely in Euros.
armB.mnemonic: أصل كلمة 'Transaction'.. لما تـ 'Transact' يعني بتعمل 'Action' 'فعل' تجاري.

armA.definition: To express the sense of words or text in another language.
armA.arabic: يترجم، يعني يحول الكلام من لغة للغة تانية.
examples: Can you translate this?
I used an app to translate the menu.
It is difficult to translate poetry.
armA.mnemonic: 'Trans' 'نقل' + 'Late' 'متأخر'.. المترجم بينقل المعنى من غير ما يكون 'Late'.

armB.definition: To express the sense of words or text in another language.
armB.arabic: يترجم، يعني يحول الكلام من لغة للغة تانية.
examples: Can you translate this?
He translates from English to Arabic.
I used an app to translate the menu.
His books have been translated into many languages.
It is difficult to translate poetry.
The idea doesn't translate well to the screen.
armB.mnemonic: 'Trans' 'نقل' + 'Late' 'متأخر'.. المترجم بينقل المعنى من غير ما يكون 'Late'.

armA.definition: A cart on wheels used for transporting items, or a streetcar.
armA.arabic: العربية اللي بعجل زي عربية السوبر ماركت أو عربية نقل الشنط.
examples: Put the food in the shopping trolley.
She loaded her luggage onto the airport trolley.
The city restored the vintage electric trolley for tourists.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Roll' 'يتدحرج'.. الـ 'Trolley' بيمشي على عجل و 'Rolls'.

armB.definition: A cart on wheels used for transporting items, or a streetcar.
armB.arabic: العربية اللي بعجل زي عربية السوبر ماركت أو عربية نقل الشنط.
examples: I need a trolley for my bags.
Put the food in the shopping trolley.
The waiter brought the dessert trolley.
She loaded her luggage onto the airport trolley.
The hospital patient was moved on a trolley.
The city restored the vintage electric trolley for tourists.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Roll' 'يتدحرج'.. الـ 'Trolley' بيمشي على عجل و 'Rolls'.

armA.definition: In accordance with fact or reality; not false or erroneous.
armA.arabic: حاجة صح وحقيقية، مش كذب ولا تأليف، ومطابقة للواقع.
examples: Is this story true?
It is true that he likes pizza.
The movie is based on a true story.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'False'.. يعني حاجة 'True' ومؤكدة.

armB.definition: In accordance with fact or reality; not false or erroneous.
armB.arabic: حاجة صح وحقيقية، مش كذب ولا تأليف، ومطابقة للواقع.
examples: Is this story true?
It is true that he likes pizza.
A true friend helps you when you are in trouble.
The movie is based on a true story.
Her predictions came true exactly as she said.
He remained true to his principles despite the pressure.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'False'.. يعني حاجة 'True' ومؤكدة.

armA.definition: A melody, especially one that characterizes a particular piece of music.
armA.arabic: اللحن أو النغمة المميزة لأغنية أو مقطوعة موسيقية.
examples: I like this tune.
She hummed a happy tune.
Do you recognize this tune?
The piano is out of tune.
The politician changed his tune when he saw the poll results.
His ideas are perfectly in tune with the modern era.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Tune' زي 'iTunes'.. البرنامج اللي بنسمع عليه 'Naghmah' 'نغمات'.

armB.definition: A melody, especially one that characterizes a particular piece of music, or the state of being at the correct musical pitch.
armB.arabic: اللحن أو النغمة الموسيقية، وتُستخدم أيضاً للإشارة إلى ضبط النغمات أو الدوزان الموسيقي الصحيح.
examples: She hummed a happy tune.
Do you recognize this tune?
The piano is out of tune.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Tune' زي 'iTunes'.. البرنامج اللي بنسمع عليه نغمات وألحان موسيقية.

armA.definition: The state of being unsure or not knowing what will happen.
armA.arabic: حالة عدم التأكد أو الشك في حاجة معينة وإنك مش عارف إيه اللي هيحصل.
examples: There is still some uncertainty regarding the date.
Economic uncertainty affects everyone.
The uncertainty made him nervous.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Certainty' 'يقين'.. الـ 'Uncertainty' هي 'الحيرة' وعدم التأكد.

armB.definition: The state of being unsure or not knowing what will happen.
armB.arabic: حالة عدم التأكد أو الشك في حاجة معينة وإنك مش عارف إيه اللي هيحصل.
examples: There is uncertainty about the weather.
The uncertainty made him nervous.
Economic uncertainty affects everyone.
There is still some uncertainty regarding the date.
The project was plagued by scientific uncertainty.
He faced the uncertainty of his future with stoic calm.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Certainty' 'يقين'.. الـ 'Uncertainty' هي 'الحيرة' وعدم التأكد.

armA.definition: Significant as a cause or basis of something but not necessarily obvious.
armA.arabic: حاجة أساسية أو جوهرية بس مش ظاهرة على السطح، زي السبب الحقيقي 'الخفي' لمشكلة.
examples: The underlying rock is hard.
We must find the underlying reason.
Stress is often the underlying cause of illness.
The underlying message of the film was hope.
We need to address the underlying structural problems.
The theory is based on several underlying assumptions about human nature.
armA.mnemonic: 'Under' 'تحت' + 'Lying' 'مستلقي'.. الشيء الـ 'Underlying' هو اللي نايم تحت السطح ومش باين بس هو الأساس.

armB.definition: Significant as a cause, principle, or basis of something, but not always obvious or directly stated.
armB.arabic: حاجة أساسية أو جوهرية بس مش ظاهرة على السطح، زي السبب الحقيقي أو الخفي لمشكلة.
examples: Stress is often the underlying cause of illness.
The underlying message of the film was hope.
We need to address the underlying structural problems.
armB.mnemonic: مكوّنة من under (تحت) وlying (مستلقٍ أو واقع)؛ الشيء الـ underlying كأنه مستلقٍ تحت السطح، مش باين مباشرة لكنه الأساس لكل شيء.

armA.definition: Clothing worn under other clothes, next to the skin.
armA.arabic: الهدوم اللي بتتلبس تحت اللبس الخارجي وملاصقة للجسم.
examples: Put on clean underwear every day.
He packed socks and underwear for the trip.
Thermal underwear is essential for skiing.
armA.mnemonic: هي 'Under' يعني 'تحت' و 'Wear' يعني 'لبس'.. يبقى 'Underwear' هو 'اللبس اللي تحت'.

armB.definition: Clothing worn under other clothes, next to the skin.
armB.arabic: الهدوم اللي بتتلبس تحت اللبس الخارجي وملاصقة للجسم.
examples: I bought new underwear.
Put on clean underwear every day.
He packed socks and underwear for the trip.
Thermal underwear is essential for skiing.
The brand launched a new line of luxury underwear.
Historical analysis of underwear reveals changes in social norms.
armB.mnemonic: هي 'Under' يعني 'تحت' و 'Wear' يعني 'لبس'.. يبقى 'Underwear' هو 'اللبس اللي تحت'.

armA.definition: To an unwarranted degree; inordinately.
armA.arabic: يعني بشكل مبالغ فيه أو زيادة عن اللزوم ومن غير سبب مقنع.
examples: The task was not unduly difficult.
He seemed unduly concerned about the cost.
The report was unduly critical of the staff.
armA.translations: بشكل مفرط دون مبرر بلا داعٍ
armA.mnemonic: 'Due' يعني مستحق.. 'Unduly' يعني زيادة عن المستحق أو اللازم.

armB.definition: To an unwarranted degree; inordinately.
armB.arabic: يعني بشكل مبالغ فيه أو زيادة عن اللزوم ومن غير سبب مقنع.
examples: Don't be unduly worried.
The task was not unduly difficult.
He seemed unduly concerned about the cost.
The report was unduly critical of the staff.
There is no need to be unduly pessimistic about the outcome.
The influence of the lobby groups was unduly strong in the decision-making process.
armB.mnemonic: 'Due' يعني مستحق.. 'Unduly' يعني زيادة عن المستحق أو اللازم.

armA.definition: The distinctive clothing worn by members of the same organization or body.
armA.arabic: الزي الموحد اللي بيلبسوه في المدارس أو الشغل أو الجيش.
examples: She wears a blue uniform to school.
The police officer was in uniform.
He looked very smart in his military uniform.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'يونيفورم' بنستخدمها في حياتنا العادية بنفس المعنى.

armB.definition: The distinctive clothing worn by members of the same organization or body.
armB.arabic: الزي الموحد اللي بيلبسوه في المدارس أو الشغل أو الجيش.
examples: She wears a blue uniform to school.
The police officer was in uniform.
Nurses usually wear a white uniform.
He looked very smart in his military uniform.
The soldiers were issued with new combat uniforms.
The wearing of school uniforms fosters a sense of belonging.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'يونيفورم' بنستخدمها في حياتنا العادية بنفس المعنى.

armA.definition: To come or bring together for a common purpose or action.
armA.arabic: يعني يتحدوا أو يتجمعوا عشان هدف واحد. زي لما الناس تتحد عشان تعمل تغيير أو الدول تتحد في حلف.
examples: We must unite now.
The team united to win the game.
Music can unite people from different cultures.
The two companies decided to unite to increase profits.
The tragedy served to unite the community in grief.
Various factions attempted to unite under a single banner of revolution.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Unit' يعني وحدة.. لما الناس تعمل 'Unite' بيتحولوا لـ 'Unit' 'وحدة' واحدة قوية.

armB.definition: To come or bring together for a common purpose or action.
armB.arabic: يعني يتحدوا أو يتجمعوا عشان هدف واحد. زي لما الناس تتحد عشان تعمل تغيير أو الدول تتحد في حلف.
examples: Music can unite people from different cultures.
The two companies decided to unite to increase profits.
The tragedy served to unite the community in grief.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Unit' يعني وحدة.. لما الناس تعمل 'Unite' بيتحولوا لـ 'Unit' 'وحدة' واحدة قوية.

armA.definition: All of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.
armA.arabic: الكون كله، الأرض والكواكب والنجوم وكل حاجة موجودة.
examples: Scientists study the origins of the universe.
Is there life elsewhere in the universe?
The expansion of the universe is accelerating.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Uni' يعني واحد.. الـ 'Universe' هو الكون الواحد اللي بيجمعنا كلنا.

armB.definition: All of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.
armB.arabic: الكون كله، الأرض والكواكب والنجوم وكل حاجة موجودة.
examples: The sun is in the universe.
We live in a large universe.
Scientists study the origins of the universe.
Is there life elsewhere in the universe?
He believes in a parallel universe.
The expansion of the universe is accelerating.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Uni' يعني واحد.. الـ 'Universe' هو الكون الواحد اللي بيجمعنا كلنا.

armA.definition: Up to the point in time or the event mentioned.
armA.arabic: لغاية وقت معين. زي لما تقول: هستناك لغاية الساعة 5.
examples: Wait until tomorrow.
The shop is open until 5 PM.
He stayed until the end of the movie.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Antel' 'أنتل'.. هستناك تركب الـ 'Antel' 'until' ما الإشارة تيجي.

armB.definition: Up to the point in time or the event mentioned.
armB.arabic: لغاية وقت معين. زي لما تقول: هستناك لغاية الساعة 5.
examples: Open until 5 PM.
Wait until tomorrow.
He stayed until the end of the movie.
Up until now, we had no problems.
The secret was kept until his death.
She continued working until late into the night.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Antel' 'أنتل'.. هستناك تركب الـ 'Antel' 'until' ما الإشارة تيجي.

armA.definition: To remove a covering from; to make known or reveal for the first time.
armA.arabic: يكشف الستار عن حاجة.. يعني يعلن عن منتج جديد أو خطة لأول مرة، أو يشيل الغطا من على تمثال.
examples: They will unveil the statue.
The company unveiled a new car.
The plan was unveiled yesterday.
She unveiled her secret to her friends.
The government unveiled a comprehensive reform package.
The artist unveiled his masterpiece to a stunned audience.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Veil' 'حجاب/ستار'.. الـ 'Unveil' إنك تشيل الستار وتكشف المستور.

armB.definition: To remove a covering from; to make known or reveal for the first time.
armB.arabic: يكشف الستار عن حاجة.. يعني يعلن عن منتج جديد أو خطة لأول مرة، أو يشيل الغطا من على تمثال.
examples: They will unveil the statue during tomorrow's official ceremony.
The company plans to unveil its latest smartphone at the annual conference.
The government is expected to unveil a comprehensive reform package next week.
armB.translations: يكشف النقاب عن يزيح الستار عن يعلن لأول مرة
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Veil' 'حجاب/ستار'.. الـ 'Unveil' إنك تشيل الستار وتكشف المستور.

armA.definition: Complete; absolute.
armA.arabic: يعني كامل أو مُطلق، زي لما تقول 'فوضى عارمة' أو 'ظلام دامس'.
examples: It was utter silence.
The room was in utter darkness.
That is utter nonsense.
The party was an utter failure.
He looked at me in utter amazement.
The situation descended into utter chaos after the announcement.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Outer'.. حاجة واصلة للحد الأقصى 'Utter'.

armB.definition: Complete; absolute.
armB.arabic: يعني كامل أو مُطلق، زي لما تقول 'فوضى عارمة' أو 'ظلام دامس'.
examples: The situation descended into utter chaos after the announcement.
He looked at me in utter amazement.
The meeting ended in an utter failure when neither side agreed to compromise.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Outer'.. حاجة واصلة للحد الأقصى 'Utter'.

armA.definition: Of very great extent or quantity; immense.
armA.arabic: حاجة ضخمة جداً وواسعة، سواء في المساحة أو العدد.
examples: The sea is vast.
A vast number of people attended.
The vast majority of students passed.
They crossed a vast desert.
The universe is vast and mysterious.
His knowledge of the subject is vast.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Vast' شبه 'Fast' 'سريع'.. عشان تقطع مسافة 'Vast' 'واسعة' لازم تمشي 'Fast'.

armB.definition: Of very great extent or quantity; immense.
armB.arabic: حاجة ضخمة جداً وواسعة، سواء في المساحة أو العدد.
examples: The vast majority of students passed.
They crossed a vast desert.
His knowledge of the subject is vast.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Vast' شبه 'Fast' 'سريع'.. عشان تقطع مسافة 'Vast' 'واسعة' لازم تمشي 'Fast'.

armA.definition: Traveling through a place on the way to a destination, or by means of a particular system or method.
armA.arabic: المرور عبر مكان في الطريق إلى مكان آخر، أو القيام بشيء بواسطة وسيلة أو طريقة معينة.
examples: We are flying to Tokyo via Dubai.
He sent the message via email.
The news was broadcast via satellite to millions.

armB.definition: Traveling through a place on the way to a destination, or by means of.
armB.arabic: إنك تروح مكان عن طريق مكان تاني، أو تعمل حاجة بواسطة أداة معينة.
examples: I went home via the park.
He sent the message via email.
We are flying to Tokyo via Dubai.
The news was broadcast via satellite to millions.
She achieved success via a highly unconventional route.
The disease is transmitted via respiratory droplets in the air.

armA.definition: A musical instrument with four strings held against the neck and played with a bow.
armA.arabic: آلة موسيقية وترية بتتلعب بقوس، صوتها ناعم ومشهورة جداً في الموسيقى الكلاسيكية والأوركسترا.
examples: She plays the violin very well.
I want to buy a new violin for my lesson.
The sound of a violin can be very sad.
He is the lead violin in the school orchestra.
The concerto was written specifically for the violin.
The luthier spent months crafting the exquisite violin.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Violin' قريبة من 'Violent' 'عنيف'.. بس العكس، صوتها حنين مش عنيف.

armB.definition: A musical instrument with four strings held against the neck and played with a bow.
armB.arabic: آلة موسيقية وترية بتتلعب بقوس، صوتها ناعم ومشهورة جداً في الموسيقى الكلاسيكية والأوركسترا.
examples: She plays the violin very well.
I want to buy a new violin for my lesson.
The sound of a violin can be very sad.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Violin' قريبة من 'Violent' 'عنيف'.. بس العكس، صوتها حنين مش عنيف.

armA.definition: A network of fine threads made by a spider; the Internet.
armA.arabic: شبكة خيوط بيعملها العنكبوت، أو شبكة الإنترنت اللي بتربط العالم ببعضه.
examples: The spider made a web.
I search on the web.
Flies get caught in the spider's web.
The web of lies he told eventually collapsed.
It is a complex web of political alliances.
The duck's webbed feet help it swim efficiently.
armA.mnemonic: شبكة العنكبوت أو الـ 'Web' سايت.

armB.definition: A network of fine threads made by a spider; the Internet.
armB.arabic: شبكة خيوط بيعملها العنكبوت، أو شبكة الإنترنت اللي بتربط العالم ببعضه.
examples: The spider made a web.
Flies get caught in the spider's web.
You can find a lot of information on the web.
armB.mnemonic: شبكة العنكبوت أو الـ 'Web' سايت.

armA.definition: To measure how heavy someone or something is.
armA.arabic: توزن حاجة عشان تعرف هي كام كيلو، أو تفكر في قرار وتقارن بين الاختيارات.
examples: I weigh 70 kilos.
Please weigh the fruit.
He weighed himself on the scales.
You need to weigh the pros and cons.
The evidence weighed heavily against him.
She had to weigh her words carefully before speaking.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Way' 'طريق'.. وانت في الـ 'Way' للمطار لازم تعمل 'Weigh' 'وزن' للشنط بتاعتك.

armB.definition: To measure how heavy someone or something is, or to consider options carefully before deciding.
armB.arabic: توزن حاجة عشان تعرف هي كام كيلو، أو تفكر في قرار وتقارن بين الاختيارات.
examples: Please weigh the fruit.
I weigh 70 kilos.
You need to weigh the pros and cons.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Way' 'طريق'.. وانت في الـ 'Way' للمطار لازم تعمل 'Weigh' 'وزن' للشنط بتاعتك.

armA.definition: In a good or satisfactory way.
armA.arabic: بشكل كويس أو جيد. عكس 'Badly'.
examples: She cooks very well.
I know him well.
The team played well today.
You did well to tell the truth.
This implies that the system works well.
The policy was well received by the public.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Ill'.. 'Well' يعني كويس.

armB.definition: In a good or satisfactory way.
armB.arabic: بشكل كويس أو جيد؛ بطريقة مرضية أو ناجحة.
examples: She cooks very well.
I know him well.
The team played well today.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Ill'.. 'Well' يعني كويس.

armA.definition: At what time; used to ask questions about time.
armA.arabic: بتستخدم عشان تسأل عن الوقت، بمعنى 'إمتى؟'.
examples: When is your birthday?
When did you arrive?
I don't know when the train leaves.
When are you planning to finish the project?
When, if ever, will they learn?
Since when has he been an expert?
armA.mnemonic: اربط 'When' بكلمة 'Win' 'يفوز'.. واسأل نفسك: 'When' will I 'win'? 'إمتى هفوز؟'.

armB.definition: At what time; used to ask questions about time.
armB.arabic: بتستخدم عشان تسأل عن الوقت، بمعنى 'إمتى؟'.
examples: When is your birthday?
When did you arrive?
I don't know when the train leaves.
armB.mnemonic: اربط 'When' بكلمة 'Win' 'يفوز'.. واسأل نفسك: 'When' will I 'win'? 'إمتى هفوز؟'.

armA.definition: During the time that; at the same time as.
armA.arabic: بينما، أو في الوقت اللي بيحصل فيه حاجة تانية. 'كلمة رسمية أكتر من while'.
examples: The system was upgraded whilst maintaining full operational capacity.
Whilst some people love winter, others hate it.
He listened whilst she spoke.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Whilst' هي هي 'While' بس فيها 'st' زيادة للدلع والرسميات.

armB.definition: During the time that; at the same time as.
armB.arabic: بينما، أو في الوقت اللي بيحصل فيه حاجة تانية. 'كلمة رسمية أكتر من while'.
examples: I read whilst he slept.
Whilst walking, I saw a cat.
He listened whilst she spoke.
Whilst I agree with you, I cannot help.
Whilst some people love winter, others hate it.
The system was upgraded whilst maintaining full operational capacity.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Whilst' هي هي 'While' بس فيها 'st' زيادة للدلع والرسميات.

armA.definition: To speak very softly using one's breath without one's vocal cords.
armA.arabic: إنك تتكلم بصوت واطي جداً 'تهس' عشان محدش يسمعك.
examples: Please whisper in the library.
You can whisper your secret to me.
They had to whisper so no one would overhear them.
armA.mnemonic: زي ما بنقول بالمصري 'وسوسة'.. 'Whisper' قريبة في النطق والمعنى 'كلام واطي'.

armB.definition: To speak very softly using one's breath without one's vocal cords.
armB.arabic: إنك تتكلم بصوت واطي جداً 'تهس' عشان محدش يسمعك.
examples: Please whisper in the library.
He whispered his name to me.
She whispered something in his ear.
The wind whispered through the tall grass.
It is whispered that the company is going bankrupt.
He whispered a prayer of gratitude as the plane landed safely.
armB.mnemonic: زي ما بنقول بالمصري 'وسوسة'.. 'Whisper' قريبة في النطق والمعنى 'كلام واطي'.

armA.definition: A thing that is complete in itself.
armA.arabic: الكل أو المجموع الكامل لشيء.
examples: Two halves make a whole.
The collection functions as a whole.
We must consider the society as a whole.
armA.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Hole' 'حفرة'.. أكلت الكيكة الـ 'Whole' 'كلها' وماسيبتش غير الـ Hole.

armB.definition: A thing that is complete in itself.
armB.arabic: الكل أو المجموع الكامل لشيء.
examples: Two halves make a whole.
The collection functions as a whole.
The project was, on the whole, a success.
We must consider the society as a whole.
The parts are greater than the whole in this specific theory.
Organic architecture treats the building as a unified whole.
armB.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Hole' 'حفرة'.. أكلت الكيكة الـ 'Whole' 'كلها' وماسيبتش غير الـ Hole.

armA.definition: The measurement or extent of something from side to side.
armA.arabic: العرض بتاع أي حاجة، يعني المسافة من الجنب ده للجنب ده.
examples: What is the width of the box?
Measure the width of the room.
The road varies in width.
The fabric is available in different widths.
The width of his knowledge is impressive.
They swam the entire width of the river against the current.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Wide' 'واسع'.. الـ 'Width' هو قديش الحاجة واسعة.

armB.definition: The measurement or extent of something from side to side.
armB.arabic: العرض بتاع أي حاجة، يعني المسافة من الجنب ده للجنب ده.
examples: Measure the width of the room.
The road varies in width.
They swam the entire width of the river against the current.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Wide' 'واسع'.. الـ 'Width' هو قديش الحاجة واسعة.

armA.definition: The quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment.
armA.arabic: الحكمة، يعني لما يكون عندك خبرة ومعرفة تخليك تاخد قرارات صح.
examples: Listen to the wisdom of your parents.
I question the wisdom of that decision.
The conventional wisdom was challenged by new findings.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Wise' حكيم.. الـ 'Wisdom' هي الحكمة اللي بتيجي مع السن والخبرة.

armB.definition: The quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment.
armB.arabic: الحكمة، يعني لما يكون عندك خبرة ومعرفة تخليك تاخد قرارات صح.
examples: He has much wisdom.
Listen to the wisdom of your parents.
Wisdom comes with age.
I question the wisdom of that decision.
Traditional folk wisdom suggests honey for a cough.
The conventional wisdom was challenged by new findings.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Wise' حكيم.. الـ 'Wisdom' هي الحكمة اللي بتيجي مع السن والخبرة.

armA.definition: Made of wood; (of a person or behavior) stiff, awkward, and showing little or no emotion.
armA.arabic: مصنوع من الخشب، وتُستخدم أيضاً مجازياً لوصف الشخص أو الأداء المتخشب والجامد الخالي من التعبير.
examples: She stirred the soup with a wooden spoon.
They built a small wooden house.
His acting was rather wooden and unconvincing.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Wood' 'خشب'.. وزودنا 'en' عشان تبقى صفة.

armB.definition: Made of wood; (of a person) stiff and awkward in movement or manner.
armB.arabic: مصنوع من الخشب، وأحياناً بنوصف بيها الشخص اللي حركته مش طبيعية ومتخشب.
examples: I have a wooden chair.
The box is wooden.
They built a small wooden house.
She stirred the soup with a wooden spoon.
His acting was rather wooden and unconvincing.
The wooden expression on his face betrayed no emotion.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Wood' 'خشب'.. وزودنا 'en' عشان تبقى صفة.

armA.definition: To injure someone physically, especially with a weapon, or to hurt someone's feelings or pride deeply.
armA.arabic: يجرح شخصاً جسدياً (خاصة بسلاح أو أداة حادة)، أو يجرح مشاعره وكبرياءه معنوياً.
examples: Be careful not to wound yourself with that broken glass.
A stray bullet can easily wound innocent bystanders.
He did not intend to wound her feelings with his honest remark.
armA.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم، حرف الـ 'W' يشبه غُرز خياطة الجرح.. 'Wound' يعني يجرح.

armB.definition: To injure someone, usually with a weapon; to hurt someone's feelings.
armB.arabic: يجرح حد بسلاح أو يعوره، وممكن تستخدم معنوياً بمعنى يجرح مشاعر حد.
examples: Be careful not to wound yourself.
The knife wounded his hand.
He was wounded in the accident.
She was deeply wounded by his cruel words.
The scandal wounded his reputation significantly.
The animal was wounded but managed to escape.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم، حرف الـ 'W' زي خياطة الجرح.. 'Wound' يعني يجرح.

armA.definition: But; nevertheless; despite that.
armA.arabic: بتيجي بمعنى 'لكن' أو 'مع ذلك' عشان تربط جملتين فيهم تناقض.
examples: It is small yet strong.
He is old, yet he runs fast.
The path was dark, yet I found my way.
It was a strange yet beautiful song.
He has a good job, and yet he never seems to have any money.
Simple yet profound, the theory explains everything.

armB.definition: Used to link two contrasting ideas or clauses; but, nevertheless.
armB.arabic: أداة ربط بتيجي بمعنى 'لكن' أو 'مع ذلك' للربط بين جملتين أو صفتين بينهما تناقض.
examples: It was a strange yet beautiful song.
The path was dark, yet I found my way.
He has a good job, and yet he never seems to have any money.

armA.definition: Belonging to or associated with the person being addressed.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتاعتك إنت.. بنستخدمها عشان ننسب الملكية للشخص اللي بنكلمه.
examples: What is your name?
Is this your car?
Don't forget your passport.
I appreciate your help.
It is none of your business.
I beg your pardon?
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Your' شبه 'You'.. بس بنحط 'r' عشان نقول إن الحاجة دي بتاعتك.

armB.definition: Belonging to or associated with the person being addressed.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتاعتك إنت.. بنستخدمها عشان ننسب الملكية للشخص اللي بنكلمه.
examples: What is your name?
Is this your car?
Don't forget your passport.
armB.translations: لَك خَاص بِك ـكَ / ـكِ (كاف الملكية)
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Your' شبه 'You'.. بس بنحط 'r' عشان نقول إن الحاجة دي بتاعتك.
